import sand3d as s3d


def armchair():

    back_placed = s3d.at(back(), x=-21.6, y=-282, z=293)
    arm_placed = s3d.at(arm(), x=-333.9, y=20, z=293)
    arm_image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(arm_placed), mirror="x", x=-43.1)
    front_leg_placed = s3d.at(front_leg(), x=-347, y=345, z=-0.5)
    front_leg_image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(front_leg_placed), mirror="x", x=-43.1)
    rear_leg_placed = s3d.at(rear_leg(), x=-350, y=-291, z=-0.5)
    rear_leg_image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(rear_leg_placed), mirror="x", x=-43.1)
    return s3d.assembly("armchair", seat_placed, back_placed, arm_placed, arm_image, front_leg_placed, front_leg_image, rear_leg_placed, rear_leg_image)


def seat(w=686, d=686, h=210):

    rail=s3d.extrude("support",s3d.rect(w=w-10,d=654,r=8),h=24)
    rail=s3d.pocket(rail,s3d.rect(w=w-42,d=622,r=8),on=rail.face("top"))
    rail=s3d.at(rail,z=-22)
    s3d.material(rail,"brushed_steel",color="#777975")
    s3d.material(pad,"leather",color="#514941",roughness=0.65)
    return s3d.group("seat_group",pad,rail)


def back(w=700, d=208, h=434):

    core=s3d.box("back_core",w=w,d=34,h=h)

    core=s3d.at(core,y=-35)

import sand3d as s3d


def sideboard():
    body = s3d.at(cabinet_body(), x=-1792, y=166.3, z=-502.8)
    legs = s3d.at(end_leg_frame(), x=-2497, y=182, z=-676.2)
    legs_image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(legs), mirror="x", x=-3584)
    support = s3d.at(intermediate_support(), x=-1872, y=172, z=-676.2)
    support_image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(support), mirror="x", x=-3584)
    braces = s3d.at(underbody_braces(), x=-2186, y=184, z=-644)
    braces_image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(braces), mirror="x", x=-3584)
    return s3d.assembly("sideboard", body, legs, legs_image, support, support_image, braces, braces_image)


def cabinet_body(w=1500, d=332, h=504, border=28, recess=13, band_z=350, band_h=15, band_depth=17):
    body = s3d.box("body", w=w, d=d, h=h)
    body = s3d.pocket(body, s3d.rect(w=w-2*border, d=h-2*border), depth=recess, on=body.face("-Y").move(y=h/2))
    body = s3d.pocket(body, s3d.rect(w=w-2*border, d=band_h), depth=recess+band_depth, on=body.face("-Y").move(y=band_z+band_h/2))
    s3d.material(body, "walnut", color="#905c37")
    return s3d.group("cabinet_body", body)


def end_leg_frame(w=50, d=230, h=180, foot=34, lean=7, rail_h=24, rail_t=20):
    a = s3d.loft("leg", s3d.station(z=0, w=foot, d=foot, n=4), s3d.station(z=h, w=w, d=w, x=-lean, n=4))
    a = s3d.at(a, y=-d/2)
    b = s3d.at(s3d.copy(a), y=d/2)
    rail = s3d.at(s3d.box("end_rail", w=rail_t, d=d, h=rail_h), x=-lean, z=h-rail_h)
    s3d.material(a, "walnut", color="#905c37")
    s3d.material(b, "walnut", color="#905c37")
    s3d.material(rail, "walnut", color="#905c37")
    return s3d.group("end_leg_frame", a, b, rail)


def intermediate_support(w=50, d=50, h=180, foot=34, lean=8):
    leg = s3d.loft("support", s3d.station(z=0, w=foot, d=foot, n=4), s3d.station(z=h, w=w, d=d, x=-lean, n=4))
    s3d.material(leg, "walnut", color="#905c37")
    return s3d.group("intermediate_support", leg)


def underbody_braces(w=628, d=230, h=41, t=20, rise=53):
    front = s3d.extrude("front_brace", s3d.poly([(-w/2,-d/2-t/2), (w/2,-t), (w/2,0), (-w/2,-d/2+t/2)]), h=h)
    rear = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("rear_brace", s3d.poly([(-w/2,d/2-t/2), (w/2,-t), (w/2,0), (-w/2,d/2+t/2)]), h=h), z=rise)
    s3d.material(front, "walnut", color="#905c37")
    s3d.material(rear, "walnut", color="#905c37")
    return s3d.group("underbody_braces", front, rear)

import sand3d as s3d


def shelving():
    base = s3d.at(base_shelf(), x=-867, y=-335, z=502)
    end = s3d.at(end_frame(), x=-1427.5, y=-335, z=502)
    twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(end), mirror="x", x=-1734)
    lower = s3d.at(lower_shelf(), x=-867, y=-335, z=896)
    top = s3d.at(top_shelf(), x=-867, y=-335, z=2234)
    return s3d.assembly("shelving", base, end, twin, lower, top)


def base_shelf(w=1155, d=475.5, h=68, t=34):
    rim = s3d.extrude("base_rim", s3d.rect(w=w, d=d), h=h)
    tool = s3d.extrude("inside", s3d.rect(w=w-2*t, d=d-2*t), h=h*2)
    rim = s3d.cut(rim, s3d.at(tool, z=-h/2))
    panel = s3d.at(s3d.box("base_panel", w=w-t, d=d-t, h=h/2), z=h/2)
    s3d.material(rim, "painted_metal", color="#232323")
    s3d.material(panel, "wood" if False else "oak", color="#5c3514")
    return s3d.group("base_shelf", rim, panel)


def end_frame(w=34, d=475.5, h=1800, rail_z=1494):
    post = s3d.at(s3d.box("post", w=w, d=w, h=h), y=-(d-w)/2)
    other = s3d.at(s3d.copy(post), y=(d-w)/2)
    rail = s3d.at(s3d.box("end_rail", w=w, d=d, h=w), z=rail_z)
    frame = s3d.join(post, other, rail)
    s3d.material(frame, "painted_metal", color="#232323")
    return s3d.group("end_frame", frame)


def lower_shelf(w=1155, d=475.5, h=34, edge=5):
    rim = s3d.extrude("shelf_edge", s3d.rect(w=w, d=d), h=h)
    tool = s3d.at(s3d.box("inside", w=w-2*edge, d=d-2*edge, h=h*2), z=-h/2)
    rim = s3d.cut(rim, tool)
    panel = s3d.box("shelf_panel", w=w-edge, d=d-edge, h=h)
    s3d.material(rim, "painted_metal", color="#232323")
    s3d.material(panel, "oak", color="#5c3514")
    return s3d.group("lower_shelf", rim, panel)


def top_shelf(w=1155, d=475.5, h=68, t=34, bar_d=30, bar_y=17, bar_z=-221):
    rim = s3d.extrude("top_rim", s3d.rect(w=w, d=d), h=h)
    tool = s3d.at(s3d.box("inside", w=w-2*t, d=d-2*t, h=h*2), z=-h/2)
    rim = s3d.cut(rim, tool)
    panel = s3d.at(s3d.box("top_panel", w=w-t, d=d-t, h=h/2), z=h/2)
    bar = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("hanging_rail", d=bar_d, h=w-t), x=-(w-t)/2, y=bar_y, z=bar_z, ry=90)
    s3d.material(rim, "painted_metal", color="#232323")
    s3d.material(panel, "oak", color="#5c3514")
    s3d.material(bar, "painted_metal", color="#232323")
    return s3d.group("top_shelf", rim, panel, bar)

import sand3d as s3d


def kitchenette():
    root = s3d.at(cabinet_root(), x=0, y=0)
    coupler = s3d.at(faucet_coupler(), x=-213.5, y=724.5, z=965)
    strainer = s3d.at(sink_strainer(), x=35.5, y=683.5, z=729)
    door = s3d.at(cooking_cabinet_door(), x=291.5, y=-206, z=56)
    lever = s3d.at(short_faucet_lever(), x=-214, y=637.5, z=961)
    knob = s3d.at(cooking_control(), x=194.5, y=-268.5, z=921)
    sinkdoor = s3d.at(sink_cabinet_door(), x=290.5, y=690.5, z=54)
    draindoor = s3d.at(drainer_cabinet_door(), x=290.5, y=242.5, z=54)
    spout = s3d.at(faucet_spout(), x=-176.5, y=577, z=932)
    knobtwo = s3d.at(auxiliary_cooking_control(), x=194.5, y=-166.5, z=921)
    s3d.joint('joint_joint_01_joint_00', coupler, s3d.local(root, x=-214, y=721, z=980), axis='+Y', range=(0,90))
    s3d.joint('joint_sinkStrainer_01_joint_00', strainer, s3d.local(root, x=35, y=684, z=730), kind='prismatic', axis='+Z', range=(0,10.6))
    s3d.joint('joint_door_01_joint_00', door, s3d.local(root, x=287, y=-384, z=53), axis='+Z', range=(-100,0))
    s3d.joint('joint_leftHandle_01_joint_00', lever, s3d.local(root, x=-214, y=650, z=980), axis='+Y', range=(0,90))
    s3d.joint('joint_knob_01_joint_00', knob, s3d.local(root, x=194, y=-259, z=921), axis='+Z', range=(0,179))
    s3d.joint('joint_door_03_joint_00', sinkdoor, s3d.local(root, x=287, y=868, z=53), axis='+Z', range=(0,102))
    s3d.joint('joint_door_02_joint_00', draindoor, s3d.local(root, x=287, y=453, z=53), axis='+Z', range=(0,100))
    s3d.joint('joint_tap_01_joint_00', spout, s3d.local(root, x=-214, y=684, z=932), axis='+Z', range=(0,140))
    s3d.joint('joint_knob_02_joint_00', knobtwo, s3d.local(root, x=194, y=-158, z=921), axis='+Z', range=(0,179))
    return s3d.assembly('kitchenette', root, coupler, strainer, door, lever, knob, sinkdoor, draindoor, spout, knobtwo)


def cabinet_root(w=600, d=1820, top=910, t=5, base=27, rail=40, rear_h=465, shelf=402, sink_y=684, sink_x=34, sink_w=370, sink_d=292, sink_bottom=768, cook_y=-208, cook_w=470, cook_d=320, bay_y=-658, bay_d=440, panel=18, appliance_x=15, appliance_w=420, appliance_h=803, drawer_z=580, box_y=-740, box_d=180, box_h=350):
    half=2
    solids=[]
    for y in (-d/half+t/half, bay_y+bay_d/half+half*t, 14, 472, d/half-t/half):
        solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.box('partition', w=w, d=t, h=top-base), y=y, z=base))
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.box('bottom', w=w, d=d, h=t), z=base+rail/half))
    feet=s3d.at(s3d.cylinder('foot',d=rail+panel,h=base+t),on=s3d.grid(nx=half,ny=5,px=w-rail-half*panel,py=bay_d))
    solids.extend(feet)
    rear=s3d.at(s3d.box('rear_lower', w=t, d=d, h=rear_h), x=-w/half+t/half, z=base)
    s3d.pocket(rear,s3d.rect(w=bay_d-panel,d=panel*6),depth=t,on=rear.face('-X').move(x=-bay_y,y=panel*3))
    solids.append(rear)
    for x in (-w/half+t/half, w/half-t/half):
        solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.box('top_rail', w=t, d=d, h=rail), x=x, z=top-rail))
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.box('shelf', w=w-half*t, d=d/half-rail, h=panel), y=d/4, z=shelf))
    work=s3d.at(s3d.box('worktop', w=w,d=d,h=rail), z=top-rail)
    s3d.pocket(work, s3d.rect(w=sink_w,d=sink_d,r=base), depth=rail, on=work.face('top').move(x=sink_x,y=sink_y))
    solids.append(work)
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.box('cooking_housing',w=cook_w-base,d=cook_d-rail,h=rail+panel+t),y=cook_y,z=top-rail-panel-t))
    bowl=s3d.loft('sink', s3d.station(z=sink_bottom,w=sink_w-base,d=sink_d-base,x=sink_x,y=sink_y,n=8),s3d.station(z=top,w=sink_w,d=sink_d,x=sink_x,y=sink_y,n=8))
    s3d.shell(bowl,t=t,open='end')
    solids.append(bowl)
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.cylinder('waste_pipe',d=rail,h=sink_bottom-drawer_z+rail),x=sink_x,y=sink_y,z=drawer_z-rail))
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.cylinder('waste_trap',d=rail*half,h=rail+panel),x=sink_x,y=sink_y,z=drawer_z-rail-panel))
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.cylinder('faucet_base',d=rail+t,h=rail+panel),x=-w/half+rail*half+t,y=sink_y,z=top-t))
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.box('upstand',w=t,d=d,h=70),x=-w/half+t/half,z=top))
    cooking=s3d.at(s3d.extrude('cooking_border',s3d.rect(w=cook_w,d=cook_d,r=t),h=t),y=cook_y,z=top)
    s3d.pocket(cooking,s3d.rect(w=cook_w-base,d=cook_d-base),depth=t/half,on=cooking.face('top'))
    solids.append(cooking)
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.tube('burner',d=rail*4,d_in=rail*4-panel,h=t),x=rail*half,y=cook_y+rail,z=top+t))
    ribs=s3d.at(s3d.extrude('drainer_rib',s3d.slot(l=w-rail*half,d=t*half),h=t),on=s3d.grid(nx=1,ny=17,py=25),y=cook_w/half,z=top)
    solids.extend(ribs)
    fridge=s3d.at(s3d.box('upright_box',w=appliance_w,d=bay_d,h=appliance_h),x=appliance_x,y=bay_y,z=base+panel)
    s3d.shell(fridge,t=t,open='+X')
    solids.append(fridge)
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.box('bay_inner_door',w=rail,d=box_d,h=box_h),x=w/half-rail*half,y=box_y,z=rail*half+base))
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.box('bay_drawer',w=rail*half,d=bay_d,h=rail),x=w/half-rail,y=bay_y,z=drawer_z))
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.box('bay_shelf',w=appliance_w,d=bay_d,h=panel),x=appliance_x,y=bay_y,z=drawer_z))
    solids.append(s3d.at(s3d.box('upper_appliance',w=box_d*half,d=box_d*half,h=rail*4),x=rail,y=bay_y,z=drawer_z+rail+panel))
    lower_z=drawer_z-box_h+rail+t*half
    lower=s3d.at(s3d.box('lower_compartment',w=appliance_w-base,d=appliance_w-base,h=drawer_z-lower_z-appliance_x),x=rail-t*half,y=bay_y,z=lower_z)

import sand3d as s3d


def bed_frame():

def support_frame(w=885, d=2259, h=72, rail_w=52, inner=41, inner_pitch=365, cross_d=46, cross_h=32, cross_pitch=1088):
    rail = s3d.at(s3d.box("side_rail", w=rail_w, d=d, h=h), x=(w-rail_w)/2)
    twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(rail), mirror="x")
    spine = s3d.at(s3d.box("inner_rail", w=inner, d=d, h=inner), x=inner_pitch/2, z=(h-inner)/2)
    spine_twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(spine), mirror="x")
    span = (w-rail_w-inner_pitch)/2
    bar = s3d.box("crossbar", w=span, d=cross_d, h=cross_h)
    bars = s3d.at(bar, on=s3d.grid(nx=2, ny=2, px=(w-rail_w+inner_pitch)/2, py=cross_pitch), z=(h-cross_h)/2)
    frame = s3d.group("support_frame", rail, twin, spine, spine_twin, bars)
    s3d.material(frame, kind="painted_metal", color="#55595b")

def end_frame(w=928.8, d=106, h=1025, pitch=833, post_w=63, post_d=69, sleeve_w=78, sleeve_d=85, sleeve_h=234, foot_w=97, foot_h=13, cap_w=70, cap_d=76, cap_h=12, beam_d=59, beam_h=55, beam_z=108, bar_d=49, bar_h=31, bar_z=342, top_z=926, brace_l=885, brace_d=38, brace_h=33, brace_z=635, brace_angle=29):

    foot = s3d.at(s3d.box("foot_plate", w=foot_w, d=d, h=foot_h), x=pitch/2)
    cap = s3d.at(s3d.box("post_cap", w=cap_w, d=cap_d, h=cap_h), x=pitch/2, z=h-cap_h)
    upright = s3d.join(post, sleeve, foot, cap)

import sand3d as s3d


def wardrobe():
    case = s3d.at(cabinet_case(), x=1198, y=259)
    return s3d.assembly("wardrobe", case)


def cabinet_case(w=2396, d=518, h=2319, t=25, skin=12):
    back = s3d.at(s3d.box("back", w, skin, h), y=(d-skin)/2)
    bottom = s3d.box("bottom", w, d, t)
    top = s3d.at(s3d.box("top", w, d, t), z=h-t)
    side = s3d.at(s3d.box("end", skin, d, h), x=-(w-skin)/2)
    twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(side), mirror="x")
    shell = s3d.join(back, bottom, top, side, twin)
    s3d.material(shell, "wood" if False else "painted_metal", color="#b9b4a8")
    partition = s3d.at(bay_partition(), x=-395, z=t)
    partition_image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(partition), mirror="x")
    panels = s3d.at(projecting_panels(), x=-770, y=-450.25, z=26)
    panels_image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(panels), mirror="x")
    shelves = s3d.at(middle_shelves(), y=8.5)
    drawers = s3d.at(drawer_stack(), x=-794.5, y=-2.5, z=34)
    drawers_image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(drawers), mirror="x")
    shelf = s3d.at(outer_shelf(), x=-794.5, z=1674)
    shelf_image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(shelf), mirror="x")
    return s3d.group("cabinet_case", shell, partition, partition_image, panels, panels_image, shelves, drawers, drawers_image, shelf, shelf_image)


def bay_partition(w=26, d=518, h=2269, skin=12, edge=51):
    panel = s3d.box("partition", skin, d, h)
    rail = s3d.at(s3d.box("edge", w, edge, h), y=-(d-edge)/2)
    rear = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(rail), mirror="y")
    panel = s3d.join(panel, rail, rear)
    s3d.material(panel, "painted_metal", color="#b9b4a8")
    return s3d.group("bay_partition", panel)


def projecting_panels(w=831, d=383.5, h=2267, t=13, lower=1648, gap=24, lean=28, outer=-396, inner=341, extra=94):
    solids = []
    for x, shift in [(outer, 0), (inner, lean), (inner+extra, -lean)]:
        profile = s3d.poly([(x-t/2, -d/2), (x+t/2, -d/2), (x+t/2+shift, d/2), (x-t/2+shift, d/2)])
        low = s3d.extrude("projecting_lower", profile, h=lower)
        high = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("projecting_upper", profile, h=h-lower-gap), z=lower+gap)
        s3d.material(low, "painted_metal", color="#b9b4a8")
        s3d.material(high, "painted_metal", color="#b9b4a8")
        solids.extend([low, high])
    return s3d.group("projecting_panels", solids)


def middle_shelves(w=774, d=485, t=9, levels=(153,875,1075,1274,1474,1988), division_z=1674, division_t=25, division_d=518):
    shelves = []
    for z in levels:
        shelf = s3d.at(s3d.box("shelf", w, d, t), z=z)
        s3d.material(shelf, "painted_metal", color="#b9b4a8")
        shelves.append(shelf)
    division = s3d.at(s3d.box("upper_division", w, division_d, division_t), y=-(division_d-d)/2, z=division_z)
    s3d.material(division, "painted_metal", color="#b9b4a8")
    return s3d.group("middle_shelves", shelves, division)


def drawer_stack(w=746, d=463, pitch=161.5, front_h=102, t=13, top_z=617, cap=16):
    parts = []
    for i in range(4):
        front = s3d.at(s3d.box("drawer_front", w, t, front_h), y=-(d-t)/2, z=i*pitch)
        base = s3d.at(s3d.box("drawer_base", w, d, t), z=i*pitch)
        rear = s3d.at(s3d.box("drawer_rear", w, t, front_h+t), y=(d-t)/2, z=i*pitch)
        drawer = s3d.join(front, base, rear)
        s3d.material(drawer, "painted_metal", color="#b9b4a8")
        parts.append(drawer)
    cover = s3d.at(s3d.box("drawer_cover", w, d, cap), z=top_z)
    s3d.material(cover, "painted_metal", color="#b9b4a8")
    parts.append(cover)
    return s3d.group("drawer_stack", parts)


def outer_shelf(w=746, d=518, h=25):
    shelf = s3d.box("upper_shelf", w, d, h)

    return s3d.group("outer_shelf", shelf)

import sand3d as s3d


def office_chair():

    e = s3d.at(pedestal(), x=4, y=-50, z=94)
    return s3d.assembly("office_chair", a, b, c, ci, e)


def seat(w=596,d=550,h=210,rear_w=426,bevel=16,front_h=116,drop=41):
    outline=s3d.poly([(-w/2,-d/2),(w/2,-d/2),(w/2-bevel,d/12),(rear_w/2,d/2),(-rear_w/2,d/2),(-w/2+bevel,d/12)])
    solid=s3d.extrude("seat",outline,h=h)
    cutter=s3d.at(s3d.extrude("sloping_top",s3d.poly([(-d/2,h),(d/2,h-drop),(d/2,h*2),(-d/2,h*2)]),h=w*2,both=True),rx=90,rz=90)
    solid=s3d.cut(solid,cutter)
    bevel_tool=s3d.at(s3d.extrude("front_bevel",s3d.poly([(-d/2-bevel,front_h),(-d/2,front_h),(-d/2+bevel,h),(-d/2+bevel,h*2),(-d/2-bevel,h*2)]),h=w*2,both=True),rx=90,rz=90)
    solid=s3d.cut(solid,bevel_tool)
    s3d.material(solid,"fabric",color="#242424")
    return s3d.group("seat_group",solid)


def backrest(w=486,d=216,h=617,top_w=279,shoulder=506,front=-106,rear=46,lean=86,top_front=-34,top_rear=88,recess_w=250,recess_bottom=100,lower=110,wing=23,recess_top=140):
    side=s3d.poly([(front,0),(front+32,lower),(front+lean,shoulder),(top_front,h),(top_rear,h),(rear,shoulder),(rear,0)])
    solid=s3d.at(s3d.extrude("back",side,h=w,both=True),rx=90,rz=90)
    silhouette=s3d.poly([(-w/2,0),(w/2,0),(w/2-16,shoulder),(top_w/2,h),(-top_w/2,h),(-w/2+16,shoulder)])
    tool=s3d.at(s3d.extrude("shoulders",silhouette,h=d*3,both=True),rx=90)
    solid=s3d.intersect(solid,tool)
    wing_profile=s3d.poly([(-w/2,front-d),(w/2,front-d),(w/2,front),(recess_w/2,front+wing),(-recess_w/2,front+wing),(-w/2,front)])

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def lamp():
    b = s3d.at(base(), x=7516, y=1490, z=1225)
    return s3d.assembly("lamp", b)


def base(d=108, h=4):
    solid = s3d.cylinder("base", d=d, h=h)
    s3d.material(solid, "painted_metal", color="#373b3d")
    stem = s3d.at(upright(), x=0, y=0, z=h/2)
    cord = s3d.at(cable(), x=-1, y=-65, z=0)
    return s3d.group("base", solid, stem, cord)


def upright(d=8, h=192):
    solid = s3d.cylinder("stem", d=d, h=h)
    s3d.material(solid, "chrome", color="#777b7d")
    arm = s3d.at(articulated_arm(), x=-2, y=58, z=273.5)
    return s3d.group("upright", solid, arm)


def articulated_arm(t=5, width=13, lower=98, upper=79, angle=26, top_angle=87, pivot_d=10, pivot_l=18, brace_d=3, connector=18):
    strap = s3d.at(s3d.box("vertical_link", w=t, d=width, h=lower), x=-4, y=-58, z=-84)
    rising = s3d.at(s3d.box("rising_link", w=t, d=width, h=lower), y=-58, z=6, rx=-angle)
    tip_y = -58 + lower*math.sin(math.radians(angle))
    tip_z = 6 + lower*math.cos(math.radians(angle))
    reach = s3d.at(s3d.box("top_link", w=t, d=width, h=upper), x=-4, y=tip_y, z=tip_z, rx=-top_angle)
    twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(reach), mirror="x")
    brace = s3d.wire("brace", path=[(pivot_l/2,-38,48),(pivot_l/2,tip_y+upper,tip_z)], d=brace_d)
    neck = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("shade_neck", d=pivot_d, h=connector), y=tip_y+upper, z=tip_z-connector)
    pivots = []
    for y,z in [(-58,-84),(-58,6),(tip_y,tip_z),(tip_y+upper,tip_z)]:
        p = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("pivot", d=pivot_d, h=pivot_l), x=-pivot_l/2, y=y, z=z, ry=90)
        s3d.material(p, "steel", color="#666a6c")
        pivots.append(p)
    for ob in [strap,rising,reach,twin,brace,neck]:
        s3d.material(ob, "painted_metal", color="#373b3d")
    head = s3d.at(shade(), x=3, y=99, z=-56)
    return s3d.group("articulated_arm", strap, rising, reach, twin, brace, neck, pivots, head)


def shade(bottom_d=133, top_d=92, length=123, tilt=20, wall=2, offset_y=11, offset_z=25):
    solid = s3d.cone("shade", d=bottom_d, d2=top_d, h=length)
    solid = s3d.shell(solid, t=wall, open="bottom")
    solid = s3d.at(solid, y=offset_y, z=offset_z, rx=tilt)
    s3d.material(solid, "painted_metal", color="#373b3d")
    return s3d.group("shade", solid)


def cable(d=3.6, stem_y=65, stem_x=1, stem_h=192, arm_y=108, arm_z=369, loop_x=19, loop_y=7, loop_h=43):
    floor = s3d.spline([(-20,-201,3),(-18,-150,4),(20,-90,2),(15,-55,3),(0,20,8),(stem_x,stem_y,30)])
    trail = s3d.wire("floor_cord", path=floor, d=d)
    hidden = s3d.wire("stem_cord", path=[(stem_x,stem_y,30),(stem_x,stem_y,stem_h)], d=d)
    lower_loop = s3d.spline([(stem_x,stem_y,stem_h-20),(loop_x,stem_y-loop_y,stem_h-10),(loop_x,stem_y-loop_y,stem_h+loop_h/2),(stem_x,stem_y,stem_h+loop_h)])
    low = s3d.wire("lower_loop", path=lower_loop, d=d)
    upper_loop = s3d.spline([(stem_x,stem_y,stem_h+loop_h),(-loop_x,stem_y+loop_y,stem_h+loop_h*1.5),(-loop_x*1.5,stem_y+loop_y*3,stem_h+loop_h*2.5),(stem_x,arm_y,arm_z-loop_h/3)])
    high = s3d.wire("upper_loop", path=upper_loop, d=d)
    crown_loop = s3d.spline([(stem_x,arm_y,arm_z-loop_h/3),(loop_x,arm_y+loop_h,arm_z-loop_h/3),(loop_x,arm_y+loop_h*1.7,arm_z),(stem_x,arm_y+loop_h*1.9,arm_z)])
    crown = s3d.wire("crown_loop", path=crown_loop, d=d)
    for ob in [trail,hidden,low,high,crown]:
        s3d.material(ob, "rubber", color="#242626")
    return s3d.group("cable", trail, hidden, low, high, crown)

def tap(w=54, d=230, h=335, pipe=27, collar=38, collar_h=12):

import sand3d as s3d

def door(radius=240, depth=28, ring_outer=214, crest=194, inner=166, base=5):
    surround = s3d.revolve("surround", s3d.poly([(inner,0),(radius,0),(radius,base),(ring_outer,base+1),(crest,depth),(crest-9,depth),(inner,base+1)]))
    disk = s3d.cylinder("recessed_disk", d=inner*2+2, h=base+1)

def console(w=584, d=220, h=148, main_h=108, end_w=82, main_d=136, slope=38, recess=4, border=12):
    profile = s3d.poly([(-d/2,0),(-d/2,main_h),(-d/2+main_d-slope,main_h),(-d/2+main_d,0)])
    panel = s3d.extrude("console_body", profile, h=w)

    end_profile = s3d.poly([(-d/2,0),(-d/2,h),(d/2-24,h),(d/2,main_h),(d/2,0)])
    end = s3d.extrude("console_end", end_profile, h=end_w)
    end = s3d.at(end, x=-w/2, rx=90, rz=90)
    panel = s3d.join(panel, end)
    face = s3d.Frame(origin=(end_w/2, -d/2+main_d-slope/2, main_h/2), normal=(0,main_h,slope), up=(0,0,1))
    inset_profile = s3d.rect(w=w-end_w-border*2, d=main_h-border*2)
    panel = s3d.pocket(panel, inset_profile, depth=recess, on=face)
    inset = s3d.extrude("control_inset", inset_profile, h=recess/2, on=face.offset(d=-recess))
    s3d.material(panel, "painted_metal", color="#c1c1c1")
    s3d.material(inset, "plastic", color="#585858")

import sand3d as s3d


def pergola():
    slab = s3d.at(ground_slab(), z=-56)
    center = s3d.at(center_support_row(), z=-1)
    outer = s3d.at(outer_support_row(), x=1101, z=-1)
    image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(outer), mirror="x")
    transverse = s3d.at(transverse_supports(), z=706)
    roof = s3d.at(canopy(), y=-4, z=988)
    return s3d.assembly("pergola", slab, center, outer, image, transverse, roof)


def ground_slab(w=2822, d=3951, h=56):
    slab = s3d.box("slab", w=w, d=d, h=h)
    s3d.material(slab, "concrete", color="#bdbcc0")
    return s3d.group("ground_slab", slab)


def center_support_row(w=56, d=3966, h=989, end=1665, inner=564, t=21, bottom=707, chord=42, pitch=277):
    posts = []
    for y in (-end, -inner, inner, end):
        posts.append(s3d.at(s3d.box("post", w=w, d=w, h=h), y=y))
    beam = s3d.at(truss(length=d, thickness=t, height=h-bottom, chord=chord, pitch=pitch), z=bottom)
    part = s3d.group("center_support_row", posts, beam)
    s3d.material(part, "painted_metal", color="#97562b")
    return part


def truss(length, thickness, height, chord, pitch):
    lower = s3d.box("lower_chord", w=thickness, d=length, h=chord)
    upper = s3d.at(s3d.box("upper_chord", w=thickness, d=length, h=chord), z=height-chord)
    profile = s3d.poly(pts=[(-pitch/2,chord-1),(-pitch/2+thickness,chord-1),(pitch/2,height-chord+1),(pitch/2-thickness,height-chord+1)])
    diagonal = s3d.extrude("diagonal", profile, h=thickness, both=True)
    diagonals = s3d.at(diagonal, on=s3d.grid(nx=14, px=pitch))
    diagonals = [s3d.transform(item, rx=90, rz=90) for item in diagonals]
    verticals = s3d.at(s3d.box("web_upright", w=thickness, d=thickness, h=height), on=s3d.grid(nx=1, ny=15, py=pitch))
    return s3d.join(lower, upper, diagonals, verticals)


def outer_support_row(w=56, d=3966, h=989, end=1665, inner=564, t=21, bottom=707, chord=42, pitch=277):
    posts = []
    for y in (-end, -inner, inner, end):
        posts.append(s3d.at(s3d.box("post", w=w, d=w, h=h), y=y))
    beam = s3d.at(truss(length=d, thickness=t, height=h-bottom, chord=chord, pitch=pitch), z=bottom)
    part = s3d.group("outer_support_row", posts, beam)
    s3d.material(part, "painted_metal", color="#97562b")
    return part


def transverse_supports(w=2822, end=1665, h=282, t=21, chord=42, pitch=277):
    beam = truss_cross(length=w, thickness=t, height=h, chord=chord, pitch=pitch)
    beams = s3d.at(beam, on=s3d.grid(nx=1, ny=2, py=end*2))
    part = s3d.group("transverse_supports", beams)
    s3d.material(part, "painted_metal", color="#97562b")
    return part


def truss_cross(length, thickness, height, chord, pitch):
    lower = s3d.box("cross_lower", w=length, d=thickness, h=chord)
    upper = s3d.at(s3d.box("cross_upper", w=length, d=thickness, h=chord), z=height-chord)
    profile = s3d.poly(pts=[(-pitch/2,chord-1),(-pitch/2+thickness,chord-1),(pitch/2,height-chord+1),(pitch/2-thickness,height-chord+1)])
    diagonal = s3d.extrude("cross_diagonal", profile, h=thickness, both=True)
    diagonals = s3d.at(diagonal, on=s3d.grid(nx=10, px=pitch))
    diagonals = [s3d.transform(item, rx=90) for item in diagonals]
    uprights = s3d.at(s3d.box("cross_upright", w=thickness, d=thickness, h=height), on=s3d.grid(nx=11, px=pitch))
    return s3d.join(lower, upper, diagonals, uprights)


def canopy(w=2836, d=3986, h=141, edge=28, slat=14, slat_h=56, pitch=140.85):
    rail = s3d.at(s3d.box("edge_rail", w=edge, d=d, h=h), x=(w-edge)/2)
    image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(rail), mirror="x")
    ends = s3d.at(s3d.box("end_rail", w=w, d=edge, h=h), on=s3d.grid(nx=1, ny=2, py=d-edge))
    bars = s3d.at(s3d.box("roof_bar", w=w-edge, d=slat, h=slat_h), on=s3d.grid(nx=1, ny=27, py=pitch))
    part = s3d.group("canopy", rail, image, ends, bars)
    s3d.material(part, "painted_metal", color="#97562b")
    return part

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def well():
    base = s3d.at(stone_well(), y=-6)
    post = s3d.at(support_post(), x=-770, y=130)
    twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(post), mirror="x")
    cover = s3d.at(roof(), x=-7, y=157, z=1490)
    shaft = s3d.at(winding_shaft(), y=120, z=582)
    return s3d.assembly("well", base, post, twin, cover, shaft)


def stone_well(outer=((-741,-99),(-545,-559),(-12,-759),(477,-581),(743,-137),(665,334),(271,690),(-220,710),(-633,420)), inner=((-535,-124),(-358,-431),(19,-549),(356,-420),(539,-89),(469,282),(176,523),(-122,520),(-485,277)), h=694, floor=330, rim_h=220, expansion=45):
    outline = s3d.poly(outer)
    base = s3d.extrude("stone wall",outline,h=h-rim_h)
    rim = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("raised rim",s3d.offset(outline,t=expansion),h=rim_h+1,taper=10),z=h-rim_h-1)
    base = s3d.join(base,rim)
    tool = s3d.extrude("opening",s3d.poly(inner),h=h+1)
    base = s3d.cut(base,tool)
    s3d.material(base,"concrete",color="#959b96")
    water = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("recess",s3d.poly(inner),h=1),z=floor)
    s3d.material(water,"concrete",color="#8aa481")
    return s3d.group("stone_well",base,water)


def support_post(w=165,d=360,h=1580,top_w=140,top_d=350,lean=14,turn=-8.5):
    post=s3d.loft("upright",s3d.station(z=0,w=w,d=d,n=40),s3d.station(z=h/2,w=w,d=d,x=-lean,n=40),s3d.station(z=h,w=top_w,d=top_d,x=lean,n=40))
    post=s3d.at(post,rz=turn)
    s3d.material(post,"walnut",color="#796763")
    return s3d.group("support_post",post)


def roof(w=1890, front=-859, back=854, ridge_front=-117, ridge_back=-2, rise=732, thickness=48, sag=20):
    profile = s3d.poly([(front+29,49),(ridge_front,638),(ridge_back-5,640),(back-27,19),(back,57),(ridge_back+16,rise-thickness),(ridge_back,rise),(ridge_front,rise),(ridge_front-16,rise-thickness),(front,86)])
    solid = s3d.extrude("roof slabs", profile, h=w, on=s3d.Frame(origin=(-w/2,0,-sag),normal=(1,0,0),up=(0,0,1)))
    s3d.material(solid,"walnut",color="#796763")
    gable_frame_placed = s3d.at(gable_frame(), x=-903, y=-27, z=-146)
    gable_frame_image = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(gable_frame_placed), mirror="x", x=14)
    return s3d.group("roof", solid, gable_frame_placed, gable_frame_image)


def gable_frame(w=65, d=2037, h=1088, tie_h=200, tie_z=32, rafter_t=150, near_y=-960, near_z=82, far_y=923, far_z=157, tip_y=250, tip_z=1016):
    tie = s3d.at(s3d.box("tie beam",w=50,d=d,h=tie_h),x=8,z=tie_z,rx=2.5,rz=-1.5)
    first = timber(w=w,t=rafter_t,y1=near_y,z1=near_z,y2=tip_y,z2=tip_z)
    second = timber(w=w,t=rafter_t,y1=far_y,z1=far_z,y2=-320,z2=tip_z)
    frame = s3d.join(tie,first,second)
    s3d.material(frame,"walnut",color="#5a4c40")
    return s3d.group("gable_frame",frame)


def timber(w,t,y1,z1,y2,z2):
    length = math.hypot(y2-y1,z2-z1)
    beam = s3d.box("rafter",w=w,d=t,h=length)
    return s3d.at(beam,y=y1,z=z1,rx=-math.degrees(math.atan2(y2-y1,z2-z1)))


def winding_shaft(w=1750, diameter=334, axis_z=652, rope_d=18, rope_h=370, bucket_h=280, bucket_d=170, bucket_t=12, rope_y=-100, bucket_y=-120, bucket_z=-12):
    half_flat=diameter*math.sqrt(3)/4
    # Regular hexagon with the two points on the Y axis.
    profile=s3d.poly([(0,-diameter/2),(half_flat,-diameter/4),(half_flat,diameter/4),(0,diameter/2),(-half_flat,diameter/4),(-half_flat,-diameter/4)])
    solid=s3d.extrude("drum",profile,h=w)
    solid=s3d.at(solid,x=-w/2,z=axis_z,ry=90)
    s3d.material(solid,"walnut",color="#48484c")
    rope=s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("rope",d=rope_d,h=rope_h),y=rope_y,z=axis_z-rope_h)
    s3d.material(rope,"fabric",color="#69666f")
    bucket=s3d.extrude("bucket",s3d.polygon(n=5,d=bucket_d),h=bucket_h,taper=-12)
    bucket=s3d.shell(bucket,t=bucket_t,open="top")
    bucket=s3d.at(bucket,y=bucket_y,z=bucket_z)
    s3d.material(bucket,"walnut",color="#69666f")
    crank_placed=s3d.at(crank(),x=1190,y=50,z=253)
    return s3d.group("winding_shaft",solid,rope,bucket,crank_placed)


def crank(outline=((-343,381),(-212,366),(-168,55),(-122,4),(313,29),(306,84),(-86,52),(-124,81),(-173,410),(-223,432),(-343,420)),depth=60):
    # Measured side outline of the bent crank, in its X-Z plane.
    profile=s3d.poly(outline)
    solid=s3d.extrude("crank",profile,h=depth,on=s3d.Frame(origin=(0,depth/2,0),normal=(0,-1,0),up=(0,0,1)))
    s3d.material(solid,"walnut",color="#48484c")
    return s3d.group("crank",solid)

import sand3d as s3d


def wheelbarrow():
    a=s3d.at(tray(), x=-34.5, y=-134, z=168)
    b=s3d.at(handle_frame(), x=-196, y=-264, z=82)
    c=s3d.transform(s3d.copy(b), mirror="x", x=-69)
    d=s3d.at(support_loop(), x=-215, y=-439, z=-11)
    e=s3d.transform(s3d.copy(d), mirror="x", x=-69)
    f=s3d.at(wheel(), x=-24, y=273, z=-17)
    return s3d.assembly("wheelbarrow",a,b,c,d,e,f)


def tray(w=600, d=854, h=259, bottom_w=440, bottom_d=600, t=25, floor=50, tilt=-5, rim_shift=-24):
    outer=s3d.loft("tray",s3d.station(z=-16,w=bottom_w,d=bottom_d,y=-110,n=100),s3d.station(z=h,w=w,d=d,y=rim_shift,n=100))
    trim=s3d.extrude("underside",s3d.poly([(-500,-100),(250,-100),(250,-26),(-500,49)]),h=w*2,both=True,on=s3d.Frame(normal=(1,0,0),up=(0,0,1)))
    outer=s3d.cut(outer,trim)
    inner=s3d.loft("inside",s3d.station(z=floor,w=bottom_w-t*3,d=bottom_d-5,y=-120,n=100),s3d.station(z=h+t,w=w-t*2-10,d=d-t,y=rim_shift+20,n=100))
    outer=s3d.cut(outer,inner)
    lip=s3d.extrude("lip",s3d.rect(w,d),h=8)
    lip=s3d.pocket(lip,s3d.rect(w-t*3,d-t))
    lip=s3d.at(lip,y=rim_shift,z=h-8)
    outer=s3d.join(outer,lip)
    outer=s3d.transform(outer,rx=tilt,z=36)
    s3d.material(outer,"painted_metal",color="#f2a73d")
    return s3d.group("tray",outer)


def handle_frame(w=190,d=1399,h=280,stock_w=33,stock_h=26):
    path=[(-79,-d/2,h-stock_h/2),(-22,-300,185),(30,210,100),(95,d/2,13)]
    rail=s3d.sweep("rail",s3d.rect(stock_w,stock_h),path=path)
    s3d.material(rail,"painted_metal",color="#161616")
    return s3d.group("handle_frame",rail)


def support_loop(w=54,d=240,h=282,stock=28):
    path=[(-12,-d/2,h-stock/2),(-10,-85,90),(0,-45,30),(0,0,14),(4,45,38),(10,85,180),(12,d/2,h-stock/2)]
    loop=s3d.wire("support",path=path,d=stock)
    s3d.material(loop,"painted_metal",color="#161616")
    return s3d.group("support_loop",loop)


def wheel(w=91,d=264,h=264,tire=42,hub=38):
    tire_ob=s3d.tube("tire",d=d,d_in=d-tire*2,h=w)
    tire_ob=s3d.at(tire_ob,ry=90,x=-w/2,z=h/2)
    hub_ob=s3d.cylinder("hub",d=hub,h=w)
    hub_ob=s3d.at(hub_ob,ry=90,x=-w/2,z=h/2)
    wheel_ob=s3d.join(tire_ob,hub_ob)
    s3d.material(wheel_ob,"rubber",color="#161616")
    return s3d.group("wheel",wheel_ob)

import sand3d as s3d


def grill():
    trough = s3d.at(cooking_trough(), x=100, y=-47, z=479)
    lid = s3d.at(raised_lid(), x=104, y=117, z=620)
    grate = s3d.at(cooking_grate(), x=100, y=-47, z=613)
    frame = s3d.at(leg_frame(), x=100, y=-47, z=1, rz=-1)
    return s3d.assembly('grill', trough, lid, grate, frame)


def cooking_trough(w=564, d=284, h=142, t=6, rim=12):
    profile = s3d.poly([(-d/2,h), s3d.arc(center=(0,h), r=d/2, start=180, end=360)])
    outer = s3d.extrude('trough', profile, h=w)
    inside = s3d.poly([(-(d/2-t),h), s3d.arc(center=(0,h), r=d/2-t, start=180, end=360)])
    tool = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('interior', inside, h=w-2*t), z=t)
    outer = s3d.cut(outer, tool)
    outer = s3d.at(outer, x=-w/2, rx=90, rz=90)
    rails = s3d.at(s3d.box('rim', w, rim, t), on=s3d.grid(nx=1, ny=2, py=d), z=h-t)
    s3d.material(outer, 'painted_metal', color='#565656')
    s3d.material(rails, 'painted_metal', color='#565656')
    return s3d.group('cooking_trough', outer, rails)


def raised_lid(w=560, h=282, t=6, angle=9):
    p = s3d.poly([s3d.arc(center=(0,h/2), r=h/2, start=-90-angle, end=90-angle)])
    solid = s3d.extrude('lid', p, h=w)
    tool = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder('lid_inside', d=h-2*t, h=w-2*t), y=h/2, z=t)
    solid = s3d.cut(solid, tool)
    solid = s3d.at(solid, x=-w/2, rx=90, rz=90)
    s3d.material(solid, 'painted_metal', color='#565656')
    return s3d.group('raised_lid', solid)


def cooking_grate(w=544, d=286, bar=9, pitch=23, n=23, h=8):
    bars = s3d.at(s3d.box('grate_bar', bar, d, h), on=s3d.grid(nx=n, px=pitch))
    s3d.material(bars, 'steel', color='#8d8d8d')
    return s3d.group('cooking_grate', bars)


def leg_frame(w=604, d=266, h=574, tube=22, bend=30):
    path = [ (0,-(d-tube)/2,0), (0,-(d-tube)/2,h-bend), (0,-(d-tube)/2+bend,h), (0,(d-tube)/2-bend,h), (0,(d-tube)/2,h-bend), (0,(d-tube)/2,0)]
    legs = s3d.at(s3d.wire('bent_legs', path, d=tube, fillet=bend), on=s3d.grid(nx=2, px=w-tube))
    s3d.material(legs, 'painted_metal', color='#565656')
    shelf = s3d.at(lower_shelf(), z=125)
    ledge = s3d.at(projecting_ledge(), x=-403, y=5, z=444)
    return s3d.group('leg_frame', legs, shelf, ledge)

import sand3d as s3d


def library_card_catalog():
    carcass = carcass_part()
    drawers = []
    cw = (1080 - 2 * 22 - 3 * 12) / 4
    ch = (1500 - 2 * 24 - 11 * 12) / 12
    for row in range(12):
        for col in range(4):
            drawer = drawer_part()
            x = -540 + 22 + col * (cw + 12) + cw / 2
            z = 60 + 24 + row * (ch + 12) + ch / 2
            f = s3d.local(carcass, x, 230, z)
            drawer = s3d.at(drawer, on=f)
            s3d.joint(
                f"drawer_r{row + 1}_c{col + 1}_slide",
                drawer,
                f,
                kind="prismatic",
                axis="+Y",
                range=(0, 180),
            )
            drawers.append(drawer)
    return s3d.assembly("library_card_catalog", carcass, *drawers)


def carcass_part():
    W = 1080
    D = 460
    P = 60
    H = 1500
    S = 22
    T = 24
    DV = 12
    SH = 12
    B = 10
    CW = W - 2 * S
    CH = H - 2 * T
    ID = D - B
    cellw = (CW - 3 * DV) / 4
    cellh = (CH - 11 * SH) / 12
    items = []

    def box(name, size, x, y, z, color="#4f331f", kind="walnut"):
        obj = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(size[0], size[1]), size[2], both=True)
        obj = s3d.at(obj, x=x, y=y, z=z)
        return s3d.material(obj, kind, color=color)

    items.append(box("plinth", (1000, 400, P), 0, -30, 30, "#422b1a"))
    items.append(box("left_side", (S, D, H), -W / 2 + S / 2, 0, P + H / 2))
    items.append(box("right_side", (S, D, H), W / 2 - S / 2, 0, P + H / 2))
    items.append(box("bottom_panel", (CW, ID, T), 0, B / 2, P + T / 2))
    items.append(box("top_panel", (CW, ID, T), 0, B / 2, P + H - T / 2))
    items.append(box("back_panel", (CW, B, CH), 0, -D / 2 + B / 2, P + H / 2))
    items.append(box("top_cap", (1100, 480, 18), 0, 0, P + H + 9))
    for i in range(3):
        x = -W / 2 + S + (i + 1) * cellw + i * DV + DV / 2
        items.append(box(f"divider_{i + 1}", (DV, ID, CH), x, B / 2, P + H / 2))
    for i in range(11):
        z = P + T + (i + 1) * cellh + i * SH + SH / 2
        items.append(box(f"shelf_{i + 1}", (CW, ID, SH), 0, B / 2, z))
    xo = cellw / 2 - 9
    for r in range(12):
        zmin = P + T + r * (cellh + SH)
        for c in range(4):
            cx = -W / 2 + S + c * (cellw + DV) + cellw / 2
            for side, sgn in [("left", -1), ("right", 1)]:
                items.append(
                    box(
                        f"rail_r{r + 1}_c{c + 1}_{side}",
                        (18, 380, 8),
                        cx + sgn * xo,
                        30,
                        zmin + 4,
                        "#805c3b",
                    )
                )
    return s3d.group("carcass", *items)


def drawer_part():
    items = []

    def box(name, size, x, y, z, kind="walnut", color="#6e482b"):
        obj = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(size[0], size[1]), size[2], both=True)
        obj = s3d.at(obj, x=x, y=y, z=z)
        return s3d.material(obj, kind, color=color)

    frontt = 14
    bw = 242
    bd = 400
    st = 8
    bt = 8
    sh = 86
    cellh = (1500 - 48 - 11 * 12) / 12
    bottomz = -cellh / 2 + 8 + bt / 2
    sidez = -cellh / 2 + 8 + sh / 2
    items.append(box("front_panel", (244, frontt, 104), 0, frontt / 2, 0))
    items.append(box("drawer_bottom", (bw, bd, bt), 0, -bd / 2, bottomz))
    items.append(box("left_side", (st, bd, sh), -bw / 2 + st / 2, -bd / 2, sidez))
    items.append(box("right_side", (st, bd, sh), bw / 2 - st / 2, -bd / 2, sidez))
    items.append(box("drawer_back", (bw, 8, sh), 0, -bd + 4, sidez))
    items.append(box("label_frame", (92, 4, 28), 0, 16, 20, "brass", "#c29e4d"))
    knob = s3d.extrude("pull_knob", s3d.circle(26), 20, both=True)
    knob = s3d.at(knob, x=0, y=24, z=-14, rx=-90)
    items.append(s3d.material(knob, "brass", color="#c29e4d"))
    return s3d.group("drawer", *items)

import sand3d as s3d

def stacked_dryer_unit():

def cabinet_part():
    w, d, h, t, seam, low = 680, 720, 1830, 20, 25, 820

    return s3d.group("cabinet", *objs)


def drum_part():
    # lathe cross section in radius/axial coordinates
    shell = s3d.revolve(

import sand3d as s3d


def contemporary_metal_ceiling_fan():
    canopy = canopy_part()
    downrod = downrod_part()
    f1 = s3d.local(canopy, 0, 0, 0, 0, 162, 0)
    downrod = s3d.at(downrod, on=f1)
    f2 = s3d.local(downrod, 0, 0, 680, 0, 0, 0)
    motor = s3d.at(motor_housing(), on=f2)
    f3 = s3d.local(motor, 0, 0, 160, 0, 0, 0)
    rotor = s3d.at(blade_assembly(), on=f3)
    s3d.joint("motor_to_blade_assembly", rotor, f3, kind="continuous", axis="normal")
    return s3d.assembly(
        "contemporary_metal_ceiling_fan", s3d.group("fixed_fan", canopy, downrod, motor), rotor
    )


def canopy_part():
    cup = s3d.revolve("canopy_cup", [(75, -6), (175, 30), (190, 95), (145, 155), (45, 190)])
    plate = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("ceiling_plate", s3d.circle(400), 12, both=True), z=196)
    ring = s3d.at(s3d.torus("socket_ring", 130, 20), z=-10)
    pad = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("socket_pad", s3d.rect(31, 30), 30, both=True), x=67)
    for ob, kind, color in [
        (cup, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),
        (plate, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),

        (pad, "steel", "#141616"),

        s3d.material(ob, kind, color=color)

def downrod_part():
    ball = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("swivel_ball", 104), z=-52)
    rod = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("rod_tube", s3d.circle(42), 470, both=True), z=265)

    lower = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("lower_collar", s3d.circle(80), 55, both=True), z=507.5)
    for ob, kind, color in [
        (ball, "plastic", "#4d4f4f"),
        (rod, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),
        (upper, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),
        (lower, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),
    ]:
        s3d.material(ob, kind, color=color)
    return s3d.group("downrod", ball, rod, upper, lower)


def motor_housing():
    shell = s3d.revolve(
        "motor_shell",
        [
            (0, -105),
            (70, -105),
            (125, -93),
            (166, -62),
            (181, -23),
            (181, 23),
            (166, 62),
            (125, 93),
            (70, 105),

    top = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("top_collar", s3d.circle(104), 40, both=True), z=-125)

        (band, "plastic", "#4d4f4f"),

def blade_assembly():
    hub = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("rotor_hub", s3d.circle(244), 46, both=True), z=-23)
    dome = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("spinner_dome", 176), z=-68)
    s3d.material(hub, "plastic", color="#4d4f4f")
    s3d.material(dome, "brushed_steel", color="#9ea3a1")
    blades = []
    # Swept planform samples approximate the source's centerline and chord across radius.
    outline = [
        (105, -59),
        (170, -49),
        (250, -43),
        (340, -34),
        (430, -17),
        (530, 8),
        (640, 60),
        (750, 156),
        (795, 213),

        (640, 257),
        (530, 142),
        (430, 105),
        (340, 76),

        (170, 67),
        (105, 59),
    ]
    for i in range(4):
        blade = s3d.at(s3d.extrude(f"blade_{i}", s3d.poly(outline), 8, both=True), rz=i * 90, z=14)
        s3d.material(blade, "aluminium", color="#bdc2bf")

def low_horizontal_axis_wind_turbine():

    )
    return s3d.assembly("low_horizontal_axis_wind_turbine", tower, nacelle, rotor)


def tower_part():
    p = [
        s3d.material(
            s3d.at(s3d.extrude("wide_base", s3d.rect(950, 650), 40, both=True), z=20),
            "rubber",
            color="#060606",

        s3d.material(
            s3d.at(s3d.extrude("short_mast", s3d.circle(110), 360, both=True), z=220),

            color="#2e3338",

        s3d.material(
            s3d.at(s3d.extrude("yaw_lower_bearing", s3d.circle(216), 20, both=True), z=410),
            "steel",
            color="#8c9194",
        ),
    ]
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(((350, 220), (350, -220), (-350, 220), (-350, -220))):
        length = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + 290 * 290)

                s3d.at(
                    s3d.extrude("brace_%d" % i, s3d.circle(28), length, both=True),
                    x=x / 2,
                    y=y / 2,
                    z=190,
                    ry=pitch,
                    rz=yaw,
                ),
                "painted_metal",
                color="#2e3338",
            )
        )
    return s3d.group("tower", *p)


def nacelle_part():
    profile = [
        (0, -215),
        (45, -210),
        (65, -195),
        (75, -170),
        (75, 170),
        (65, 195),
        (45, 210),
        (0, 215),
    ]
    body = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.revolve("nacelle_body", profile), x=40, z=85, ry=90),
        "painted_metal",
        color="#e0e6e0",
    )
    p = [
        body,
        s3d.material(
            s3d.at(
                s3d.extrude("bearing_collar", s3d.circle(120), 60, both=True), x=285, z=85, ry=90
            ),
            "steel",
            color="#8c9194",
        ),
        s3d.material(
            s3d.at(s3d.extrude("yaw_upper_bearing", s3d.circle(204), 35, both=True), z=17.5),
            "steel",
            color="#8c9194",
        ),
        s3d.material(
            s3d.at(s3d.extrude("tail_boom", s3d.circle(24), 340, both=True), x=-340, z=85, ry=90),
            "painted_metal",
            color="#2e3338",
        ),
        s3d.material(
            s3d.at(s3d.extrude("tail_vane", s3d.rect(70, 8), 170, both=True), x=-515, z=120),
            "painted_metal",
            color="#f2b823",
        ),
    ]
    return s3d.group("nacelle", *p)


def rotor_part():
    hub = s3d.extrude("hub_tool", s3d.circle(110), 34, both=True)
    blade = s3d.extrude(
        "blade_tool",
        s3d.poly([(40, -30), (75, -30), (260, -10), (260, 10), (75, 30), (40, 30)]),
        12,
        both=True,
    )
    blades = [s3d.transform(s3d.copy(blade), rz=angle) for angle in (0, 120, 240)]
    rotor = s3d.material(s3d.at(s3d.join(hub, *blades), ry=90), "plastic", color="#f0f2eb")
    shaft = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("shaft", s3d.circle(48), 100, both=True), x=-30, ry=90),
        "painted_metal",
        color="#2e3338",
    )
    return s3d.group("rotor", rotor, shaft)

import sand3d as s3d
import random


def toy_angular_orange_tree(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    roots = root_flare(seed=seed + 1)
    trunk = tapered_trunk(seed=seed + 2)
    crown = s3d.at(branch_network(seed=seed + 3), on=trunk.fork)
    return s3d.assembly('toy_angular_orange_tree', roots, trunk, crown)


def root_flare(seed=1, radius=900, shoulder=300, count=6):
    core = s3d.loft('root_collar', s3d.station(0, shoulder*2, shoulder*2), s3d.station(shoulder, shoulder*1.6, shoulder*1.6), s3d.station(shoulder*1.7, shoulder*1.4, shoulder*1.4))
    s3d.material(core, 'bark', color='#79502e', roughness=1)
    sites = s3d.ring(count, 0, start=12).jitter(rz=11, seed=seed)
    lengths = s3d.vary(radius, radius*.18, count, seed=seed+1)
    roots = [s3d.at(angular_root(length=lengths[i], h=shoulder, seed=seed+20+i), on=f) for i,f in enumerate(sites)]
    return s3d.group('root_flare', core, roots)


def angular_root(length=900, h=300, seed=1):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    width = h * rng.uniform(.8, 1.1)
    points = [(0,-width/2,0),(0,width/2,0),(0,0,h), (length*.55,-width*.33,0),(length*.55,width*.33,0),(length*.5,0,h*.38),(length,-width*.1,0),(length,width*.1,0),(length,0,h*.07)]
    root = s3d.hull('tapered_exposed_root', points)
    s3d.material(root, 'bark', color='#79502e', roughness=1)
    return root


def tapered_trunk(seed=2, h=2200, base=590, neck=330, lean=90):
    trunk = s3d.loft('stout_tapered_trunk', s3d.station(0,base,base*.92,n=2), s3d.station(h*.18,base*.85,base*.8,x=-lean*.3,n=2), s3d.station(h*.65,base*.66,base*.64,x=lean*.2,n=2), s3d.station(h,neck,neck,x=lean,n=2))
    s3d.material(trunk, 'bark', color='#815330', roughness=1)
    return s3d.assembly('tapered_trunk', trunk, fork=s3d.Frame((lean,0,h)))


def branch_network(seed=3, count=7, reach=1520, rise=1030, leader_h=2070):
    sites = s3d.ring(count,0,start=9).jitter(rz=9,seed=seed)
    lengths = s3d.vary(reach,250,count,seed=seed+1)
    heights = s3d.vary(rise,220,count,seed=seed+2)
    arms = [s3d.at(crown_arm(length=lengths[i], rise=heights[i], seed=seed+100+i), on=f) for i,f in enumerate(sites)]
    path = [(0,0,0),(-90,60,leader_h*.4),(-180,80,leader_h)]
    leader = s3d.wire('central_leader',path,[(0,290),(.5,190),(1,65)])
    s3d.material(leader,'bark',color='#815330',roughness=1)
    tip = s3d.along(path,count=2)[-1].origin
    top = s3d.at(foliage_clusters(seed=seed+20,w=1730,d=1670,h=1590,color='#3f8c36'),on=s3d.Frame((tip.x,tip.y,tip.z-350)))
    return s3d.group('branch_network',leader,arms,top)


def crown_arm(length=1520, rise=1030, seed=100, foliage_w=1520, foliage_d=1420, foliage_h=1470):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    main_path = [(0,0,0),(length*.28,0,rise*.4),(length*.66,length*.04,rise*.72),(length,length*.1,rise)]
    main = s3d.wire('spreading_main_limb',main_path,[(0,275),(.28,225),(.68,140),(1,65)])
    s3d.material(main,'bark',color='#815330',roughness=1)
    tip = s3d.along(main_path,count=2)[-1].origin
    palette = ['#398337','#438d36','#2e7735','#4b943b']
    lower = s3d.at(foliage_clusters(seed=seed+1,w=foliage_w,d=foliage_d,h=foliage_h,color=palette[rng.randrange(len(palette))]),on=s3d.Frame((tip.x,tip.y,tip.z-380)))
    upper_start = s3d.along(main_path,count=2,span=(.5,.8))[0].origin
    upper_end = (length*.58,length*.16,rise+650)
    upper_path = [tuple(upper_start),(length*.55,length*.11,rise+240),upper_end]
    upper_branch = s3d.wire('ascending_secondary_branch',upper_path,[(0,155),(1,45)])
    s3d.material(upper_branch,'bark',color='#815330',roughness=1)
    upper = s3d.at(foliage_clusters(seed=seed+2,w=foliage_w*.94,d=foliage_d*.93,h=foliage_h*.98,color=palette[rng.randrange(len(palette))]),on=s3d.Frame((upper_end[0],upper_end[1],upper_end[2]-180)))
    starts = s3d.along(main_path,count=4,span=(.55,.96))
    fruit_sites = s3d.ring(4,foliage_w*.46,start=28,on=s3d.Frame((tip.x,tip.y,rise+410))).jitter(z=130,rz=12,seed=seed+3)
    fruits=[]
    twigs=[]
    sizes=s3d.vary(290,42,len(fruit_sites),seed=seed+4)
    for i,(source,site) in enumerate(zip(starts,fruit_sites)):
        p=source.origin
        q=site.origin
        twig=s3d.wire('fruit_bearing_twig', [tuple(p),((p.x+q.x)/2,(p.y+q.y)/2,q.z-70),tuple(q)], [(0,64),(1,20)])
        s3d.material(twig,'bark',color='#79502e',roughness=1)
        twigs.append(twig)
        fruits.append(s3d.at(hanging_oranges(seed=seed+30+i,d=sizes[i]),on=s3d.Frame(tuple(q))))
    return s3d.group('fruiting_crown_arm',main,upper_branch,lower,upper,twigs,fruits)


def foliage_clusters(seed=1,w=1500,d=1400,h=1500,color='#398337'):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    points=[]
    tiers=[(.08,.45,0),(.30,.93,45),(.66,1,0),(.90,.62,45)]
    for z,scale,turn in tiers:
        frames=s3d.ring(4,1,start=turn)
        for frame in frames:
            p=frame.origin
            j=rng.uniform(.92,1.08)
            points.append((p.x*w*.5*scale*j,p.y*d*.5*scale*j,h*z+rng.uniform(-h*.025,h*.025)))
    points.extend([(w*.04,-d*.03,0),(-w*.05,d*.03,h)])
    leaves=s3d.hull('chunky_angular_foliage',points)
    s3d.material(leaves,'leaf',color=color,roughness=.9)
    return leaves


def hanging_oranges(seed=1,d=290,stem=100):
    fruit=faceted_fruit(seed=seed,d=d)
    fruit=s3d.at(fruit,z=-stem-d)
    stem_and_cap=fruit_stems(seed=seed+1,d=d,stem=stem)
    return s3d.group('hanging_orange',fruit,stem_and_cap)


def faceted_fruit(seed=1,d=290):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    fruit=s3d.loft('faceted_orange',s3d.station(0,d*.24,d*.24),s3d.station(d*.18,d*.85,d*.85),s3d.station(d*.52,d,d),s3d.station(d*.83,d*.83,d*.83),s3d.station(d,d*.24,d*.24))
    s3d.material(fruit,'plastic',color=rng.choice(['#ff8b0e','#f77d08','#ff9815']),roughness=.92)
    return fruit


def fruit_stems(seed=1,d=290,stem=100):
    stalk=s3d.wire('short_fruit_stem',[(0,0,0),(0,0,-stem)],d=19)
    s3d.material(stalk,'bark',color='#6e4c29',roughness=1)
    cap=s3d.at(s3d.cone('green_calyx',d*.24,d*.06,d2=d*.07),z=-stem-d*.035)
    s3d.material(cap,'leaf',color='#285f2b',roughness=1)
    return s3d.group('fruit_stems',stalk,cap)

import sand3d as s3d
import random
import numpy as np


def toy_low_poly_elm_vignette(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    ground = bare_soil_patch(seed=seed + 1)
    trunk = s3d.at(elm_trunk(seed=seed + 2), on=ground.tree_base)
    roots = s3d.at(root_flares(seed=seed + 3), on=trunk.root_origin)
    crown = s3d.at(rising_scaffold_branches(seed=seed + 4), on=trunk.fork)
    return s3d.assembly('toy_low_poly_elm_vignette', ground, trunk, roots, crown)


def bare_soil_patch(seed, width=6700, depth=6000, height=280, corners=11, uneven=260):
    edge = s3d.ring(corners, width / 2).jitter(x=uneven, y=uneven, seed=seed)
    points = []
    for f in edge:
        x, y = f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width
        points.extend([(x * .94, y * .94, 0), (x, y, height * .63)])
    points.append((0, 0, height))
    soil = s3d.hull('irregular_bare_earth', points)
    def earth_color(x, y, z):
        v = s3d.noise(x / (width / 2), y / (depth / 2), z / height, seed=seed + 1)
        return np.stack((.43 + .045 * v, .30 + .035 * v, .19 + .025 * v), axis=-1)
    s3d.material(soil, 'soil', color=earth_color, roughness=1)
    return s3d.assembly('bare_soil_patch', soil, tree_base=s3d.Frame((0, 0, height)))


def elm_trunk(seed, height=3400, base_d=1100, fork_d=620, lean=120):
    path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (-lean / 2, 0, height * .3), (lean / 3, lean / 2, height * .68), (lean, lean / 2, height)])
    wood = s3d.wire('stout_angular_trunk', path, d=[(0, base_d), (.3, base_d * .8), (1, fork_d)])
    s3d.material(wood, 'bark', color='#735034', roughness=1)
    ridges = angular_bark_ridges(path, base_d=base_d, seed=seed + 1)
    end = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1].origin
    return s3d.assembly('elm_trunk', wood, ridges, root_origin=s3d.Frame((0, 0, 0)), fork=s3d.Frame(tuple(end)))


def angular_bark_ridges(path, seed, base_d=1100, count=4, ridge_d=90):
    stations = s3d.along(path, count=5, span=(.04, .9))
    sites = s3d.ring(count, base_d * .35, start=45)
    colors = ['#8a6240', '#4e3828']
    ribs = []
    for k, site in enumerate(sites):
        pts = []
        for j, f in enumerate(stations):
            shrink = 1 - .34 * j / (len(stations) - 1)
            pts.append(tuple(f.point(x=site.origin.x * shrink, y=site.origin.y * shrink)))
        rib = s3d.wire('broad_bark_ridge', pts, d=[(0, ridge_d), (1, ridge_d * .55)])
        s3d.material(rib, 'bark', color=colors[k % len(colors)], roughness=1)
        ribs.append(rib)
    return s3d.group('angular_bark_ridges', *ribs)


def root_flares(seed, count=7, length=1600, width=550, height=650, embed=110):
    frames = s3d.ring(count, width / 3, start=12).jitter(rz=14, seed=seed)
    lengths = s3d.vary(length, length * .25, count, seed=seed + 1)
    roots = [s3d.at(root_flare(length=l, width=width, height=height, embed=embed), on=f) for f, l in zip(frames, lengths)]
    return s3d.group('root_flares', *roots)


def root_flare(length, width, height, embed):
    points = [(0, -width / 2, -embed), (0, width / 2, -embed), (0, 0, height), (length * .55, -width * .3, -embed), (length * .55, width * .3, -embed), (length * .55, 0, height * .27), (length, -width * .1, -embed), (length, width * .1, -embed), (length, 0, -embed / 2)]
    root = s3d.hull('buttressed_root', points)
    s3d.material(root, 'bark', color='#735034', roughness=1)
    return root


def rising_scaffold_branches(seed, count=6, spread=3150, rise=5100, fork_d=590):
    sites = s3d.ring(count, fork_d * .12, start=18).jitter(rz=10, seed=seed)
    spreads = s3d.vary(spread, 500, count, seed=seed + 1)
    rises = s3d.vary(rise, 650, count, seed=seed + 2)
    drifts = s3d.vary(0, 500, count, seed=seed + 3)
    limbs = [s3d.at(scaffold_limb(seed=seed + 100 + k, spread=w, rise=h, drift=d, diameter=fork_d), on=f) for k, (f, w, h, d) in enumerate(zip(sites, spreads, rises, drifts))]
    middle = s3d.at(scaffold_limb(seed=seed + 200, spread=spread * .22, rise=rise * 1.22, drift=0, diameter=fork_d * .8), rz=120)
    return s3d.group('rising_scaffold_branches', *limbs, middle)


def scaffold_limb(seed, spread, rise, drift, diameter):
    path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (spread * .18, drift * .2, rise * .34), (spread * .57, drift * .65, rise * .72), (spread, drift, rise)])
    limb = s3d.wire('rising_elm_limb', path, d=[(0, diameter), (.45, diameter * .63), (1, diameter * .14)])
    s3d.material(limb, 'bark', color='#79563a', roughness=1)
    twig_sites = s3d.along(path, count=3, spin=137.508, span=(.43, .86)).turn(ry=56)
    lengths = s3d.vary(1750, 350, len(twig_sites), seed=seed + 1)
    twigs = [s3d.at(secondary_branches(seed=seed + 10 + k, length=l, diameter=diameter * .37), on=f) for k, (f, l) in enumerate(zip(twig_sites, lengths))]
    leaf_sites = s3d.along(path, count=3, span=(.61, 1))
    scales = s3d.vary(1, .17, len(leaf_sites), seed=seed + 2)
    foliage = [s3d.at(angular_foliage_clusters(seed=seed + 30 + k), on=f, scale=sc) for k, (f, sc) in enumerate(zip(leaf_sites, scales))]
    return s3d.group('scaffold_limb', limb, *twigs, *foliage)


def secondary_branches(seed, length=1750, diameter=215, bend=260):
    path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (bend * .4, 0, length * .5), (bend, 0, length)])
    twig = s3d.wire('secondary_elm_branch', path, d=[(0, diameter), (1, diameter * .13)])
    s3d.material(twig, 'bark', color='#79563a', roughness=1)
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=2, span=(.62, 1))
    leaves = [s3d.at(angular_foliage_clusters(seed=seed + 10 + k, width=1900, depth=1650, height=1600), on=f) for k, f in enumerate(sites)]
    return s3d.group('secondary_branches', twig, *leaves)


def angular_foliage_clusters(seed, width=2450, depth=2200, height=2200, sides=7, irregularity=.14):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    tiers = [(-.34, .68, 0), (0, 1, 18), (.32, .7, -8)]
    points = [(width * .04, 0, -height / 2), (-width * .07, depth * .03, height / 2)]
    for k, (level, radius, turn) in enumerate(tiers):
        frames = s3d.ring(sides, width * radius / 2, start=turn).jitter(x=width * irregularity / 2, y=width * irregularity / 2, z=height * irregularity / 2, seed=seed + 1 + k)
        points.extend([(f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width, f.origin.z + level * height) for f in frames])
    mass = s3d.hull('angular_elm_leaf_mass', points)
    palette = ['#608c36', '#6e963e', '#7d9d47', '#527b32', '#889b4c', '#59863b']
    s3d.material(mass, 'leaf', color=rng.choice(palette), roughness=.88)
    return mass

items.program:
import sand3d as s3d
import random
import numpy as np


def mature_coppiced_tree(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    stool = coppice_stool(seed=seed + 1)
    roots = flared_roots(stool, seed=seed + 2)
    stubs = old_pruning_stubs(stool, seed=seed + 3)
    cuts = exposed_cut_planes(stubs, seed=seed + 4)
    trunks = regrowth_trunks(stool, seed=seed + 5)
    forks = crooked_branch_forks(trunks, seed=seed + 6)
    foliage = flattened_foliage_clusters(forks, seed=seed + 7)
    return s3d.assembly('mature_coppiced_tree', stool, roots, stubs, cuts, trunks, forks, foliage)


def coppice_stool(seed=1, width=1420, depth=1240, height=660, sides=9):
    base = s3d.ring(sides, width / 2).jitter(x=70, y=65, seed=seed)
    waist = s3d.ring(sides, width * .46, start=12).jitter(x=95, y=80, z=55, seed=seed + 1)
    crown = s3d.ring(sides, width * .35, start=-8).jitter(x=90, y=70, z=65, seed=seed + 2)
    points = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width, 0) for f in base]
    points += [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width, height * .46 + f.origin.z) for f in waist]
    points += [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width, height + f.origin.z) for f in crown]
    stool = s3d.hull('ancient_knuckled_stool', points)
    bark_material(stool, seed)
    return stool


def bark_material(ob, seed=0, tone=(.265, .185, .125), variation=.035):
    def colour(x, y, z):
        v = s3d.noise(x / 340, y / 340, z / 580, seed=seed)
        return np.clip(np.asarray(tone)[None, :] + v[:, None] * variation, 0, 1)
    s3d.material(ob, 'bark', color=colour, roughness=.96)
    return ob


def flared_roots(stool, seed=2, count=8, reach=1210, spread=330, height=360):
    sites = s3d.ring(count, 0, start=9).jitter(rz=12, seed=seed)
    lengths = s3d.vary(reach, reach * .24, count, seed=seed + 1)
    widths = s3d.vary(spread, spread * .25, count, seed=seed + 2)
    roots = [s3d.at(root_buttress(length=l, width=w, height=height, seed=seed + 10 + i), on=f)
             for i, (f, l, w) in enumerate(zip(sites, lengths, widths))]
    return s3d.group('flared_roots', roots)


def root_buttress(length=1200, width=330, height=360, seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    kink = rng.uniform(-width / 2, width / 2)
    points = [(0, -width / 2, 0), (0, width / 2, 0), (0, -width * .4, height), (0, width * .4, height),
              (length * .46, kink - width * .29, 0), (length * .46, kink + width * .29, 0),
              (length * .46, kink, height * .4), (length, kink - width * .1, 0),
              (length, kink + width * .1, 0), (length * .91, kink, height * .09)]
    root = s3d.hull('angular_buttress', points)
    return bark_material(root, seed)


def surface_site(stool, x, y, above=1500):
    hits = s3d.snap(stool, [s3d.Frame((x, y, above))], direction='-Z')
    return s3d.Frame(tuple(hits[0].origin))


def old_pruning_stubs(stool, seed=3):
    specs = [(0, -100, 690, 370, -100, -75), (-440, -200, 420, 340, -115, -100),
             (360, 160, 450, 460, 110, 50), (50, 390, 310, 300, 0, 110)]
    parts, anchors = [], {}
    for i, (x, y, d, h, dx, dy) in enumerate(specs):
        site = surface_site(stool, x, y)
        path = [(0, 0, -d * .24), (dx * .4, dy * .4, h * .5), (dx, dy, h)]
        stub = s3d.wire('old_cut_limb', path, d=[(0, d), (1, d * .87)])
        bark_material(stub, seed + i)
        parts.append(s3d.at(stub, on=site))
        end = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]
        anchors['cut' + str(i)] = s3d.Frame(site.point(*tuple(end.origin)), normal=tuple(end.normal))
    return s3d.assembly('old_pruning_stubs', *parts, **anchors)


def exposed_cut_planes(stubs, seed=4):
    diameters = [690, 420, 450, 310]
    parts = [s3d.at(cut_face(d=d * .87, seed=seed + i), on=getattr(stubs, 'cut' + str(i)))
             for i, d in enumerate(diameters)]
    return s3d.group('exposed_cut_planes', parts)


def cut_face(d=500, seed=0, rim=.105, thickness=5):
    wood_d = d * (1 - 2 * rim)
    wood = s3d.extrude('weathered_pale_heartwood', s3d.polygon(4, wood_d), thickness)
    s3d.material(wood, 'oak', color='#b59b70', roughness=1)
    rings = []
    for fraction in (.46, .73):
        ring = s3d.at(s3d.tube('angular_growth_ring', wood_d * fraction, wood_d * fraction - d * .014, thickness / 4), z=thickness)
        s3d.material(ring, 'oak', color='#8f7955', roughness=1)
        rings.append(ring)
    crack = s3d.extrude('old_radial_check', s3d.poly([(wood_d * .12, 0), (wood_d * .49, -d * .012), (wood_d * .42, d * .008)]), thickness / 3)
    crack = s3d.at(crack, z=thickness)
    s3d.material(crack, 'bark', color='#52402c', roughness=1)
    return s3d.group('old_cut_surface', wood, rings, crack)


def regrowth_trunks(stool, seed=5):
    specs = [(-470, -110, 300, 2260, -920, -120), (430, 30, 340, 2650, 860, 160),
             (-100, 430, 245, 2790, -240, 650), (170, -440, 205, 2080, 520, -690),
             (-470, 270, 190, 2180, -820, 470)]
    parts, anchors = [], {}
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    for i, (x, y, d, h, dx, dy) in enumerate(specs):
        site = surface_site(stool, x, y)
        kink = rng.uniform(-130, 130)
        path = [(0, 0, -d / 2), (dx * .18 + kink, dy * .12, h * .29),
                (dx * .53, dy * .62 + kink, h * .61), (dx * .84 - kink, dy * .83, h * .83), (dx, dy, h)]
        trunk = s3d.wire('angular_regrowth_trunk', path, d=[(0, d), (.35, d * .78), (.72, d * .53), (1, d * .32)])
        bark_material(trunk, seed + i + 1, tone=(.30, .22, .15))
        parts.append(s3d.at(trunk, on=site))
        for label, fraction in [('tip', 1), ('side', .69)]:
            frame = s3d.along(path, count=2, span=(0, fraction))[-1]
            anchors[label + str(i)] = s3d.Frame(site.point(*tuple(frame.origin)), normal=tuple(frame.normal))
    return s3d.assembly('regrowth_trunks', *parts, **anchors)


def crooked_branch_forks(trunks, seed=6, trunk_count=5, forks=3, length=660, diameter=100):
    parts, anchors = [], {}
    for i in range(trunk_count):
        parent = getattr(trunks, 'tip' + str(i))
        sites = s3d.ring(forks, 0, start=i * 47, on=parent).turn(ry=49).jitter(rx=11, ry=13, rz=15, seed=seed + i)
        lengths = s3d.vary(length, length * .26, len(sites), seed=seed + 10 + i)
        for j, (site, h) in enumerate(zip(sites, lengths)):
            branch, end = angular_branch(length=h, diameter=diameter * (1 - .07 * i), seed=seed + 100 + i * forks + j)
            parts.append(s3d.at(branch, on=site))
            anchors['leaf' + str(i * (forks + 1) + j)] = s3d.Frame(site.point(*tuple(end.origin)), normal=(0, 0, 1))
        site = getattr(trunks, 'side' + str(i)).turn(ry=57, rz=-37 + i * 71)
        branch, end = angular_branch(length=length * .85, diameter=diameter * .73, seed=seed + 200 + i)
        parts.append(s3d.at(branch, on=site))
        anchors['leaf' + str(i * (forks + 1) + forks)] = s3d.Frame(site.point(*tuple(end.origin)), normal=(0, 0, 1))
    return s3d.assembly('crooked_branch_forks', *parts, **anchors)


def angular_branch(length=660, diameter=100, seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    drift = rng.uniform(-length * .15, length * .15)
    path = [(0, 0, -diameter / 3), (drift, length * .1, length * .47), (drift * .6, -length * .04, length)]
    branch = s3d.wire('crooked_tip_branch', path, d=[(0, diameter), (.5, diameter * .64), (1, diameter * .22)])
    bark_material(branch, seed, tone=(.30, .22, .15))
    return branch, s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]


def flattened_foliage_clusters(forks, seed=7, count=20, width=1110, depth=920, height=450):
    widths = s3d.vary(width, width * .26, count, seed=seed)
    parts = [s3d.at(foliage_cluster(width=w, depth=depth, height=height, seed=seed + 10 + i), on=getattr(forks, 'leaf' + str(i)))
             for i, w in enumerate(widths)]
    return s3d.group('flattened_foliage_clusters', parts)


def foliage_cluster(width=1110, depth=920, height=450, seed=0):
    sites = s3d.Frames([s3d.Frame((0, 0, 20)), s3d.Frame((-width * .30, depth * .08, -height * .12)),
                        s3d.Frame((width * .25, -depth * .19, height * .11))])
    sizes = [1, .67, .62]
    lobes = [s3d.at(foliage_lobe(width=width * size, depth=depth * size, height=height * size, seed=seed + i), on=frame)
             for i, (frame, size) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes))]
    return s3d.group('flattened_leaf_cluster', lobes)


def foliage_lobe(width=1110, depth=920, height=450, seed=0, corners=7):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    belt = s3d.ring(corners, width / 2).jitter(x=width * .09, y=width * .07, z=height * .14, seed=seed)
    top = s3d.ring(corners - 2, width * .32, start=19).jitter(x=width * .08, y=width * .07, z=height * .13, seed=seed + 1)
    points = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width, f.origin.z) for f in belt]
    points += [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width, height * .48 + f.origin.z) for f in top]
    points += [(-width * .12, depth * .05, -height * .44), (width * .16, -depth * .13, -height * .36)]
    lobe = s3d.hull('faceted_flat_foliage', points)
    tint = rng.choice([(0.29, .36, .17), (.34, .40, .20), (.38, .43, .23), (.25, .33, .18)])
    def colour(x, y, z):
        n = s3d.noise(x / 240, y / 240, z / 220, seed=seed + 2)
        return np.clip(np.asarray(tint)[None, :] + n[:, None] * .035, 0, 1)
    s3d.material(lobe, 'leaf', color=colour, roughness=.96)
    return lobe

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random


def autumn_papaya_jungle_vignette(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    ground = ground_patch(seed=seed + 1)
    tree = s3d.at(papaya_tree(seed=seed + 10), on=s3d.bbox(ground, '+Z'))
    edges = edge_jungle_foliage(ground, seed=seed + 20)
    litter = fallen_lobed_leaves(ground, seed=seed + 30)
    return s3d.assembly('autumn_papaya_jungle_vignette', ground, tree, edges, litter)


def ground_patch(seed=0, width=6400, depth=5800, height=160, corners=11):
    sites = s3d.ring(corners, width / 2).jitter(x=130, y=120, seed=seed)
    outline = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width) for f in sites]
    ground = s3d.extrude('bounded_warm_earth', s3d.poly(outline), height)
    s3d.material(ground, 'soil', color='#795039', roughness=1)
    return ground


def papaya_tree(seed=0, trunk_height=3710, crown_depth=320):
    trunk = papaya_trunk(h=trunk_height, seed=seed + 1)
    scars = angular_leaf_scars(trunk, height=trunk_height-crown_depth, seed=seed + 2)
    stalks, tips = leaf_stalks(trunk, crown_height=trunk_height, crown_depth=crown_depth, seed=seed + 3)
    canopy = palmate_leaf_canopy(tips, seed=seed + 4)
    fruits = papaya_fruit_cluster(trunk, crown_height=trunk_height, seed=seed + 5)
    return s3d.group('papaya_tree', trunk, scars, stalks, canopy, fruits)


def papaya_trunk(seed=0, h=3710, foot=265, neck=115, lean=140):
    drift = s3d.vary(0, 26, 3, seed=seed)
    trunk = s3d.loft('slender_leaning_trunk',
        s3d.station(0, foot, foot),
        s3d.station(h/4, foot*.76, foot*.76, x=-lean/5, y=drift[0]),
        s3d.station(h*.6, foot*.58, foot*.58, x=lean*.6, y=drift[1]),
        s3d.station(h, neck, neck, x=lean, y=drift[2]))
    s3d.material(trunk, 'bark', color='#a38750', roughness=.95)
    return trunk


def angular_leaf_scars(trunk, seed=0, height=3390, count=24, width=85, depth=28, relief=5):
    probes = s3d.phyllotaxis(count, d=800, h=height).move(z=120)
    sites = s3d.snap(trunk, [f.origin for f in probes])
    scar = s3d.extrude('angular_leaf_scar', s3d.poly([(-width/2,0),(0,-depth),(width/2,0),(0,-depth/2)]), relief)
    s3d.material(scar, 'bark', color='#695337', roughness=1)
    marks = s3d.at(scar, on=sites.offset(-relief/2))
    return s3d.group('angular_leaf_scars', marks)


def leaf_stalks(trunk, seed=0, count=11, crown_height=3710, crown_depth=320, reach=1190):
    probes = s3d.ring(count, 420, start=12).move(z=crown_height-crown_depth/2).jitter(z=crown_depth/2, seed=seed)
    roots = s3d.snap(trunk, [f.origin for f in probes])
    lengths = s3d.vary(reach, 260, len(roots), seed=seed + 1)
    rises = s3d.vary(340, 170, len(roots), seed=seed + 2)
    stalks, tips = [], []
    for i, (root, length, rise) in enumerate(zip(roots, lengths, rises)):
        stalk = petiole_part(length=length, rise=rise, seed=seed + 100 + i)
        stalks.append(s3d.at(stalk, on=root))
        end = root.point(0, rise, length)
        radial = root.normal
        tips.append(s3d.Frame(origin=end, normal=(0,0,1), up=(radial.x,radial.y,0)))
    return s3d.group('leaf_stalks', stalks), tips


def petiole_part(seed=0, length=1190, rise=340, diameter=32):
    stalk = s3d.wire('long_leaf_petiole', [(0,0,0),(0,rise*.65,length*.55),(0,rise,length)], d=[(0,diameter),(1,diameter*.6)])
    s3d.material(stalk, 'leaf', color='#7d803c', roughness=.95)
    return stalk


def palmate_leaf_canopy(tips, seed=0, length=1100):
    sizes = s3d.vary(length, 220, len(tips), seed=seed)
    tilts = s3d.vary(-8, 16, len(tips), seed=seed + 1)
    colors = ['#747d32','#8b8634','#a69538','#65752e','#ad6e31']
    leaves = [s3d.at(palmate_leaf(length=size, color=colors[i % len(colors)], seed=seed + 100 + i), on=f.turn(rx=tilt))
              for i, (f, size, tilt) in enumerate(zip(tips, sizes, tilts))]
    return s3d.group('palmate_leaf_canopy', leaves)


def palmate_leaf(seed=0, length=1100, color='#81873a', thickness=12, width_ratio=.19, fold=.035):
    rays = [(-.65,-.18),(-1,.30),(-.76,.84),(0,1.16),(.76,.84),(1,.30),(.65,-.18)]
    variations = s3d.vary(1, .10, len(rays), seed=seed)
    lobes, veins = [], []
    for i, ((dx,dy), variation) in enumerate(zip(rays, variations)):
        lobe = folded_lobe(dx*length*variation/2, dy*length*variation, length*width_ratio/2, thickness, length*fold)
        lobes.append(lobe)
        vein = s3d.wire('palmate_vein', [(0,0,thickness),(dx*length*variation/4,dy*length*variation/2,length*fold+thickness),(dx*length*variation*.45,dy*length*variation*.9,thickness)], d=thickness*.65)
        veins.append(vein)
    leaf = s3d.merge(*lobes)
    s3d.material(leaf, 'leaf', color=color, roughness=1)
    venation = s3d.merge(*veins)
    s3d.material(venation, 'leaf', color='#b2aa59', roughness=1)
    return s3d.group('seven_lobed_papaya_leaf', leaf, venation)


def folded_lobe(dx, dy, width, thickness, ridge):
    reach = (dx*dx+dy*dy)**.5
    px, py = -dy/reach*width, dx/reach*width
    pts = [(0,0,0),(dx,dy,0),(.46*dx+px,.46*dy+py,0),(.46*dx-px,.46*dy-py,0),
           (0,0,thickness),(dx,dy,thickness),(.46*dx+px,.46*dy+py,thickness),(.46*dx-px,.46*dy-py,thickness),(.48*dx,.48*dy,ridge+thickness)]
    return s3d.hull('folded_pointed_lobe', pts)


def papaya_fruit_cluster(trunk, seed=0, crown_height=3710, count=9, height=580, offset=235):
    probes = s3d.ring(count, 450, start=23).move(z=crown_height-550).jitter(z=280, seed=seed)
    sites = s3d.snap(trunk, [f.origin for f in probes])
    heights = s3d.vary(height, 95, len(sites), seed=seed + 1)
    palette = ['#e6a227','#658238','#ecae31','#91a03a','#d58420','#3f733d','#e9aa29','#6d913b','#b8a331']
    fruits = []
    for i, (site, h) in enumerate(zip(sites, heights)):
        p, n = site.origin, site.normal
        frame = s3d.Frame((p.x+n.x*offset,p.y+n.y*offset,p.z-h-60), normal=(0,0,1), up=(n.x,n.y,0))
        fruits.append(s3d.at(papaya_fruit(height=h, offset=offset, color=palette[i % len(palette)], seed=seed+100+i), on=frame))
    return s3d.group('papaya_fruit_cluster', fruits)


def papaya_fruit(seed=0, height=580, width=245, offset=235, color='#e5a127', stem_rise=60):
    fruit = s3d.loft('elongated_pear_papaya',
        s3d.station(0,0,0),
        s3d.station(height*.13,width*.76,width*.76),
        s3d.station(height*.36,width,width),
        s3d.station(height*.67,width*.83,width*.83),
        s3d.station(height*.92,width*.40,width*.40),
        s3d.station(height,width*.19,width*.19))
    s3d.material(fruit, 'leaf', color=color, roughness=.92)
    stem = s3d.wire('fruit_attachment_stem', [(0,0,height),(0,-offset/2,height+stem_rise/2),(0,-offset,height+stem_rise)], d=23)
    s3d.material(stem, 'leaf', color='#566239', roughness=1)
    return s3d.group('papaya_with_stem', fruit, stem)


def edge_jungle_foliage(ground, seed=0, count=7, radius=2530):
    probes = s3d.ring(count, radius, start=10).jitter(x=100,y=100,seed=seed)
    hits = s3d.snap(ground, [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y, 1500) for f in probes], direction='-Z')
    sizes = s3d.vary(1, .23, len(hits), seed=seed+1)
    plants = [s3d.at(jungle_rosette(seed=seed+100+i), on=s3d.Frame(hit.origin), rz=i*137.508, scale=size)
              for i,(hit,size) in enumerate(zip(hits,sizes))]
    return s3d.group('edge_jungle_foliage', plants)


def jungle_rosette(seed=0, count=6, length=700, width=160):
    frames = s3d.ring(count, 0, start=12).turn(ry=43).jitter(ry=12,rz=10,seed=seed)
    sizes = s3d.vary(1, .24, len(frames), seed=seed+1)
    blades = s3d.at(jungle_blade(length=length,width=width,seed=seed+2), on=frames, scale=sizes)
    return s3d.group('low_jungle_rosette', blades)


def jungle_blade(seed=0, length=700, width=160):
    blade = s3d.loft('broad_jungle_blade',s3d.station(0,18,8),s3d.station(length*.43,width,32,x=length*.10),s3d.station(length*.8,width*.65,20,x=length*.22),s3d.station(length,0,0,x=length*.34))
    colors = ['#596735','#78803a','#9c8d37']
    s3d.material(blade, 'leaf', color=colors[seed % len(colors)], roughness=1)
    return blade


def fallen_lobed_leaves(ground, seed=0, count=9, size=480):
    sampled = s3d.scatter(count*12, ground, seed=seed)
    sites = [f for f in sampled if f.normal.z > .9 and f.origin.x**2+f.origin.y**2 > 650**2][:count]
    sizes = s3d.vary(size, 125, len(sites), seed=seed+1)
    turns = s3d.vary(180,180,len(sites),seed=seed+2)
    colors = ['#a8542b','#bc8c37','#716f32']
    leaves = [s3d.at(palmate_leaf(length=length,color=colors[i % len(colors)],thickness=7,fold=.018,seed=seed+100+i),on=site,rz=turn)
              for i,(site,length,turn) in enumerate(zip(sites,sizes,turns))]
    return s3d.group('fallen_lobed_leaves', leaves)
