import sand3d as s3d
import random
import math
import numpy as np


def autumn_cashew_tree_island(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    ground = ground_island(seed=seed + 1)
    trunk = s3d.at(stout_trunk(seed=seed + 2), z=480)
    roots = s3d.at(root_flare(seed=seed + 3), on=s3d.local(trunk))
    crown = s3d.at(spreading_branches(seed=seed + 4), on=s3d.local(trunk, x=70, z=1800))
    moss = ground_details(ground, seed=seed + 5)
    return s3d.assembly('autumn_cashew_tree_island', ground, trunk, roots, crown, moss)


def ground_island(seed=0, width=9600, depth=8200, height=480, corners=13, bevel=110):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    outline = [(f.origin.x * width / 2 * rng.uniform(.91, 1), f.origin.y * depth / 2 * rng.uniform(.91, 1)) for f in s3d.ring(corners, 1)]
    earth = s3d.extrude('faceted_earth_island', s3d.poly(outline), height)
    earth = s3d.chamfer(earth, bevel, edges='top')
    s3d.material(earth, 'soil', color=lambda x,y,z,n: np.where((n[2] > .7)[:,None], np.array([.40,.255,.135]), np.array([.265,.151,.087])), roughness=1)
    return earth


def stout_trunk(seed=0, height=2850, width=940, depth=850):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    lean = rng.uniform(-170, -100)
    trunk = s3d.loft('irregular_warm_brown_trunk', s3d.station(0,width*1.35,depth*1.3,n=3), s3d.station(height*.16,width,depth,x=90,n=3), s3d.station(height*.47,width*.81,depth*.82,x=20,y=-65,n=3), s3d.station(height*.74,width*.67,depth*.66,x=70,n=3), s3d.station(height,width*.41,depth*.45,x=lean,y=40,n=3))
    s3d.material(trunk,'bark',color='#784529',roughness=1)
    return trunk


def root_flare(seed=0, count=6, reach=1410, girth=360, rise=500):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    roots = []
    sites = s3d.ring(count, 0, start=12).jitter(rz=15,seed=seed+1)
    for i, site in enumerate(sites):
        length = reach*rng.uniform(.72,1)
        root = s3d.wire('buttress_root', [(0,0,rise), (length*.43,0,rise*.29), (length,0,15)], [(0,girth),(1,25)])
        s3d.material(root,'bark',color='#704226')
        roots.append(s3d.at(root,on=site))
    return s3d.group('root_flare',*roots)


def spreading_branches(seed=0, count=7):
    frames = s3d.ring(count,0,start=8).jitter(z=170,rz=11,seed=seed+1)
    lengths = s3d.vary(2570,380,count,seed=seed+2)
    rises = s3d.vary(1990,470,count,seed=seed+3)
    boughs = [s3d.at(branch_bough(seed=seed+100+i,length=length,rise=rise), on=frame) for i,(frame,length,rise) in enumerate(zip(frames,lengths,rises))]
    return s3d.group('low_spreading_branch_crown',*boughs)


def branch_bough(seed=0, length=2600, rise=2000, diameter=420, twig_length=780):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    drift = rng.uniform(-270,270)
    points = [(0,0,0),(length*.24,drift*.25,rise*.18),(length*.64,drift*.7,rise*.49),(length,drift,rise)]
    path = s3d.spline(points)
    limb = s3d.wire('spreading_primary_limb',path,[(0,diameter),(.52,diameter*.6),(1,110)])
    s3d.material(limb,'bark',color='#855033')
    children=[limb]
    attachments = s3d.along(path,count=4,span=(.42,1),spin=137.508).turn(ry=42)
    for j, frame in enumerate(attachments):
        tip = frame.point(0,0,twig_length)
        twig = s3d.wire('fruiting_branchlet',[frame.origin,frame.point(0,0,twig_length*.5),tip],[(0,110),(1,29)])
        s3d.material(twig,'bark',color='#865235')
        children.append(twig)
        leaves = s3d.at(oval_leaf_clusters(seed=seed+20+j),on=s3d.Frame(origin=tip).turn(ry=rng.uniform(-25,25),rz=rng.uniform(0,360)))
        children.append(leaves)
        if j != 0:
            fruit = cashew_apple(seed=seed+50+j, red=(j%2==0))
            children.append(s3d.at(fruit,on=s3d.Frame(origin=tip).move(z=-65),rz=rng.uniform(0,360),scale=rng.uniform(.92,1.17)))
    return s3d.group('branch_bough',*children)


def oval_leaf_clusters(seed=0, count=10, stalk_h=660):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    stalk = s3d.wire('cluster_twig',[(0,0,0),(25,0,stalk_h)],[(0,38),(1,12)])
    s3d.material(stalk,'bark',color='#80522f')
    sites = s3d.along([(0,0,50),(25,0,stalk_h)],count=count,spin=137.508).turn(ry=66).jitter(ry=14,rz=18,seed=seed+1)
    colors=['#a9a250','#b9a348','#c38d37','#a75b2f','#7f8843','#8e943f']
    leaves=[]
    for i,site in enumerate(sites):
        leaf = oval_leaf(seed=seed+100+i,length=rng.uniform(660,900),width=rng.uniform(410,560),color=rng.choice(colors))
        leaves.append(s3d.at(leaf,on=site))
    return s3d.group('oval_leaf_cluster',stalk,*leaves)


def oval_leaf(seed=0, length=780, width=500, fold=40, color='#a99a43'):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    bend=rng.uniform(-.06,.06)*length
    edge=[(0,0,0),(-width*.32,0,length*.14),(-width*.5,0,length*.43),(-width*.46,0,length*.73),(-width*.24,bend,length*.96),(width*.15,bend,length),(width*.41,0,length*.86),(width*.5,0,length*.55),(width*.36,0,length*.19)]
    leaf=s3d.hull('broad_blunt_oval_leaf',edge+[(0,-fold,length*.48),(0,fold*.45,length*.48)])
    s3d.material(leaf,'leaf',color=color,roughness=.91)
    return leaf


def cashew_apple(seed=0, red=False, height=410, width=335, stem_h=100):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    body=s3d.loft('red_cashew_apple' if red else 'golden_cashew_apple',s3d.station(-height-stem_h,width*.55,width*.5),s3d.station(-height*.87-stem_h,width*.95,width*.83),s3d.station(-height*.58-stem_h,width,width*.87),s3d.station(-height*.25-stem_h,width*.64,width*.61),s3d.station(-stem_h,width*.26,width*.27))
    s3d.material(body,'plastic',color=rng.choice(['#c74a27','#d6592c']) if red else rng.choice(['#eeaa32','#e5b33c','#e98b29']),roughness=.84)
    stem=s3d.wire('cashew_pedicel',[(0,0,0),(0,0,-stem_h)],d=27)
    s3d.material(stem,'bark',color='#6b6535')
    nut=s3d.at(cashew_nut(seed=seed+1),z=-height-stem_h)
    return s3d.group('hanging_cashew_with_nut',stem,body,nut)


def cashew_nut(seed=0, width=170, length=190, thickness=90):
    path=s3d.spline([(0,0,0),(width*.65,0,-length*.25),(width*.78,0,-length*.72),(width*.31,0,-length),(-width*.23,0,-length*.9),(-width*.43,0,-length*.56)])
    nut=s3d.wire('curved_kidney_cashew_nut',path,[(0,thickness*.72),(.32,thickness),(1,thickness*.76)])
    s3d.material(nut,'plastic',color='#8c9981',roughness=.92)
    return nut


def ground_details(ground,seed=0):
    sites=s3d.scatter(54,ground,seed=seed+1)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.origin.z > 479 and f.origin.x**2+f.origin.y**2 > 1700**2]
    rng=random.Random(seed+2)
    patches=[]
    for i,f in enumerate(kept[:8]):
        patches.append(s3d.at(moss_patch(seed=seed+100+i),on=s3d.Frame(origin=f.origin),rz=rng.uniform(0,360)))
    rocks=[]
    for i,f in enumerate(kept[8:13]):
        rocks.append(s3d.at(angular_rock(seed=seed+200+i),on=s3d.Frame(origin=f.origin).move(z=-35)))
    plant_sites=[f for f in kept[13:] if (f.origin.x/4200)**2+(f.origin.y/3500)**2 > .67 and (f.origin.y > 1000 or abs(f.origin.x)>2800)]
    plants=[s3d.at(jungle_edge_plant(seed=seed+300+i),on=s3d.Frame(origin=f.origin),rz=rng.uniform(0,360)) for i,f in enumerate(plant_sites[:6])]
    return s3d.group('sparse_island_understory',*patches,*rocks,*plants)


def moss_patch(seed=0, width=1150, depth=760, height=62):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    ring=s3d.ring(9,1)
    outline=[(f.origin.x*width/2*rng.uniform(.76,1.1),f.origin.y*depth/2*rng.uniform(.76,1.1)) for f in ring]
    patch=s3d.extrude('separate_low_moss_patch',s3d.poly(outline),height)
    patch=s3d.chamfer(patch,height*.4,edges='top')
    s3d.material(patch,'moss',color=rng.choice(['#626f32','#74803d','#687938']),roughness=1)
    return patch


def angular_rock(seed=0, width=560, depth=440, height=350):
    sites=s3d.scatter(12,(width,depth,height),surface=True,seed=seed+1,on=s3d.Frame(origin=(0,0,height*.40)))
    rock=s3d.hull('angular_jungle_rock',[f.origin for f in sites])
    s3d.material(rock,'rock',color='#827560',roughness=1)
    return rock


def jungle_edge_plant(seed=0, count=7, height=850):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    stem=s3d.cylinder('understory_base',45,height*.15)
    s3d.material(stem,'bark',color='#5d6634')
    sites=s3d.ring(count,0).turn(ry=53).jitter(ry=18,rz=13,seed=seed+1).move(z=height*.11)
    leaves=[s3d.at(oval_leaf(seed=seed+20+i,length=height*rng.uniform(.73,1.15),width=height*.36,fold=height*.055,color=rng.choice(['#596e3b','#6b7839','#7d8240'])),on=f) for i,f in enumerate(sites)]
    return s3d.group('broad_leaf_jungle_rosette',stem,*leaves)

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random
import math


def low_poly_palm(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    base = exposed_root_base(seed=seed + 1)
    trunk = tapered_trunk(seed=seed + 2)
    crown = s3d.at(crown_attachment(seed=seed + 3), on=trunk.tip)
    return s3d.assembly("low_poly_palm", base, trunk, crown)


def exposed_root_base(seed=1, width=640, height=340, roots=6):
    flare = s3d.loft("root_flare", s3d.station(0, width, width), s3d.station(height / 2, width * .74, width * .70), s3d.station(height, width * .64, width * .64))
    s3d.material(flare, "bark", color="#805035", roughness=1)
    sites = s3d.ring(roots, 0, start=15).jitter(rz=13, seed=seed + 1)
    buttresses = s3d.at(root_buttress(seed=seed + 2), on=sites, scale=s3d.vary(1, .18, roots, seed=seed + 3))
    return s3d.group("exposed_root_base", flare, buttresses)


def root_buttress(seed=2, length=650, width=180, height=300):
    root = s3d.hull("exposed_angular_root", [(0, -width/2, 0), (0, width/2, 0), (0, 0, height), (length*.66, -width*.34, 0), (length*.66, width*.34, 0), (length*.62, 0, height*.3), (length, 0, 0)])
    s3d.material(root, "bark", color="#70442e", roughness=1)
    return root


def tapered_trunk(seed=2, height=6500, foot=480, tip=184, lean=350):
    path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (-lean*.15, 12, height*.24), (lean*.08, 22, height*.49), (lean*.57, -18, height*.75), (lean, 0, height)])
    diameters = [(0, foot), (.06, foot*.70), (.35, foot*.60), (.72, foot*.47), (1, tip)]
    wood = s3d.wire("bent_tapered_trunk", path, d=diameters)
    s3d.material(wood, "bark", color="#966442", roughness=1)
    scars = old_leaf_scars(path, diameters, seed=seed + 1)
    end = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]
    return s3d.assembly("tapered_trunk", wood, scars, tip=end)


def old_leaf_scars(path, diameters, seed=3, count=39, band_h=52, projection=14):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=count, span=(.055, .985))
    bands = []
    for i, f in enumerate(sites):
        u = .055 + (.985-.055)*i/(count-1)
        diameter = float(np.interp(u, [v[0] for v in diameters], [v[1] for v in diameters]))
        radius = diameter/2
        p = projection * rng.uniform(.7, 1.15)
        band = s3d.revolve("angular_leaf_scar", s3d.poly([(radius*.97, 0), (radius+p, band_h*.32), (radius+p*.28, band_h), (radius*.97, band_h*.78)]))
        s3d.material(band, "bark", color=rng.choice(["#71452f", "#805038", "#a7744d"]), roughness=1)
        bands.append(s3d.at(band, on=f))
    return s3d.group("old_leaf_scars", *bands)


def crown_attachment(seed=3, width=320, height=330):
    heart = s3d.loft("compact_leaf_bases", s3d.station(0, width*.6, width*.6), s3d.station(height*.52, width, width*.85), s3d.station(height, width*.36, width*.36))
    s3d.material(heart, "leaf", color="#666e35", roughness=.94)
    fronds = arching_frond_ribs(seed=seed + 1)
    return s3d.group("crown_attachment", heart, fronds)


def arching_frond_ribs(seed=4, attachment_radius=65):
    tiers = [(9, 3020, 620, 900, 40, 8), (5, 2490, 1120, 100, 135, 43), (2, 1350, 1580, -1000, 190, 95)]
    fronds = []
    for tier, (count, length, rise, drop, z, azimuth) in enumerate(tiers):
        sites = s3d.ring(count, attachment_radius, start=azimuth).move(z=z).jitter(rz=12, rx=5, seed=seed + 10*tier + 1)
        lengths = s3d.vary(length, length*.13, count, seed=seed + 10*tier + 2)
        rises = s3d.vary(rise, abs(rise)*.17, count, seed=seed + 10*tier + 3)
        for i, (site, frond_length, frond_rise) in enumerate(zip(sites, lengths, rises)):
            part = feathered_frond(length=frond_length, rise=frond_rise, drop=drop, seed=seed + 100*(tier+1) + i)
            fronds.append(s3d.at(part, on=site))
    return s3d.group("arching_frond_ribs", *fronds)


def feathered_frond(length=3000, rise=650, drop=800, seed=5, rib_d=42):
    path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (length*.22, 0, rise*.78), (length*.50, 0, rise), (length*.78, 0, rise*.40), (length, 0, -drop)])
    rib = s3d.wire("central_frond_rib", path, d=[(0, rib_d), (.4, rib_d*.65), (.85, rib_d*.22), (1, 2)])
    s3d.material(rib, "leaf", color="#71813c", roughness=.95)
    blades = pointed_frond_leaflets(path, length, seed=seed + 1)
    return s3d.group("feathered_frond", rib, blades)


def pointed_frond_leaflets(path, frond_length, seed=6, count=27, sweep=.48, droop=.24):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    blades = []
    for side in (-1, 1):
        start, end = (.075, .965) if side == 1 else (.09, .98)
        sites = s3d.along(path, count=count, span=(start, end))
        for i, f in enumerate(sites):
            u = start + (end-start)*i/(count-1)
            tangent = np.array(tuple(f.point(0, 0, 1))) - np.array(tuple(f.origin))
            direction = sweep*tangent + np.array([0, side, -droop*(.6+u)])
            frame = s3d.Frame(origin=tuple(f.origin), normal=tuple(direction), up=(0, 0, 1))
            envelope = math.sin(math.pi*u)**.65 * (1-.48*u)
            length = frond_length*.36*envelope*rng.uniform(.87, 1.12)
            blade = angular_leaflet(length=length, width=length*.13, seed=seed + 100*(side+1) + i)
            blades.append(s3d.at(blade, on=frame))
    return s3d.group("pointed_frond_leaflets", *blades)


def angular_leaflet(length=700, width=90, seed=7, fold=14, sag=.16):
    blade = s3d.loft("pointed_folded_blade", s3d.station(0, 0, 0), s3d.station(length*.27, width, fold, y=-length*sag*.06), s3d.station(length*.65, width*.59, fold*.6, y=-length*sag*.4), s3d.station(length, 0, 0, y=-length*sag))
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    s3d.material(blade, "leaf", color=rng.choice(["#326b36", "#3f7839", "#4b803c", "#396f32", "#548442"]), roughness=.96)
    return blade

import sand3d as s3d
import random
import numpy as np


def ancient_gnarled_tree_autumn_mountain_vignette(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    ground = ground_patch(seed=seed+1)
    trunk = s3d.at(ancient_trunk(seed=seed+2), x=-300, y=-400, z=400)
    roots = knotted_roots(trunk, ground, seed=seed+3)
    limbs = s3d.at(crooked_limbs(seed=seed+4), on=s3d.local(trunk, *tuple(trunk.crown.origin)))
    twigs = exposed_twigs(limbs, seed=seed+5)
    leaves = autumn_foliage(limbs, seed=seed+6)
    rise = rear_craggy_rise(ground, seed=seed+7)
    rocks = scattered_rocks(ground, seed=seed+8)
    grass = sparse_grass_tufts(ground, seed=seed+9)
    litter = fallen_leaves(ground, seed=seed+10)
    tree = s3d.group('rooted_tree', trunk, roots, limbs, twigs, leaves)
    tree = s3d.transform(tree, rz=135)
    return s3d.assembly('ancient_autumn_tree', ground, tree, rise, rocks, grass, litter)


def ground_patch(seed=0, width=10000, depth=8200, thickness=430, corners=13):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    rim = s3d.ring(corners, 1)
    outline = [(f.origin.x*width/2*rng.uniform(.89,1), f.origin.y*depth/2*rng.uniform(.89,1)) for f in rim]
    soil = s3d.extrude('bounded_earth', s3d.poly(outline), thickness, taper=-2)
    s3d.material(soil, 'soil', color='#725039', roughness=1)
    return soil


def ancient_trunk(seed=0, diameter=2100, height=5400, groove=.18, twist=55, hollow_w=1040, hollow_h=2060):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    ring = s3d.ring(16, diameter/2)
    pts = []
    for i, f in enumerate(ring):
        k = (1-groove if i%2 else 1)*rng.uniform(.96,1.04)
        pts.append((f.origin.x*k, f.origin.y*k))
    axis = [(0,0,0),(-200,30,height*.18),(-320,70,height*.39),(-100,100,height*.59),(180,140,height*.79),(80,220,height)]
    path = s3d.spline(axis)
    body = s3d.sweep('twisted_grooved_trunk', s3d.poly(pts), path, scale=[(0,1),(.2,.86),(.45,.72),(.72,.56),(1,.31)], twist=twist)
    s3d.material(body, 'bark', color='#684631', roughness=1)
    opening = [(-hollow_w*.40,0),(hollow_w*.34,0),(hollow_w*.50,hollow_h*.34),(hollow_w*.32,hollow_h*.77),(-hollow_w*.04,hollow_h),(-hollow_w*.42,hollow_h*.80),(-hollow_w*.55,hollow_h*.32)]
    cutter = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('weathered_hollow_tool',s3d.poly(opening),diameter), x=-130,y=180,z=620,rx=90)
    body = s3d.cut(body,cutter)
    back = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('dark_hollow_back', s3d.poly(opening),12), x=-130,y=172,z=620,rx=90)
    s3d.material(back,'bark',color='#2d241d',roughness=1)
    rim_path = [(-hollow_w*.51,-720,830),(-hollow_w*.61,-650,1400),(-hollow_w*.45,-500,2250),(-170,-430,2680),(230,-490,2200),(390,-650,1450),(240,-780,850)]
    lip = s3d.wire('worn_hollow_lip',rim_path,95)
    s3d.material(lip,'bark',color='#967043',roughness=1)
    knots = []
    for name, origin, size in [('low_knot',(580,-80,1700),(780,790,1050)),('shoulder_knot',(-540,210,3260),(770,800,1000))]:
        knot = s3d.at(angular_mass(name, size, seed+rng.randrange(100,900)), x=origin[0],y=origin[1],z=origin[2])
        s3d.material(knot,'bark',color='#755039',roughness=1)
        knots.append(knot)
    return s3d.assembly('ancient_trunk',body,back,lip,knots,crown=s3d.Frame((-100,100,height*.59)),root_base=s3d.Frame((0,0,0)))


def knotted_roots(trunk, ground, seed=0, spread=2400, count=7, base_d=670):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    roots = []
    sites = s3d.ring(count,spread,start=8).jitter(rz=11,seed=seed+1)
    base = s3d.bbox(trunk, '-Z').origin
    soil_z = s3d.bbox(ground, '+Z').origin.z
    center = s3d.Frame((base.x,base.y,soil_z)).origin
    for i,f in enumerate(sites):
        factor = rng.uniform(.8,1.14)
        x,y = f.origin.x*factor,f.origin.y*factor
        hit = s3d.snap(ground,[s3d.Frame((center.x+x,center.y+y,2000))],direction='-Z')[0].origin
        path=[(center.x+x*.12,center.y+y*.12,center.z+390),(center.x+x*.40,center.y+y*.40,center.z+210),(center.x+x*.72,center.y+y*.72,hit.z+90),(hit.x,hit.y,hit.z-65)]
        root=s3d.wire('gripping_root_'+str(i),path,[(0,base_d),(.35,base_d*.84),(.73,base_d*.42),(1,70)])
        s3d.material(root,'bark',color=('#795638' if i%2 else '#694932'),roughness=1)
        roots.append(root)
    return s3d.group('knotted_roots',roots)


def crooked_limbs(seed=0, base_d=650):
    paths = [
        [(0,0,0),(-1000,-80,850),(-2200,-140,1050),(-3370,-80,1760)],
        [(0,0,180),(-600,250,1620),(-1750,480,2790),(-2480,580,3310)],
        [(80,40,1140),(700,90,2290),(420,160,3260),(1070,230,4170)],
        [(80,40,840),(1200,-110,1420),(2300,-190,2260),(3270,-100,2500)],
        [(0,0,300),(450,-700,1150),(1050,-1550,1790),(2010,-2100,2680)],
        [(0,0,740),(-600,900,1650),(-1250,1740,2400),(-1420,2240,3090)],
        [(80,40,1320),(800,900,1800),(2020,1560,2690),(2520,1870,3280)]
    ]
    branches=[]
    anchors={}
    for i,path in enumerate(paths):
        branch=s3d.wire('crooked_limb_'+str(i),path,[(0,base_d),(.4,base_d*.74),(.76,base_d*.45),(1,base_d*.16)])
        s3d.material(branch,'bark',color=('#715039' if i%2 else '#62422f'),roughness=1)
        branches.append(branch)
        anchors['tip'+str(i)]=s3d.Frame(path[-1])
        anchors['fork'+str(i)]=s3d.Frame(path[-2])
    return s3d.assembly('crooked_limbs',branches,**anchors)


def exposed_twigs(limbs, seed=0, length=1000, diameter=140):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    twigs=[]
    for i in range(7):
        socket=s3d.local(limbs, *tuple(getattr(limbs,'tip'+str(i)).origin))
        for k in range(2):
            side=-1 if k==0 else 1
            reach=length*rng.uniform(.68,1.2)
            points=[(0,0,0),(side*reach*.3,reach*.1,reach*.55),(side*reach*.83,reach*.22,reach*.83)]
            twig=s3d.wire('exposed_twig',points,[(0,diameter),(1,diameter*.24)])
            s3d.material(twig,'bark',color='#73513b',roughness=1)
            twigs.append(s3d.at(twig,on=socket))
    broken_path=[(0,0,0),(-300,-180,550),(-660,-310,800)]
    broken=s3d.wire('blunt_broken_limb',broken_path,[(0,340),(1,210)])
    s3d.material(broken,'bark',color='#72513a',roughness=1)
    tip=s3d.along(broken_path,count=2)[-1]
    cap=s3d.at(s3d.extrude('pale_broken_end',s3d.circle(193),8),on=tip)
    s3d.material(cap,'oak',color='#be9762',roughness=1)
    stump=s3d.group('broken_snag',broken,cap)
    twigs.append(s3d.at(stump,on=s3d.local(limbs, *tuple(limbs.fork0.origin))))
    return s3d.group('exposed_twigs',twigs)


def autumn_foliage(limbs, seed=0, width=1850, depth=1650, height=1300):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    colors=['#bd882e','#b75c2a','#943e2a','#cf9b3b','#a94a29']
    clouds=[]
    for i in range(7):
        for k in range(3):
            if k==1 and i in (0,3,6):
                continue
            anchor=s3d.local(limbs, *tuple(getattr(limbs,('tip' if k!=2 else 'fork')+str(i)).origin))
            sizes=(width*rng.uniform(.75,1.18),depth*rng.uniform(.78,1.12),height*rng.uniform(.76,1.15))
            cloud=angular_mass('autumn_cluster_'+str(i)+'_'+str(k),sizes,seed+100*i+k)
            s3d.material(cloud,'leaf',color=colors[(i+k)%len(colors)],roughness=.95)
            cloud=s3d.at(cloud,on=anchor.move(x=(-1 if k==0 else 1)*width*.23,y=rng.uniform(-250,250),z=-sizes[2]*.48 if k!=1 else -sizes[2]*.20),rz=rng.uniform(-30,30))
            clouds.append(cloud)
    return s3d.group('autumn_foliage',clouds)


def angular_mass(name, size, seed=0, samples=17):
    w,d,h=size
    sites=s3d.scatter(samples,(w,d,h),seed=seed,surface=True,on=s3d.Frame((0,0,h/2)))
    sites=sites.jitter(x=w*.08,y=d*.08,z=h*.07,seed=seed+1)
    return s3d.hull(name,[f.origin for f in sites])


def rear_craggy_rise(ground, seed=0, width=1900, height=2050):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    sites=s3d.grid(5,1,px=1650).move(y=2860,z=250)
    crags=[]
    for i,f in enumerate(sites):
        h=height*(.48 if i==2 else rng.uniform(.70,1.12))
        mass=angular_mass('rear_slate_crag',(width,width*.87,h),seed+30+i,samples=12)
        s3d.material(mass,'rock',color=('#686e72' if i%2 else '#7b8183'),roughness=1)
        crags.append(s3d.at(mass,on=f,rz=rng.uniform(-30,30)))
    return s3d.group('rear_craggy_rise',crags)


def scattered_rocks(ground, seed=0, count=20, width=580):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    candidates=s3d.scatter(count*4,ground,seed=seed)
    kept=[f for f in candidates if f.normal.z>.9 and f.origin.x**2+f.origin.y**2>1900**2 and f.origin.y<2150][:count]
    stones=[]
    for i,f in enumerate(kept):
        w=width*rng.uniform(.48,1.7)
        stone=angular_mass('slate_rock',(w,w*rng.uniform(.7,1.2),w*.63),seed+100+i,samples=11)
        s3d.material(stone,'rock',color=('#777d7e' if i%2 else '#5d686f'),roughness=1)
        stones.append(s3d.at(stone,on=f.offset(-w*.1),rz=rng.uniform(0,180)))
    return s3d.group('scattered_rocks',stones)


def sparse_grass_tufts(ground, seed=0, samples=400, height=250, width=43):
    sites=s3d.scatter(samples,ground,seed=seed)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.normal.z>.9 and f.origin.y<2300 and (f.origin.x+300)**2+(f.origin.y+400)**2>2200**2]
    colors=['#b7a05d','#7e804b']
    grasses=[]
    for i,color in enumerate(colors):
        frames=s3d.Frames(kept[i::2])
        grass=s3d.tufts('separate_grass_tufts',frames,height=height,width=width,blades=5,lean=32,shape='cone',seed=seed+10+i)
        s3d.material(grass,'grass',color=color,roughness=1)
        grasses.append(grass)
    return s3d.group('sparse_grass_tufts',grasses)


def fallen_leaves(ground, seed=0, samples=180, length=145):
    sites=s3d.scatter(samples,ground,seed=seed)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.normal.z>.9 and f.origin.y<2300 and f.origin.x**2+f.origin.y**2>1300**2]
    leaves=[]
    colors=['#bc782c','#aa492b','#d19d40']
    for i,color in enumerate(colors):
        leaf=s3d.extrude('fallen_angular_leaf',s3d.poly([(0,-length/2),(length*.36,0),(0,length/2),(-length*.30,0)]),9)
        s3d.material(leaf,'leaf',color=color,roughness=1)
        frames=s3d.Frames(kept[i::3]).offset(4).jitter(rz=180,seed=seed+1+i)
        leaves.append(s3d.at(leaf,on=frames))
    return s3d.group('fallen_leaves',leaves)

import sand3d as s3d
import random

def alien_tree_fern_vignette(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(6, smooth=False)
    ground = soil_patch(seed=seed + 1)
    trunk = s3d.at(tapered_trunk(seed=seed + 2), on=s3d.bbox(ground, '+Z').offset(-10))
    roots = root_flare(trunk, ground, seed=seed + 3)
    plates = bark_plates(trunk, seed=seed + 4)
    stubs = old_frond_bases(trunk, seed=seed + 5)
    crown = s3d.at(arching_frond_ribs(seed=seed + 6), on=trunk.face('end'))
    rocks = exposed_charcoal_rocks(ground, seed=seed + 7)
    moss = sparse_moss_cushions(ground, seed=seed + 8)
    return s3d.assembly('alien_tree_fern_vignette', ground, trunk, roots, plates, stubs, crown, rocks, moss)

def soil_patch(seed=0, radius=1500, depth=180, ratio=0.91, edge=120):
    ring = s3d.ring(9, radius).jitter(x=90, y=90, seed=seed)
    pts = []
    for f in ring:
        p = f.origin
        pts.extend([(p.x * ratio, p.y * ratio * ratio, 0), (p.x, p.y * ratio, depth - edge / 2), (p.x * ratio, p.y * ratio * ratio, depth)])
    pts.append((0, 0, depth + 20))
    ob = s3d.hull('bounded_rust_soil', pts)
    s3d.material(ob, 'soil', color='#87462f', roughness=1)
    return ob

def tapered_trunk(seed=0, height=2860, base=540, neck=300, drift=35):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    dx = rng.uniform(-drift, drift)
    ob = s3d.loft('stout_plum_trunk', s3d.station(0, base, base), s3d.station(height * 0.18, base * 0.9, base * 0.93, x=dx), s3d.station(height * 0.58, base * 0.72, base * 0.74, x=-dx), s3d.station(height, neck, neck, x=dx))
    s3d.material(ob, 'bark', color='#352039', roughness=1)
    return ob

def root_flare(trunk, ground, seed=0, count=7, reach=540, rise=370, width=160):
    foot = s3d.bbox(trunk, '-Z').origin
    sites = s3d.ring(count, reach).jitter(x=60, y=60, seed=seed)
    roots = []
    for i, f in enumerate(sites):
        p = f.origin
        hit = s3d.snap(ground, [s3d.Frame((p.x, p.y, foot.z + rise))], direction='-Z')[0].origin
        tx, ty = (-p.y / reach * width / 2, p.x / reach * width / 2)
        points = [(p.x * 0.35 + tx, p.y * 0.35 + ty, foot.z - 15), (p.x * 0.35 - tx, p.y * 0.35 - ty, foot.z - 15), (p.x * 0.3, p.y * 0.3, foot.z + rise), (hit.x + tx * 0.3, hit.y + ty * 0.3, hit.z - 15), (hit.x - tx * 0.3, hit.y - ty * 0.3, hit.z - 15), (hit.x * 0.7, hit.y * 0.7, hit.z + width * 0.4)]
        roots.append(s3d.hull('angular_root_%s' % i, points))
    ob = s3d.group('root_flare', roots)
    s3d.material(ob, 'bark', color='#3e2543', roughness=1)
    return ob

def bark_plates(trunk, seed=0, count=78, margin=150):
    bottom = s3d.bbox(trunk, '-Z').origin.z
    top = s3d.bbox(trunk, '+Z').origin.z
    sites = s3d.scatter(count, trunk, seed=seed)
    kept = [f for f in sites if abs(f.normal.z) < 0.5 and bottom + margin < f.origin.z < top - margin]
    plates = [s3d.at(bark_plate(seed=seed + 100 + i), on=f) for i, f in enumerate(kept)]
    return s3d.group('bark_plates', plates)

def bark_plate(seed=0, width=170, height=300, relief=52):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    w = width * rng.uniform(0.85, 1.15)
    ob = s3d.hull('chunky_bark_plate', [(-w / 2, -height * 0.3, -10), (0, -height / 2, 0), (w / 2, -height * 0.3, -10), (w / 2, height * 0.3, -10), (0, height / 2, 0), (-w / 2, height * 0.3, -10), (0, -height * 0.12, relief), (0, height * 0.22, relief * 0.7)])
    s3d.material(ob, 'bark', color=rng.choice(['#4c2e50', '#422542', '#58364f', '#38223e']), roughness=1)
    return ob

def old_frond_bases(trunk, seed=0, count=18, band=900):
    top = s3d.bbox(trunk, '+Z').origin.z
    probes = s3d.phyllotaxis(count, d=650, h=band, on=s3d.Frame((0, 0, top - band)))
    sites = s3d.snap(trunk, probes)
    obs = [s3d.at(old_frond_base(seed=seed + 100 + i), on=f) for i, f in enumerate(sites)]
    return s3d.group('old_frond_bases', obs)

def old_frond_base(seed=0, length=320, width=110, thickness=65, lift=170):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    ob = s3d.loft('jagged_old_frond_base', s3d.station(0, width, thickness), s3d.station(length * 0.65, width * 0.7, thickness * 0.7, y=lift * 0.5), s3d.station(length, 0, 0, y=lift), tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(ob, 'bark', color=rng.choice(['#48264e', '#583354', '#38203e']), roughness=1)
    return ob

def arching_frond_ribs(seed=0, count=10, reach=2180, rise=630, rib=57):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    frames = s3d.ring(count, 95).jitter(rz=10, z=55, seed=seed)
    lengths = s3d.vary(reach, 300, count, seed=seed + 1)
    arches = s3d.vary(rise, 190, count, seed=seed + 2)
    fronds = []
    for i, (f, length, arch) in enumerate(zip(frames, lengths, arches)):
        if i % 4 == 1:
            length *= 0.72
            arch *= 1.45
        path = [(0, 0, 0), (0, length * 0.2, arch * 0.8), (0, length * 0.46, arch), (0, length * 0.72, arch * 0.68), (0, length * 0.9, arch * 0.13), (0, length, -arch * 0.28)]
        stem = s3d.wire('violet_angular_rachis', path, d=[(0, rib), (0.3, rib * 0.82), (0.75, rib * 0.43), (1, 6)])
        s3d.material(stem, 'plastic', color='#7b3a9c', roughness=0.88)
        color = '#b3df36' if i in (1, 4, 8) else '#16b9ad'
        foliage = paired_pointed_leaflets(path, length, color, seed=seed + 100 + i)
        frond = s3d.group('arching_frond_%s' % i, stem, foliage)
        fronds.append(s3d.at(frond, on=f))
    return s3d.group('arching_frond_ribs', fronds)

def paired_pointed_leaflets(path, reach, color, seed=0, pairs=13, spread=69, leaf_ratio=0.255):
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=pairs, span=(0.17, 0.97))
    lengths = s3d.vary(reach * leaf_ratio, reach * 0.018, pairs, seed=seed)
    obs = []
    for i, (f, length) in enumerate(zip(sites, lengths)):
        u = i / (pairs - 1)
        length *= (1 - u) * 0.86 + 0.14
        leaf = pointed_leaflet(seed=seed + 100 + i, length=length, color=color)
        pair = s3d.at(leaf, on=f.turn(ry=spread))
        other = s3d.at(pointed_leaflet(seed=seed + 200 + i, length=length * 0.96, color=color), on=f.turn(ry=-spread))
        obs.extend([pair, other])
    return s3d.group('paired_pointed_leaflets', obs)

def pointed_leaflet(seed=0, length=460, width_ratio=0.24, thickness=19, color='#16b9ad'):
    ob = s3d.loft('rigid_pointed_leaflet', s3d.station(0, 0, 0), s3d.station(length * 0.28, length * width_ratio, thickness, y=length * 0.035), s3d.station(length * 0.65, length * width_ratio * 0.63, thickness * 0.65, y=length * 0.07), s3d.station(length, 0, 0, y=length * 0.08), tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(ob, 'leaf', color=color, roughness=0.8)
    return ob

def exposed_charcoal_rocks(ground, seed=0, count=7, radius=1060):
    sites = s3d.ring(count, radius, start=15).jitter(x=180, y=130, rz=25, seed=seed).move(z=800)
    contacts = s3d.snap(ground, sites, direction='-Z')
    sizes = s3d.vary(370, 140, len(contacts), seed=seed + 1)
    obs = [s3d.at(charcoal_rock(seed=seed + 100 + i, size=size, height=size * 0.65), on=f.offset(-30)) for i, (f, size) in enumerate(zip(contacts, sizes))]
    return s3d.group('exposed_charcoal_rocks', obs)

def charcoal_rock(seed=0, size=380, height=260):
    sites = s3d.ring(6, size / 2).jitter(x=size * 0.17, y=size * 0.17, seed=seed)
    pts = []
    for f in sites:
        p = f.origin
        pts.extend([(p.x, p.y, 0), (p.x * 0.7, p.y * 0.65, height * 0.7)])
    pts.append((size * 0.1, 0, height))
    ob = s3d.hull('exposed_charcoal_rock', pts)
    s3d.material(ob, 'rock', color='#34343e', roughness=1)
    return ob

def sparse_moss_cushions(ground, seed=0, count=5, radius=880):
    probes = s3d.ring(count, radius, start=42).jitter(x=100, y=100, rz=35, seed=seed).move(z=800)
    sites = s3d.snap(ground, probes, direction='-Z')
    sizes = s3d.vary(420, 100, len(sites), seed=seed + 1)
    obs = [s3d.at(moss_cushion(seed=seed + 100 + i, width=size, depth=size * 0.75), on=f.offset(-10)) for i, (f, size) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes))]
    return s3d.group('sparse_moss_cushions', obs)

def moss_cushion(seed=0, width=430, depth=320, height=95):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    ob = s3d.loft('separate_chartreuse_moss_cushion', s3d.station(0, width * 0.85, depth * 0.85), s3d.station(height * 0.4, width, depth), s3d.station(height, width * 0.55, depth * 0.6, x=width * 0.07), s3d.station(height * 1.13, 0, 0, x=width * 0.1))
    s3d.material(ob, 'moss', color=rng.choice(['#b5d82b', '#c6e03b', '#9dc52d']), roughness=1)
    return ob

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random

def solitary_dead_tree(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    trunk = irregular_trunk(seed=seed + 1)
    roots = flared_roots(seed=seed + 2)
    left = s3d.at(left_primary_limb(seed=seed + 3), on=trunk.left)
    right = s3d.at(right_primary_limb(seed=seed + 4), on=trunk.right)
    rear = s3d.at(rear_secondary_limb(seed=seed + 5), on=trunk.rear)
    front = s3d.at(front_broken_limb(seed=seed + 6), on=trunk.front)
    crown = s3d.at(upper_crown_forks(seed=seed + 7), on=trunk.crown)
    return s3d.assembly('solitary_dead_tree', trunk, roots, left, right, rear, front, crown)

def irregular_trunk(seed=0, height=7900, base_d=940):
    pts = [(0, 0, 0), (95, -45, height * 0.17), (-130, 60, height * 0.38), (190, 95, height * 0.57), (65, 110, height * 0.75), (355, 165, height * 0.91), (280, 185, height)]
    wood = angular_wood('irregular_trunk', pts, base_d, end_d=210, seed=seed, endgrain=False)
    knots = [s3d.at(knotted_junctions_and_breaks(seed=seed + 10 + i, width=w), on=s3d.Frame(pts[k])) for i, (k, w) in enumerate([(2, 610), (3, 490), (4, 350)])]
    fissures = bark_crevices(wood, pts, base_d, seed=seed + 30)
    breakwood = s3d.at(exposed_break(seed=seed + 40, width=178, length=165), on=tip_frame(pts))
    return s3d.assembly('trunk', wood, knots, fissures, breakwood, left=s3d.Frame(pts[2]), right=s3d.Frame(pts[3]), rear=s3d.Frame(tuple((np.array(pts[2]) + np.array(pts[3])) / 2)), front=s3d.Frame(pts[2]), crown=s3d.Frame(pts[4]))

def angular_wood(name, points, diameter, end_d=20, seed=0, endgrain=True):
    wood = s3d.wire(name, points, d=[(0, diameter), (0.24, diameter * 0.77), (0.57, diameter * 0.48), (0.82, diameter * 0.25), (1, end_d)], tip='sharp')

    def bark(x, y, z, n, u):
        grain = s3d.noise(x / 260 + seed * 7, y / 260, z / 550, seed=seed)
        dark = grain < -0.18
        light = grain > 0.24
        base = np.where(dark[:, None], np.array([0.21, 0.2, 0.18]), np.array([0.36, 0.33, 0.29]))
        base = np.where(light[:, None], np.array([0.46, 0.43, 0.38]), base)
        return np.where((u > 0.999)[:, None], np.array([0.67, 0.61, 0.5]), base)

    def bark_without_endgrain(x, y, z):
        return bark(x, y, z, None, np.zeros_like(z))
    s3d.material(wood, 'bark', color=bark if endgrain else bark_without_endgrain, roughness=1)
    return wood

def knotted_junctions_and_breaks(seed=0, width=460):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    depth = width * 0.73
    height = width * 0.94
    knot = s3d.hull('solid_angular_knot', [(-width * 0.48, 0, 0), (width * 0.5, 0, 0), (0, -depth * 0.5, 0), (0, depth * 0.5, 0), (-width * 0.35, -depth * 0.22, height * 0.53), (width * 0.44, depth * 0.18, height * 0.42), (0, -depth * 0.32, height * 0.7), (width * rng.uniform(-0.15, 0.15), 0, height)])
    s3d.material(knot, 'bark', color='#49443c', roughness=1)
    return knot

def bark_crevices(wood, axis, diameter, seed=0, width=62, length=880, depth=22):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    probes = [s3d.Frame((p[0], -diameter, p[2])) for p in [(np.array(a) + np.array(b)) / 2 for a, b in zip(axis[:-2], axis[1:-1])]]
    hits = list(s3d.snap(wood, s3d.Frames(probes), direction='+Y'))
    side_probes = [s3d.Frame((diameter, p[1], p[2])) for p in [(np.array(a) + np.array(b)) / 2 for a, b in zip(axis[:-2], axis[1:-1])]]
    hits += list(s3d.snap(wood, s3d.Frames(side_probes), direction='-X'))
    details = []
    for f in hits:
        w = width * rng.uniform(0.7, 1.3)
        h = length * rng.uniform(0.65, 1.15)
        outline = s3d.poly([(0, -h / 2), (-w / 2, -h * 0.2), (-w * 0.18, h * 0.21), (0, h / 2), (w * 0.32, h * 0.12), (w * 0.2, -h * 0.3)])
        s3d.pocket(wood, outline, depth=depth, on=f)
        crease = s3d.extrude('recessed_charcoal_fissure', outline, 1, on=f.offset(-depth + 1))
        s3d.material(crease, 'bark', color='#27251f', roughness=1)
        details.append(crease)
    return s3d.group('bark_crevices', details)

def exposed_break(seed=0, width=190, length=160):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    short = length * rng.uniform(0.2, 0.4)
    a = width / 2
    core = s3d.hull('pale_splintered_heartwood', [(-a, -a, -length * 0.12), (a, -a, -length * 0.12), (a, a, -length * 0.12), (-a, a, -length * 0.12), (-a, -a, short), (a, -a, length * 0.65), (a, a, length), (-a, a, length * 0.42)])
    s3d.material(core, 'bark', color='#b6a58a', roughness=1)
    return core

def tip_frame(points):
    a, b = (np.array(points[-2]), np.array(points[-1]))
    return s3d.Frame(tuple(b), normal=tuple(b - a))

def flared_roots(seed=0, count=5, reach=1440, height=720, width=580):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sites = s3d.ring(count, r=0, start=12).jitter(rz=13, seed=seed + 1)
    roots = [s3d.at(root_buttress(seed=seed + 20 + i, length=reach * rng.uniform(0.72, 1.12), height=height * rng.uniform(0.7, 1.1), width=width * rng.uniform(0.74, 1.08)), on=f) for i, f in enumerate(sites)]
    return s3d.group('flared_roots', roots)

def root_buttress(seed=0, length=1400, height=720, width=550):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    skew = width * rng.uniform(-0.22, 0.22)
    points = [(-width / 2, -width / 2, 0), (-width / 2, width / 2, 0), (0, -width / 2, height * 0.42), (0, width / 2, height * 0.4), (0, 0, height), (length * 0.52, -width * 0.25, height * 0.2), (length * 0.57, width * 0.19, height * 0.24), (length, -width * 0.08, 0), (length, width * 0.08, 0), (length * 0.91, skew, height * 0.055)]
    root = s3d.hull('angular_root_buttress', points)
    s3d.material(root, 'bark', color='#514b42', roughness=1)
    return root

def left_primary_limb(seed=0, reach=1950, rise=2410, diameter=385):
    main = [(0, 0, 0), (-reach * 0.32, -40, rise * 0.15), (-reach * 0.68, -120, rise * 0.33), (-reach * 0.91, -60, rise * 0.71), (-reach, 0, rise)]
    fork = [main[2], (-reach * 1.08, -300, rise * 0.44), (-reach * 1.33, -270, rise * 0.73), (-reach * 1.42, -250, rise * 0.86)]
    side = [main[3], (-reach * 0.74, -260, rise * 0.95), (-reach * 0.78, -310, rise * 1.14)]
    return limb_bundle('left_primary_limb', [main, fork, side], [diameter, diameter * 0.46, diameter * 0.22], seed=seed, twig_length=520)

def limb_bundle(name, paths, diameters, seed=0, twig_length=500):
    bodies = [angular_wood(name + '_wood_' + str(i), p, d, end_d=max(42, d * 0.12), seed=seed + 20 * i) for i, (p, d) in enumerate(zip(paths, diameters))]
    twigs = [s3d.at(terminal_twigs(seed=seed + 100 + i, length=twig_length, diameter=max(42, d * 0.12)), on=tip_frame(p)) for i, (p, d) in enumerate(zip(paths, diameters))]
    knot = knotted_junctions_and_breaks(seed=seed + 200, width=diameters[0] * 1.45)
    return s3d.group(name, bodies, twigs, knot)

def terminal_twigs(seed=0, length=500, diameter=42):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    length *= rng.uniform(0.7, 1.15)
    lean = length * rng.uniform(-0.28, 0.32)
    depth = length * rng.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)
    spread = length * rng.uniform(0.28, 0.54)
    axis = [(0, 0, 0), (lean * 0.4, 0, length * 0.48), (lean, depth, length)]
    fork = [axis[1], (-spread, depth * 0.5, length * 0.73), (-spread * 1.16, depth * 0.7, length * 0.91)]
    a = angular_wood('bare_terminal_twig', axis, diameter, end_d=23, seed=seed + 1)
    b = angular_wood('broken_twig_fork', fork, diameter * 0.78, end_d=19, seed=seed + 2)
    return s3d.group('terminal_twigs', a, b)

def right_primary_limb(seed=0, reach=1950, rise=2390, diameter=310):
    main = [(0, 0, 0), (reach * 0.35, 30, rise * 0.13), (reach * 0.64, 100, rise * 0.46), (reach * 0.85, 140, rise * 0.76), (reach, 130, rise)]
    fork = [main[1], (reach * 0.64, -100, rise * 0.2), (reach * 1.12, -120, rise * 0.43), (reach * 1.34, -70, rise * 0.75)]
    side = [main[2], (reach * 0.56, 350, rise * 0.76), (reach * 0.66, 390, rise * 0.99)]
    return limb_bundle('right_primary_limb', [main, fork, side], [diameter, diameter * 0.64, diameter * 0.31], seed=seed, twig_length=490)

def rear_secondary_limb(seed=0, reach=1570, rise=2580, diameter=285):
    main = [(0, 0, 0), (180, reach * 0.4, rise * 0.16), (-290, reach * 0.72, rise * 0.42), (-380, reach * 0.91, rise * 0.76), (-180, reach, rise)]
    fork = [main[2], (280, reach * 0.94, rise * 0.61), (600, reach * 1.13, rise * 0.91)]
    return limb_bundle('rear_secondary_limb', [main, fork], [diameter, diameter * 0.48], seed=seed, twig_length=460)

def front_broken_limb(seed=0, reach=1330, rise=860, diameter=350):
    main = [(0, 0, 0), (-200, -reach * 0.32, rise * 0.16), (-450, -reach * 0.7, rise * 0.65), (-280, -reach, rise)]
    spur = [main[1], (-650, -reach * 0.51, rise * 0.76), (-710, -reach * 0.53, rise * 1.1)]
    broken = angular_wood('heavy_broken_front_limb', main, diameter, end_d=210, seed=seed)
    small = angular_wood('front_broken_spur', spur, diameter * 0.32, end_d=36, seed=seed + 1)
    knot = s3d.at(knotted_junctions_and_breaks(seed=seed + 2, width=diameter * 1.25), on=s3d.Frame(main[0]))
    breakwood = s3d.at(exposed_break(seed=seed + 3, width=190, length=140), on=tip_frame(main))
    return s3d.group('front_broken_limb', broken, small, knot, breakwood)

def upper_crown_forks(seed=0, rise=1870, diameter=230):
    main = [(0, 0, 0), (-370, -150, rise * 0.32), (-630, -180, rise * 0.76), (-520, -200, rise)]
    fork = [main[1], (-980, -80, rise * 0.54), (-1140, -100, rise * 0.83)]
    other = [(0, 0, 0), (430, 350, rise * 0.4), (720, 400, rise * 0.78)]
    return limb_bundle('upper_crown_forks', [main, fork, other], [diameter, diameter * 0.48, diameter * 0.64], seed=seed, twig_length=360)

import sand3d as s3d
import random

def freestanding_faceted_rose(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    roots = splayed_root_base(seed=seed + 1)
    stem = s3d.at(bent_stem(seed=seed + 2), z=55)
    sepals = s3d.at(angular_sepals(seed=seed + 3), on=stem.bloom)
    outer = s3d.at(outer_petals(seed=seed + 4), on=stem.bloom)
    middle = s3d.at(middle_petals(seed=seed + 5), on=stem.bloom)
    center = s3d.at(spiral_center(seed=seed + 6), on=stem.bloom)
    low = s3d.at(leaf_branch(length=225, seed=seed + 7), on=stem.low.turn(rz=195, ry=63))
    high = s3d.at(leaf_branch(length=205, seed=seed + 8), on=stem.high.turn(rz=15, ry=66))
    back = s3d.at(leaf_branch(length=157, seed=seed + 9), on=stem.back.turn(rz=110, ry=58))
    return s3d.assembly('freestanding_faceted_rose', roots, stem, sepals, outer, middle, center, low, high, back)

def splayed_root_base(seed=0, spread=138, height=64, root_d=32, count=5):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    crown = s3d.cone('root_crown', root_d * 2, height, d2=root_d)
    s3d.material(crown, 'bark', color='#344c2a', roughness=1)
    roots = []
    frames = s3d.ring(count, 0).jitter(rz=12, seed=seed + 1)
    for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
        reach = spread * rng.uniform(0.8, 1)
        root = s3d.wire('angular_root_' + str(i), [(0, 0, height * 0.7), (reach * 0.45, 0, height * 0.4), (reach, 0, root_d * 0.13)], d=[(0, root_d), (1, root_d * 0.25)])
        s3d.material(root, 'bark', color='#3e4d2c', roughness=1)
        roots.append(s3d.at(root, on=frame))
    return s3d.group('splayed_root_base', crown, roots)

def bent_stem(seed=0, height=995, diameter=30, lean=40, sway=28):
    path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (-sway, 8, height * 0.28), (8, -10, height * 0.56), (lean, 0, height * 0.82), (lean, 0, height)])
    stem = s3d.wire('faceted_green_stem', path, d=[(0, diameter), (1, diameter * 0.65)])
    s3d.material(stem, 'leaf', color='#34623a', roughness=0.9)
    tip = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]
    branches = s3d.along(path, count=3, span=(0.39, 0.74))
    return s3d.assembly('bent_stem', stem, bloom=tip, low=branches[0], back=branches[1], high=branches[2])

def angular_sepals(seed=0, count=5, length=135, width=48, flare=95):
    frames = s3d.ring(count, 13, start=18).jitter(rz=8, rx=4, seed=seed + 1)
    sepal = s3d.loft('pointed_folded_sepal', s3d.station(0, width * 0.22, 8), s3d.station(length * 0.36, width, 12, y=flare * 0.36), s3d.station(length, 0, 0, y=flare))
    s3d.material(sepal, 'leaf', color='#295334', roughness=0.95)
    sepals = s3d.at(sepal, on=frames, z=-18)
    calyx = s3d.cone('angular_calyx', 44, 62, d2=91)
    s3d.material(calyx, 'leaf', color='#315c34', roughness=0.95)
    return s3d.group('angular_sepals', s3d.at(calyx, z=-42), sepals)

def outer_petals(seed=0):
    return petal_whorl('outer_petals', seed=seed, count=7, radius=28, height=260, width=227, flare=185, base_z=0, color='#a91f3e')

def petal_whorl(name, seed=0, count=7, radius=28, height=260, width=227, flare=185, base_z=0, color='#a91f3e', inward=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    frames = s3d.ring(count, radius, start=rng.uniform(0, 360)).turn(rz=-90)
    petals = []
    for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
        h = height * rng.uniform(0.94, 1.05)
        wrap = 1 - inward * i / (count - 1)
        w = width * rng.uniform(0.92, 1.08) * (1 + wrap) / 2
        f = flare * rng.uniform(0.92, 1.06) * wrap
        petal = angular_petal(name + '_petal_' + str(i), seed=seed + 100 + i, height=h, width=w, flare=f, color=color)
        petals.append(s3d.at(petal, on=frame.turn(rz=rng.uniform(-9, 9), rx=rng.uniform(-3, 3)), z=base_z + i * 1.7))
    return s3d.group(name, petals)

def angular_petal(name, seed=0, height=260, width=227, flare=185, thickness=9, color='#a91f3e'):
    petal = s3d.loft(name, s3d.station(0, width * 0.12, thickness, y=0), s3d.station(height * 0.33, width * 0.62, thickness * 1.2, y=flare * 0.12, x=-width * 0.08), s3d.station(height * 0.72, width, thickness * 1.7, y=flare * 0.58, x=-width * 0.04), s3d.station(height * 0.91, width * 0.86, thickness, y=flare, x=width * 0.08), s3d.station(height, 0, 0, y=flare * 1.06, x=width * 0.38), tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(petal, 'plastic', color=color, roughness=1)
    return petal

def middle_petals(seed=0):
    return petal_whorl('middle_petals', seed=seed, count=6, radius=19, height=292, width=164, flare=112, base_z=12, color='#961830')

def spiral_center(seed=0):
    return petal_whorl('spiral_center', seed=seed, count=7, radius=5, height=309, width=100, flare=50, base_z=18, color='#681027', inward=0.86)

def leaf_branch(seed=0, length=210, petiole=52):
    path = [(0, 0, 0), (0, 0, petiole * 0.55), (0, -8, petiole)]
    stalk = s3d.wire('angular_leaf_petiole', path, d=[(0, 10), (1, 5)])
    s3d.material(stalk, 'leaf', color='#365f34', roughness=1)
    tip = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]
    leaf = s3d.at(serrated_folded_leaves(seed=seed + 1, length=length), on=tip)
    return s3d.group('leaf_branch', stalk, leaf)

def serrated_folded_leaves(seed=0, length=210, width=100, ridge=15, teeth=6):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sections = [s3d.station(0, 0, 0)]
    for i in range(1, teeth * 2):
        u = i / (teeth * 2)
        envelope = (1 - abs(2 * u - 1)) ** 0.7
        tooth = 1 if i % 2 else 0.79
        w = width * envelope * tooth * rng.uniform(0.96, 1.04)
        sections.append(s3d.station(length * u, w, ridge * envelope, y=-ridge * u * u))
    sections.append(s3d.station(length, 0, 0, y=-ridge))
    blade = s3d.loft('continuous_serrated_folded_leaf', *sections, tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(blade, 'leaf', color='#2c5b35', roughness=1)
    return blade

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np

def hedge_crescent(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    crown = root_crown(seed=seed + 1)
    leaders = woody_leaders(seed=seed + 2)
    foliage = s3d.at(crescent_foliage(seed=seed + 3), z=340)
    return s3d.assembly('hedge_crescent', crown, leaders, foliage)

def root_crown(seed=1, width=760, depth=500, height=230, root_d=90):
    sites = s3d.scatter(17, (width, depth, height), surface=True, seed=seed, on=s3d.Frame((0, 180, height / 2)))
    stool = s3d.hull('angular_root_stool', sites)
    s3d.material(stool, 'bark', color='#443323', roughness=1)
    roots = []
    paths = [[(0, 180, 150), (-260, 240, 70), (-570, 310, 0)], [(100, 180, 140), (330, 90, 55), (560, -40, 0)], [(-60, 150, 140), (-210, -70, 40), (-300, -180, 0)], [(0, 230, 130), (160, 410, 50), (290, 520, 0)]]
    for path in paths:
        root = s3d.wire('buttress_root', path, d=[(0, root_d), (1, 0)], tip='sharp')
        s3d.material(root, 'bark', color='#52402b', roughness=1)
        roots.append(root)
    return s3d.group('root_crown', stool, *roots)

def woody_leaders(seed=2, spread=760, stem_h=590, base_y=180, diameter=92):
    paths = [[(-spread * 0.22, base_y, 100), (-spread * 0.45, base_y + 70, 280), (-spread, base_y + 20, stem_h)], [(spread * 0.1, base_y, 90), (spread * 0.18, base_y + 140, 320), (spread * 0.48, base_y + 240, stem_h + 100)], [(spread * 0.27, base_y, 110), (spread * 0.65, base_y - 100, 330), (spread, base_y - 230, stem_h - 80)], [(-spread * 0.1, base_y, 100), (-spread * 0.28, base_y + 230, 390), (-spread * 0.35, base_y + 350, stem_h + 100)]]
    stems = []
    for i, path in enumerate(paths):
        trunk = s3d.wire('woody_leader', path, d=[(0, diameter), (1, diameter * 0.46)])
        s3d.material(trunk, 'bark', color='#4b3827' if i % 2 else '#5b4830', roughness=1)
        stems.append(trunk)
    return s3d.group('woody_leaders', *stems)

def crescent_foliage(seed=3, width=2300, depth=1400, height=1370, relief=48):
    outline = [(1, -0.5), (0.98, -0.15), (0.83, 0.18), (0.55, 0.43), (0.2, 0.5), (-0.2, 0.49), (-0.57, 0.38), (-0.86, 0.12), (-1, -0.2), (-0.96, -0.5), (-0.76, -0.28), (-0.5, -0.08), (-0.23, 0.04), (0.1, 0.075), (0.42, -0.015), (0.7, -0.22), (0.9, -0.46)]
    profile = s3d.poly([(x * width / 2, y * depth) for x, y in outline])
    hedge = s3d.extrude('continuous_clipped_foliage', profile, height)

    def clipped_height(x, y, z):
        tip = np.clip((depth / 2 - y) / depth, 0, 1)
        return np.clip(0.12 * z / height - (0.22 + 0.78 * z / height) * tip ** 1.7, -1, 1)
    hedge = s3d.displace(hedge, 650, 400, noise=clipped_height, direction='+Z', step=215)
    hedge = s3d.displace(hedge, relief, 330, seed=seed, step=0)

    def leaf_palette(x, y, z):
        radial = np.sqrt((x / (width / 2)) ** 2 + ((y + depth * 0.46) / (depth * 0.85)) ** 2)
        inner = np.clip((0.96 - radial) * 3, 0, 1)
        fleck = np.mod(np.sin(x * 0.041 + y * 0.063 + z * 0.027) * 43758.5453, 1)
        greens = np.where((fleck < 0.24)[:, None], np.array([0.3, 0.37, 0.115]), np.where((fleck > 0.72)[:, None], np.array([0.17, 0.29, 0.075]), np.array([0.105, 0.235, 0.075])))
        return greens * (1 - 0.34 * inner[:, None])
    s3d.material(hedge, 'leaf', color=leaf_palette, roughness=0.96)
    return hedge

import sand3d as s3d
import random
import math

def fantasy_forest_nandina(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    soil = bare_soil_patch(seed=seed + 1)
    bush = s3d.at(cane_cluster(seed=seed + 10), z=62)
    clods = earth_clods(soil, seed=seed + 20)
    stones = exposed_stones(soil, seed=seed + 30)
    return s3d.assembly('fantasy_forest_nandina', soil, bush, clods, stones)

def bare_soil_patch(seed=1, width=1060, depth=920, height=64, edge=45):
    rim = s3d.ring(11, width / 2).jitter(x=edge, y=edge, seed=seed)
    pts = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width, height) for f in rim]
    pts += [(p[0] * 0.88, p[1] * 0.88, 0) for p in pts]
    soil = s3d.hull('bounded_umber_soil', pts)
    s3d.material(soil, 'soil', color='#684331', roughness=1)
    return soil

def cane_cluster(seed=10, count=7, root_spread=105, low=760, high=1220, lean=145, cane_d=15):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    bases = s3d.ring(count - 1, root_spread).jitter(x=22, y=22, seed=seed + 1)
    bases = [s3d.Frame()] + list(bases)
    parts = []
    for i, base in enumerate(bases):
        height = rng.uniform(low, high)
        dx = rng.uniform(-lean, lean)
        dy = rng.uniform(-lean, lean)
        path = [(0, 0, 0), (dx * 0.28, dy * 0.28, height * 0.43), (dx * 0.7, dy * 0.7, height * 0.77), (dx, dy, height)]
        cane = s3d.wire('upright_ochre_cane', path, [(0, cane_d), (1, cane_d * 0.28)], tip='sharp')
        s3d.material(cane, 'bark', color='#98703e', roughness=0.9)
        children = [cane]
        sites = s3d.along(path, count=5, spin=137.508, span=(0.39, 0.94))
        sites = sites.turn(ry=66).jitter(ry=12, rz=24, seed=seed + 10 + i).turn(rz=-90)
        lengths = s3d.vary(355, 65, len(sites), seed=seed + 30 + i)
        for k, (site, length) in enumerate(zip(sites, lengths)):
            spray = compound_leaf_sprays(seed=seed + 100 + i * 20 + k, length=length)
            children.append(s3d.at(spray, on=site))
        young_site = s3d.along(path, count=2, span=(0.93, 1))[-1].turn(ry=57, rz=i * 45).turn(rz=-90)
        children.append(s3d.at(young_leaf_sprays(seed=seed + 400 + i, length=270), on=young_site))
        if i in (0, 2, 4, 6):
            berry_site = s3d.along(path, count=2, span=(0.8, 0.94))[-1].turn(rz=90).turn(ry=112)
            children.append(s3d.at(berry_panicles(seed=seed + 500 + i), on=berry_site))
        parts.append(s3d.at(s3d.group('leafy_cane', *children), on=base))
    return s3d.group('cane_cluster', *parts)

def compound_leaf_sprays(seed=100, length=350, spread=110, twig_d=3.8, young=False):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    path = [(0, 0, 0), (0, -length * 0.035, length * 0.48), (0, -length * 0.14, length)]
    stem = s3d.wire('golden_compound_petiole', path, [(0, twig_d), (1, twig_d * 0.25)], tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(stem, 'bark', color='#b6954e')
    parts = [stem]
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=3, span=(0.27, 0.77))
    sizes = s3d.vary(spread, spread * 0.13, len(sites), seed=seed + 1)
    for j, (site, size) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes)):
        one = secondary_leaf_axis(seed=seed + 20 + j, length=size, young=young)
        one = s3d.at(one, on=site.turn(ry=61, rz=rng.uniform(-12, 12)))
        other = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(one), mirror='x')
        parts.extend([one, other])
    terminal = secondary_leaf_axis(seed=seed + 30, length=spread * 1.02, young=young)
    parts.append(s3d.at(terminal, on=s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]))
    return s3d.group('compound_leaf_spray', *parts)

def secondary_leaf_axis(seed=120, length=110, stem_d=1.8, young=False):
    path = [(0, 0, 0), (0, 0, length)]
    stem = s3d.wire('fine_leaf_rachis', path, [(0, stem_d), (1, stem_d * 0.35)], tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(stem, 'bark', color='#bca052')
    parts = [stem]
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=2, span=(0.28, 0.67))
    for k, site in enumerate(sites):
        leaflet = lance_leaflet(seed=seed + k, length=length * 0.65, width=length * 0.225, young=young)
        placed = s3d.at(leaflet, on=site.turn(ry=58, rz=-8))
        opposite = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(placed), mirror='x')
        parts.extend([placed, opposite])
    tip = lance_leaflet(seed=seed + 3, length=length * 0.8, width=length * 0.25, young=young)
    parts.append(s3d.at(tip, on=s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]))
    return s3d.group('paired_leaflets_and_terminal', *parts)

def lance_leaflet(seed=1, length=70, width=24, fold=4, young=False):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    palette = ['#176246', '#247d55', '#429572', '#2c805d']
    copper = ['#b84e39', '#d46b43', '#aa473b']
    color = rng.choice(copper if young else palette)
    outline = [(0, 0, 0), (-width / 2, 0, length * 0.44), (0, 0, length), (width / 2, 0, length * 0.44)]
    top = s3d.hull('lanceolate_upper_leaf', outline + [(0, -fold, length * 0.43)])
    lower = s3d.hull('violet_leaf_underside', outline + [(0, fold * 0.26, length * 0.43)])
    s3d.material(top, 'leaf', color=color, roughness=0.8)
    s3d.material(lower, 'leaf', color='#665b78' if not young else '#8b4366', roughness=0.9)
    return s3d.group('pointed_flat_leaflet', top, lower)

def young_leaf_sprays(seed=200, length=270):
    return compound_leaf_sprays(seed=seed, length=length, spread=82, twig_d=3, young=True)

def berry_panicles(seed=500, length=245, spread=100, berry_d=30):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    path = [(0, 0, 0), (0, 0, length * 0.54), (0, 22, length)]
    axis = s3d.wire('panicle_axis', path, [(0, 4), (1, 1.5)], tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(axis, 'bark', color='#bd9b49')
    parts = [axis]
    branches = s3d.along(path, count=5, spin=137.508, span=(0.24, 0.88)).turn(ry=64)
    lengths = s3d.vary(spread, 25, len(branches), seed=seed + 1)
    for k, (site, reach) in enumerate(zip(branches, lengths)):
        branch = berry_branch(seed=seed + 10 + k, length=reach, berry_d=berry_d * rng.uniform(0.85, 1.13))
        parts.append(s3d.at(branch, on=site))
    return s3d.group('loose_scarlet_berry_panicle', *parts)

def berry_branch(seed=510, length=90, berry_d=22):
    path = [(0, 0, 0), (0, 0, length)]
    twig = s3d.wire('berry_panicle_twig', path, 2)
    s3d.material(twig, 'bark', color='#bb8c47')
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=4, spin=137.508, span=(0.3, 1)).turn(ry=67)
    berries = s3d.at(berry_with_stalk(seed=seed, berry_d=berry_d), on=sites)
    return s3d.group('open_berry_branch', twig, berries)

def berry_with_stalk(seed=520, berry_d=22, stalk=16):
    twig = s3d.cylinder('berry_pedicel', 1.2, stalk)
    s3d.material(twig, 'bark', color='#bb9446')
    berry = s3d.sphere('scarlet_faceted_berry', berry_d)
    s3d.material(berry, 'leaf', color=random.Random(seed).choice(['#dd332e', '#bf242a', '#e64a35']), roughness=0.7)
    berry = s3d.at(berry, z=stalk - berry_d * 0.15)
    return s3d.group('scarlet_berry_and_pedicel', twig, berry)

def earth_clods(soil, seed=20, count=15):
    sites = s3d.scatter(count, soil, seed=seed)
    sites = [f for f in sites if f.origin.z > 60 and f.origin.x ** 2 + f.origin.y ** 2 > 145 ** 2]
    sizes = s3d.vary(43, 20, len(sites), seed=seed + 1)
    pieces = [s3d.at(ground_stone(seed=seed + 10 + i, diameter=d, clod=True), on=f.offset(-10)) for i, (f, d) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes))]
    return s3d.group('angular_bare_earth_clods', *pieces)

def ground_stone(seed=50, diameter=100, clod=False):
    ring = s3d.ring(5, diameter / 2).jitter(x=diameter * 0.12, y=diameter * 0.12, seed=seed)
    pts = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y, diameter * 0.12) for f in ring]
    pts += [(f.origin.x * 0.65, f.origin.y * 0.65, diameter * 0.45) for f in ring]
    pts.append((0, 0, 0))
    rock = s3d.hull('angular_earth_clod' if clod else 'exposed_stone', pts)
    s3d.material(rock, 'soil' if clod else 'rock', color=random.Random(seed).choice(['#795039', '#8a5e3d', '#573a31'] if clod else ['#7d7c8c', '#928a98', '#6e7479']))
    return rock

def exposed_stones(soil, seed=30, count=12):
    sites = s3d.scatter(count, soil, seed=seed)
    sites = [f for f in sites if f.origin.z > 60 and f.origin.x ** 2 + f.origin.y ** 2 > 225 ** 2]
    sizes = s3d.vary(100, 30, len(sites), seed=seed + 1)
    pieces = [s3d.at(ground_stone(seed=seed + 20 + i, diameter=d), on=f.offset(-14)) for i, (f, d) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes))]
    return s3d.group('exposed_forest_stones', *pieces)

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random

def snowbound_boulder_cluster(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(6, smooth=False)
    ground = snow_ground(seed=seed + 1)
    layout = [(-700, 250, 1450, 1200, 1080, -8, -10, 14), (800, 650, 1100, 1050, 870, 9, 13, -21), (-100, -1050, 1050, 800, 690, 12, -6, 27), (1400, -850, 650, 600, 480, -10, 17, -16), (-900, 1400, 700, 650, 610, -12, -7, 39)]
    rocks = [embedded_boulder(ground, spec, seed=seed + 100 + i) for i, spec in enumerate(layout)]
    banks = [snow_buildup(ground, rock, seed=seed + 200 + i) for i, rock in enumerate(rocks)]
    return s3d.assembly('snowbound_boulder_cluster', ground, rocks, banks)

def snow_ground(seed=1, width=5000, depth=4600, thickness=270, relief=350, drift_size=1800, mesh_step=350, corner=330):
    ground = s3d.extrude('deep_snow_blanket', s3d.rect(width, depth, chamfer=corner), thickness)
    broad_wave = s3d.waves(drift_size, direction=25, spread=20, seed=seed)
    cross_wave = s3d.waves(drift_size * 1.6, direction=-65, spread=12, seed=seed + 1)

    def drifts(x, y, z):
        return 0.4 + 0.36 * broad_wave(x, y, z) + 0.22 * cross_wave(x, y, z)
    ground = s3d.displace(ground, relief, drift_size, noise=drifts, direction='+Z', faces='top', step=mesh_step)
    s3d.material(ground, 'snow', color=lambda x, y, z, n: np.array([0.4, 0.46, 0.55]) + np.clip(n[2], 0, 1)[:, None] ** 4 * np.array([0.11, 0.09, 0.06]), roughness=0.94)
    return ground

def embedded_boulder(ground, spec, seed=0, burial=0.14):
    x, y, width, depth, height, rx, ry, rz = spec
    hit = s3d.snap(ground, [(x, y, 3000)], direction='-Z')[0]
    stone = boulder_part(seed=seed, width=width, depth=depth, height=height)
    stone = s3d.at(stone, on=s3d.Frame((hit.origin.x, hit.origin.y, hit.origin.z - height * burial)), rx=rx, ry=ry, rz=rz)
    return stone

def boulder_part(seed=0, width=1450, depth=1200, height=1200, clip=0.24, shoulder=0.63, crown=0.72, irregularity=0.1):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    outline = [(-0.5 + clip, -0.5), (0.5 - clip, -0.5), (0.5, -0.5 + clip), (0.5, 0.5 - clip), (0.5 - clip, 0.5), (-0.5 + clip, 0.5), (-0.5, 0.5 - clip), (-0.5, -0.5 + clip)]
    points = []
    for level, size in [(0, 0.82), (shoulder, 1), (1, crown)]:
        for px, py in outline:
            points.append(((px * size + rng.uniform(-irregularity, irregularity)) * width, (py * size + rng.uniform(-irregularity, irregularity)) * depth, (level + rng.uniform(-irregularity, irregularity)) * height))
    rock = s3d.hull('angular_slate_boulder', points)

    def slate(x, y, z):
        patch = s3d.noise(x / width * 2, y / depth * 2, z / height * 2, seed=seed + 1)
        tone = 0.32 + 0.085 * patch
        return np.stack((tone * 0.87, tone * 0.96, tone * 1.08), axis=-1)
    s3d.material(rock, 'rock', color=slate, roughness=0.95)
    return rock

def snow_buildup(ground, rock, seed=0, spread=1.3, bank_height=210, sink=70):
    low = s3d.bbox(rock, '-X').origin
    high = s3d.bbox(rock, '+X').origin
    front = s3d.bbox(rock, '-Y').origin
    back = s3d.bbox(rock, '+Y').origin
    width = (high.x - low.x) * spread
    depth = (back.y - front.y) * spread
    cx, cy = ((low.x + high.x) / 2, (front.y + back.y) / 2)
    hit = s3d.snap(ground, [(cx, cy, 3000)], direction='-Z')[0]
    variation = s3d.vary(1, 0.07, 2, seed=seed)
    width, depth = (width * variation[0], depth * variation[1])
    mound = s3d.loft('snow_piled_at_rock_foot', s3d.station(0, width, depth), s3d.station(bank_height * 0.7, width * 0.81, depth * 0.81), s3d.station(bank_height, width * 0.52, depth * 0.52))
    s3d.material(mound, 'snow', color=lambda x, y, z, n: np.array([0.4, 0.46, 0.55]) + np.clip(n[2], 0, 1)[:, None] ** 4 * np.array([0.11, 0.09, 0.06]), roughness=0.94)
    return s3d.at(mound, x=cx, y=cy, z=hit.origin.z - sink)

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random

def spring_snow_limestone_cluster(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(10, smooth=False)
    tall = s3d.at(tall_limestone_outcrop(seed=seed + 10), x=-440, y=-170, rz=-16)
    medium = s3d.at(medium_limestone_outcrop(seed=seed + 20), x=480, y=-120, rz=24)
    low = s3d.at(low_limestone_outcrop(seed=seed + 30), y=460, rz=-20)
    return s3d.assembly('spring_snow_limestone_cluster', tall, medium, low)

def tall_limestone_outcrop(seed=0, w=820, d=730, h=1460, lean=-155):
    stone = limestone_body(w=w, d=d, h=h, lean=lean, seed=seed + 1)
    snow = tall_outcrop_snow(stone, w=w, d=d, h=h, lean=lean, seed=seed + 2)
    moss = spring_crevice_moss(stone, w=w, d=d, h=h, seed=seed + 3)
    return s3d.group('tall_limestone_outcrop', stone, snow, moss)

def limestone_body(w, d, h, lean, seed=0, bevel=0.11, crown=0.73, seam_depth=0.105):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    chipped_rectangle = [(-0.5, -0.27), (-0.3, -0.5), (0.28, -0.5), (0.5, -0.32), (0.5, 0.31), (0.29, 0.5), (-0.34, 0.5), (-0.5, 0.2)]
    radial = s3d.vary(1, 0.06, len(chipped_rectangle), seed=seed + 1)
    perimeter = [(px * w * r, py * d * r) for (px, py), r in zip(chipped_rectangle, radial)]
    points = []
    levels = [(0, 0.86, 0), (bevel, 1, bevel), (0.76, 0.91, 0.76), (1, crown, 1)]
    for level, radius, drift in levels:
        for px, py in perimeter:
            z = h * level
            if level == 1:
                z += h * (0.08 * px / w + 0.05 * py / d + rng.uniform(-0.015, 0.015))
            points.append((px * radius + lean * drift, py * radius, z))
    stone = s3d.hull('chipped_limestone', points)
    cutters = []
    for i, level in enumerate((0.34, 0.6, 0.79)):
        front = bedding_fissure(w=w, d=d, h=h, level=level, lean=lean, depth=seam_depth, seed=seed + 10 + i)
        back = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(front), mirror='y')
        cutters.extend([front, back])
        if i < 2:
            side = s3d.at(bedding_fissure(w=d, d=w, h=h, level=level, lean=0, depth=seam_depth, seed=seed + 40 + i), rz=90)
            cutters.extend([side, s3d.transform(s3d.copy(side), mirror='x')])
    split = split_fissure(w=w, d=d, h=h, seed=seed + 20)
    cutters.extend([split, s3d.transform(s3d.copy(split), mirror='y')])
    stone = s3d.cut(stone, cutters)
    river_worn_damp_regions(stone, h=h, seed=seed + 30)
    return stone

def bedding_fissure(w, d, h, level, lean, depth, seed=0, aperture=0.013):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    left, right = (-w * 0.47 + lean * level, w * 0.44 + lean * level)
    z = h * level
    slope = rng.uniform(-0.025, 0.025) * h
    points = []
    for y in (-d, -d * (0.5 - depth)):
        points.extend([(left, y, z - h * aperture), (left, y, z), (right, y, z + slope), (right, y, z + slope + h * aperture * 0.5)])
    return s3d.hull('shallow_bedding_cut', points)

def split_fissure(w, d, h, seed=0, width=0.017):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    x = w * rng.uniform(-0.22, 0.22)
    lower, upper = (h * 0.4, h * 0.66)
    points = []
    for y in (-d, -d * 0.4):
        points.extend([(x - width * w, y, lower), (x, y, lower), (x + w * 0.06, y, upper), (x + w * (0.06 + width / 2), y, upper)])
    return s3d.hull('short_slanted_fissure', points)

def river_worn_damp_regions(stone, h, seed=0):

    def limestone_colour(x, y, z):
        mottling = s3d.noise(x / 290, y / 290, z / 230, seed=seed)
        bedding = np.sin(z / h * np.pi * 7)
        ivory = np.stack((x * 0 + 0.61, x * 0 + 0.595, x * 0 + 0.53), axis=-1)
        dry = ivory + (0.025 * mottling + 0.018 * bedding)[..., None]
        joint = np.minimum(np.minimum(abs(z / h - 0.34), abs(z / h - 0.6)), abs(z / h - 0.79))
        dry = np.where((joint < 0.019)[..., None], dry * 0.48, dry)
        wetline = h * (0.175 + 0.065 * s3d.noise(x / 210, y / 210, z * 0, seed=seed + 1))
        wet = np.stack((x * 0 + 0.34, x * 0 + 0.405, x * 0 + 0.425), axis=-1)
        wet = wet + (mottling * 0.035)[..., None]
        return np.clip(np.where((z < wetline)[..., None], wet, dry), 0, 1)
    s3d.material(stone, 'rock', color=limestone_colour, roughness=0.94)
    return stone

def tall_outcrop_snow(stone, w, d, h, lean, seed=0):
    return angular_snow_cap(stone, w=w, d=d, h=h, lean=lean, thickness=90, seed=seed)

def angular_snow_cap(stone, w, d, h, lean, thickness, seed=0, overhang=1.035, margin=0.88):
    snow = s3d.copy(stone)
    snow = s3d.scale(snow, (overhang, overhang, 1))
    snow = s3d.transform(snow, z=thickness)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    mask_points = []
    for frame in s3d.ring(10, 1, start=18):
        px, py = (lean + frame.origin.x * w, frame.origin.y * d)
        bottom = h * (margin + rng.uniform(-0.045, 0.045))
        mask_points.extend([(px, py, bottom), (px, py, h + thickness * 3)])
    mask = s3d.hull('uneven_snow_margin_mask', mask_points)
    snow = s3d.intersect(snow, mask)
    s3d.material(snow, 'snow', color='#a6b8c8', roughness=1)
    return snow

def spring_crevice_moss(stone, w, d, h, seed=0, length=170, breadth=37):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    patches = []
    sites = [(-0.23, 0.32, -1), (0.16, 0.58, -1), (-0.04, 0.77, -1), (0.2, 0.32, 1), (-0.17, 0.58, 1), (0.11, 0.77, 1)]
    for i, (x, z, side) in enumerate(sites):
        hits = s3d.snap(stone, [(x * w, side * d, h * z)], direction='+Y' if side < 0 else '-Y')
        if hits:
            scale = rng.uniform(0.72, 1.15)
            patch = moss_patch(length=length * scale, breadth=breadth * scale, seed=seed + 10 + i)
            patch = s3d.at(patch, on=hits[0].offset(-3))
            patch = s3d.lay(patch, over=stone, reach=d / 2, step=0)
            patches.append(patch)
    return s3d.group('sparse_spring_crevice_moss', patches)

def moss_patch(length=170, breadth=37, seed=0, relief=9):
    profile = s3d.poly([(-length / 2, -breadth / 5), (-length / 4, -breadth / 2), (length / 5, -breadth / 3), (length / 2, 0), (length / 4, breadth / 2), (-length / 3, breadth / 3)])
    patch = s3d.extrude('fresh_yellow_green_moss', profile, relief)
    shade = random.Random(seed).choice(['#98a750', '#8a9c49', '#a7b15d'])
    s3d.material(patch, 'moss', color=shade, roughness=1)
    return patch

def medium_limestone_outcrop(seed=0, w=1000, d=790, h=1030, lean=160):
    stone = limestone_body(w=w, d=d, h=h, lean=lean, seed=seed + 1)
    snow = medium_outcrop_snow(stone, w=w, d=d, h=h, lean=lean, seed=seed + 2)
    moss = spring_crevice_moss(stone, w=w, d=d, h=h, seed=seed + 3)
    return s3d.group('medium_limestone_outcrop', stone, snow, moss)

def medium_outcrop_snow(stone, w, d, h, lean, seed=0):
    return angular_snow_cap(stone, w=w, d=d, h=h, lean=lean, thickness=78, seed=seed)

def low_limestone_outcrop(seed=0, w=780, d=630, h=595, lean=-50):
    stone = limestone_body(w=w, d=d, h=h, lean=lean, seed=seed + 1)
    snow = low_outcrop_snow(stone, w=w, d=d, h=h, lean=lean, seed=seed + 2)
    moss = spring_crevice_moss(stone, w=w, d=d, h=h, seed=seed + 3)
    return s3d.group('low_limestone_outcrop', stone, snow, moss)

def low_outcrop_snow(stone, w, d, h, lean, seed=0):
    return angular_snow_cap(stone, w=w, d=d, h=h, lean=lean, thickness=62, seed=seed)

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np


def autumn_cracked_rock_beach(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(6, smooth=False)
    ground = bare_beach_ground(seed=seed + 1)
    rock = s3d.at(cracked_boulder(seed=seed + 2), y=0, z=45)
    rock = s3d.lay(rock, over=ground, step=0)
    chips = detached_stone_chips(ground, rock, seed=seed + 3)
    return s3d.assembly('autumn_cracked_rock_beach', ground, rock, chips)


def bare_beach_ground(seed=1, width=1980, depth=1830, thickness=36, relief=17, sides=11):
    edge = s3d.ring(sides, width / 2).jitter(x=38, y=38, seed=seed + 1)
    heights = s3d.vary(thickness, relief / 2, len(edge), seed=seed + 2)
    points = []
    for f, h in zip(edge, heights):
        x, y = f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width
        points.extend([(x,y,0), (x,y,h)])
    points.extend([(0,0,thickness + relief), (-width/5,depth/7,thickness + relief/2)])
    ground = s3d.hull('bare_sand_terrain', points)
    s3d.material(ground, 'sand', color=sand_colour, roughness=1)
    return ground


def sand_colour(x, y, z):
    # Broad warm beach-sand palette: mean reflectance and small colour variation.
    sand_mean = np.array([.70, .59, .41])
    sand_variation = np.array([.06, .05, .04])
    patch = s3d.noise(x / 590, y / 590, z / 590, seed=21)
    return sand_mean + patch[...,None]*sand_variation


def cracked_boulder(seed=2, width=1100, depth=880, height=620, count=7, gap=40, spall=72):
    points = []
    # Height, radius ratio and lateral drift define the uneven boulder's four tiers.
    tiers = [(0, .80, 0, 0), (height*.34, 1, -width*.03, 0), (height*.78, .77, width*.03, depth*.03), (height, .35, -width*.05, depth*.03)]
    for k, (z, size, dx, dy) in enumerate(tiers):
        frames = s3d.ring(count, width*size/2, start=k*11).jitter(x=width*.035, y=width*.035, seed=seed + k + 1)
        heights = s3d.vary(z, height*.05 if k else 0, len(frames), seed=seed + 20 + k)
        points.extend([(f.origin.x + dx, f.origin.y*depth/width + dy, h) for f, h in zip(frames, heights)])
    rock = s3d.hull('interlocking_fractured_rock', points)
    paths = fracture_paths(width, depth)
    cutters = []
    for k, path in enumerate(paths):
        dx, dy = (gap/2, 0) if k == 0 else (0, gap/2)
        band = [(x-dx,y-dy) for x,y in path] + [(x+dx,y+dy) for x,y in reversed(path)]
        tool = s3d.extrude('deep_fracture_' + str(k), s3d.poly(band), height*2)
        cutters.append(s3d.at(tool, z=height*.10))
    rock = s3d.cut(rock, cutters)
    # Spalls are genuine angular bites at irregular positions on the fracture lips.
    lip_probes = []
    for k, path in enumerate(paths):
        offset_x, offset_y = (gap*.65, 0) if k == 0 else (0, gap*.65)
        for x,y in path[1:-1]:
            lip_probes.append(s3d.Frame((x+offset_x, y+offset_y, height*2)))
    lip_sites = s3d.snap(rock, lip_probes, direction='-Z').jitter(rz=180, seed=seed + 40)
    sizes = s3d.vary(spall, spall*.4, len(lip_sites), seed=seed + 41)
    tools = []
    for f, size in zip(lip_sites, sizes):
        r = size/2
        tool = s3d.hull('fracture_lip_spall', [(-r,-r,-r*.3),(r,-r,r*.3),(-r,r,r*.7),(r,r,r),(0,0,-r)])
        tools.append(s3d.at(tool,on=f))
    if tools:
        rock = s3d.cut(rock, tools)
    def colour(x,y,z,n):
        return stone_colour(x,y,z,n,paths,gap,height)
    s3d.material(rock, 'rock', color=colour, roughness=.97)
    return rock


def fracture_paths(width=1100, depth=880):
    # Authored branching joint traces, normalised by the boulder's two spans.
    outlines = [
        [(-.03,-.70),(0,-.35),(-.04,-.09),(.04,.15),(0,.39),(.07,.70)],
        [(0,.09),(.20,.10),(.36,.19),(.60,.18)],
        [(-.60,.20),(-.32,.13),(-.18,0),(-.03,-.07)]
    ]
    return [[(x*width,y*depth) for x,y in path] for path in outlines]


def stone_colour(x, y, z, n, paths, gap, height):
    patch = s3d.noise(x/310, y/310, z/310, seed=37)
    # Matte autumn stone palette, in broad slate, oxidised ochre and red-brown patches.
    slate = np.array([.35,.37,.37])
    ochre = np.array([.57,.37,.19])
    rust = np.array([.43,.26,.21])
    colour = np.where((patch > .17)[...,None], ochre, np.where((patch < -.18)[...,None], rust, slate))
    segments = [(a,b) for path in paths for a,b in zip(path[:-1],path[1:])]
    distance = x*0 + 10000
    for (ax,ay),(bx,by) in segments:
        vx,vy=bx-ax,by-ay
        u=np.clip(((x-ax)*vx+(y-ay)*vy)/(vx*vx+vy*vy),0,1)
        distance=np.minimum(distance,np.sqrt((x-ax-u*vx)**2+(y-ay-u*vy)**2))
    low_floor = z < height*.15
    fracture = (distance < gap*.8) & ((np.abs(n[2]) < .45) | low_floor)
    # Exposed fracture walls and the deep retained floor use separate earthy values.
    inner_mean = np.array([.26,.22,.19])
    inner_variation = np.array([.06,.05,.03])
    inner = inner_mean + patch[...,None]*inner_variation
    inner = np.where(low_floor[...,None], inner*.60, inner)
    return np.where(fracture[...,None], inner, colour)


def detached_stone_chips(ground, rock, seed=3, count=19, width=105, spread=57):
    samples = s3d.scatter(210, ground, seed=seed + 1)
    candidates = [f for f in samples if f.origin.z > 28 and 1.0 < (f.origin.x/525)**2 + (f.origin.y/440)**2 < 2.05]
    sites = s3d.Frames(candidates).jitter(x=25, y=25, rx=8, ry=8, rz=180, seed=seed + 2)
    kept = []
    for f in sites:
        probe = s3d.Frame((f.origin.x, f.origin.y, 900))
        if not s3d.snap(rock, [probe], direction='-Z'):
            kept.append(f)
        if len(kept) == count:
            break
    widths = s3d.vary(width, spread, len(kept), seed=seed + 3)
    depths = s3d.vary(.76, .22, len(kept), seed=seed + 4)
    heights = s3d.vary(.56, .20, len(kept), seed=seed + 5)
    chips = []
    for k,(f,w,d,h) in enumerate(zip(kept,widths,depths,heights)):
        chip = s3d.at(stone_chip(seed=seed + 100 + k, width=w, depth=w*d, height=w*h), on=f)
        chips.append(s3d.lay(chip, over=ground, step=0))
    return s3d.group('detached_stone_chips', *chips)


def stone_chip(seed=103, width=100, depth=76, height=56):
    base = s3d.ring(5, width/2).jitter(x=width*.13, y=width*.13, seed=seed + 1)
    points = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y*depth/width, 0) for f in base]
    points.extend([(-width*.2,-depth*.12,height*.8),(width*.21,depth*.11,height),(width*.1,-depth*.27,height*.62)])
    chip = s3d.hull('angular_detached_chip', points)
    colours = ['#616365','#8d6542','#795344','#4d5156','#aa7b4c']
    s3d.material(chip,'rock',color=colours[seed % len(colours)],roughness=1)
    return chip
