import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random


def autumn_balanced_rock_beach(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    ground = sand_ground(seed=seed + 1)
    ground_hit = s3d.snap(ground, [(-100, 60, 5000)], direction="-Z")[0]
    pedestal = s3d.at(pedestal_rock(seed=seed + 2), on=s3d.Frame(ground_hit.origin).move(z=-35))
    boulder = s3d.at(balancing_boulder(seed=seed + 3), on=pedestal.face("+Z"))
    pebbles = beach_pebbles(ground, seed=seed + 4)
    return s3d.assembly("autumn_balanced_rock_beach", ground, pedestal, boulder, pebbles)


def sand_ground(seed, width=4600, depth=3800, height=110, relief=36, count=12):
    outline = s3d.ring(count, 1).jitter(x=.085, y=.085, seed=seed + 10)
    points = [(f.origin.x * width / 2, f.origin.y * depth / 2) for f in outline]
    ground = s3d.extrude("bounded_beach_sand", s3d.poly(points), height)
    s3d.displace(ground, relief, 850, seed=seed + 20, faces="top", direction="+Z", step=570)
    def sand_colour(x, y, z):
        patch = s3d.noise(x / 1100, y / 1100, z / 1100, seed=seed + 30)
        mix = np.clip(.5 + patch, 0, 1)
        pale = np.array([.69, .58, .40])
        gold = np.array([.61, .46, .28])
        return pale + mix[:, None] * (gold - pale)
    s3d.material(ground, "sand", color=sand_colour, roughness=1)
    return ground


def pedestal_rock(seed, width=900, depth=760, height=1000, top_width=230, top_depth=190):
    levels = [(0, .76, .78, 0, 0), (.30, 1, 1, -.04, .02), (.69, .72, .73, .03, -.025)]
    points = []
    for k, (z, sx, sy, dx, dy) in enumerate(levels):
        ring = s3d.ring(6, 1, start=k * 13).jitter(x=.12, y=.12, z=.035, seed=seed + 10 + k)
        points.extend([(f.origin.x * width * sx / 2 + width * dx, f.origin.y * depth * sy / 2 + depth * dy, max(0, height * (z + f.origin.z))) for f in ring])
    crown = s3d.ring(5, 1, start=18).jitter(x=.09, y=.09, seed=seed + 20)
    points.extend([(f.origin.x * top_width / 2, f.origin.y * top_depth / 2, height) for f in crown])
    rock = s3d.hull("grounded_angular_pedestal", points)
    def stone_colour(x, y, z):
        patch = s3d.noise(x / 550, y / 550, z / 550, seed=seed + 30)
        slate = np.array([.34, .35, .34])
        rust = np.array([.44, .29, .18])
        mix = np.clip(.45 + 1.5 * patch, 0, 1)
        rgb = slate + mix[:, None] * (rust - slate)
        dark = np.clip((z / height - .73) / .27, 0, 1)
        return rgb * (1 - .42 * dark[:, None])
    s3d.material(rock, "rock", color=stone_colour, roughness=1)
    return rock


def balancing_boulder(seed, width=2160, depth=1640, height=1480, contact_width=180, contact_depth=145):
    points = []
    foot = s3d.ring(5, 1, start=18).jitter(x=.08, y=.08, seed=seed + 10)
    points.extend([(f.origin.x * contact_width / 2, f.origin.y * contact_depth / 2, 0) for f in foot])
    layers = [(.30, .85, .82, -.025, -.02, 8), (.65, 1, 1, .015, .025, -9), (.93, .73, .73, -.07, .015, 15)]
    for k, (z, sx, sy, dx, dy, turn) in enumerate(layers):
        ring = s3d.ring(7, 1, start=turn).jitter(x=.105, y=.105, z=.045, seed=seed + 20 + k)
        points.extend([(f.origin.x * width * sx / 2 + width * dx, f.origin.y * depth * sy / 2 + depth * dy, height * (z + f.origin.z)) for f in ring])
    points.append((-width * .13, depth * .025, height))
    rock = s3d.hull("top_heavy_balancing_boulder", points)
    def stone_colour(x, y, z):
        patch = s3d.noise(x / 870, y / 870, z / 870, seed=seed + 40)
        slate = np.array([.36, .38, .39])
        ochre = np.array([.58, .40, .22])
        mix = np.clip(.45 + 1.7 * patch, 0, 1)
        rgb = slate + mix[:, None] * (ochre - slate)
        russet = (s3d.noise(x / 1200, y / 1200, z / 1200, seed=seed + 50) > .18)
        rgb = np.where(russet[:, None], rgb * np.array([1.08, .82, .69]), rgb)
        darkness = np.clip(1 - z / (height * .29), 0, 1)
        return rgb * (1 - .45 * darkness[:, None])
    s3d.material(rock, "rock", color=stone_colour, roughness=1)
    return rock


def beach_pebbles(ground, seed, count=9, size=210, exclusion=850):
    candidates = s3d.scatter(count * 16, ground, seed=seed + 10)
    sites = [f for f in candidates if f.normal.z > .8 and f.origin.x ** 2 + f.origin.y ** 2 > exclusion ** 2 and abs(f.origin.x) < 2000 and abs(f.origin.y) < 1600][:count]
    sizes = s3d.vary(size, size / 3, len(sites), seed=seed + 20)
    turns = s3d.vary(0, 180, len(sites), seed=seed + 30)
    rocks = [s3d.at(beach_pebble(seed=seed + 100 + k, width=w), on=f.offset(-w * .13).turn(rz=turn), anchor="-Z") for k, (f, w, turn) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes, turns))]
    return s3d.group("sparse_embedded_pebbles", *rocks)


def beach_pebble(seed, width, depth_ratio=.76, height_ratio=.56):
    points = s3d.scatter(13, (width, width * depth_ratio, width * height_ratio), surface=True, seed=seed + 10)
    rock = s3d.hull("angular_beach_pebble", [f.origin for f in points])
    colour = random.Random(seed + 20).choice(["#666963", "#806344", "#735042", "#9a8154"])
    s3d.material(rock, "rock", color=colour, roughness=1)
    return rock

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random

def angular_rune_stone_cluster(seed=0):
    soil = bare_soil_patch(seed=seed + 1)
    middle = s3d.at(central_rune_stone(seed=seed + 10), x=35, y=205, z=48, rx=-3, ry=-4, rz=-3)
    left = s3d.at(left_rune_stone(seed=seed + 20), x=-505, y=-100, z=42, rx=3, ry=-8, rz=-12)
    right = s3d.at(right_rune_stone(seed=seed + 30), x=500, y=-170, z=42, rx=-4, ry=7, rz=13)
    return s3d.at(s3d.assembly('angular_rune_stone_cluster', soil, middle, left, right), rz=180)

def bare_soil_patch(seed=1, width=1800, depth=1280, height=90, count=13):
    s3d.facets(10, smooth=False)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sites = s3d.ring(count, 1)
    outline = [(f.origin.x * width / 2 * rng.uniform(0.88, 1), f.origin.y * depth / 2 * rng.uniform(0.88, 1)) for f in sites]
    points = [(x, y, height * rng.uniform(0.3, 0.58)) for x, y in outline]
    points += [(x * 0.93, y * 0.93, 0) for x, y in outline]
    points += [(x * 0.62, y * 0.62, height * rng.uniform(0.77, 1)) for x, y in outline]
    points += [(0, 0, height)]
    earth = s3d.hull('bare_soil_patch', points)

    def soil_color(x, y, z):
        v = s3d.noise(x / 260, y / 260, z / 160, seed=seed + 1)
        return np.stack((0.29 + 0.045 * v, 0.19 + 0.033 * v, 0.115 + 0.023 * v), axis=-1)
    s3d.material(earth, 'soil', color=soil_color, roughness=1)
    return earth

def central_rune_stone(seed=10):
    return carved_stone('central_rune_stone', width=510, depth=340, height=1260, bevel=58, variant=0, seed=seed)

def carved_stone(name, width, depth, height, bevel, variant, seed, groove_depth=26):
    s3d.facets(10, smooth=False)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    outline = [(-0.43, -0.025), (0.4, -0.025), (0.51, 0.16), (0.46, 0.7), (0.29, 0.96), (-0.12, 1), (-0.43, 0.89), (-0.52, 0.34)]
    outline = [(x * width + rng.uniform(-bevel / 5, bevel / 5), z * height) for x, z in outline]
    front = [(x * 0.78, -depth / 2, z * 0.91 + bevel / 2) for x, z in outline]
    rim = [(x, -depth / 2 + bevel, z) for x, z in outline]
    back = [(x * rng.uniform(0.85, 0.98) + bevel / 5, depth / 2, z * rng.uniform(0.94, 1)) for x, z in outline]
    rock = s3d.hull(name + '_rock', front + rim + back)

    def slate_color(x, y, z):
        v = s3d.noise(x / (width * 0.43), y / depth, z / (height * 0.27), seed=seed + 1)
        return np.stack((0.335 + 0.048 * v, 0.365 + 0.05 * v, 0.395 + 0.055 * v), axis=-1)
    s3d.material(rock, 'rock', color=slate_color, roughness=0.96)
    face = s3d.Frame((0, -depth / 2, 0), normal=(0, -1, 0), up=(0, 0, 1))
    carving, floor = rune_inscription(width=width, height=height, variant=variant, groove=groove_depth + 2)
    carving = s3d.at(carving, on=face.offset(-groove_depth))
    floor = s3d.at(floor, on=face.offset(-groove_depth + 0.4))
    rock = s3d.cut(rock, carving)
    return s3d.group(name, rock, floor)

def rune_inscription(width, height, variant, groove, stroke_ratio=0.052):
    patterns = [[((0, 0.71), (0, 0.88)), ((0, 0.77), (-0.18, 0.85)), ((0, 0.77), (0.18, 0.85)), ((0, 0.61), (-0.18, 0.54)), ((-0.18, 0.54), (0, 0.47)), ((0, 0.47), (0.18, 0.54)), ((0.18, 0.54), (0, 0.61)), ((0, 0.61), (0, 0.42)), ((-0.16, 0.35), (0.15, 0.35)), ((0.15, 0.35), (-0.15, 0.24)), ((-0.15, 0.24), (0.14, 0.24)), ((0, 0.2), (0, 0.39))], [((0, 0.6), (0, 0.85)), ((0, 0.83), (0.19, 0.74)), ((0.19, 0.74), (0, 0.66)), ((0, 0.76), (-0.18, 0.69)), ((-0.18, 0.43), (0, 0.53)), ((0, 0.53), (0.18, 0.43)), ((0.18, 0.43), (-0.13, 0.25)), ((-0.13, 0.25), (0.14, 0.25)), ((0, 0.2), (0, 0.45))], [((0, 0.57), (0, 0.84)), ((-0.19, 0.73), (0, 0.83)), ((0, 0.83), (0.19, 0.73)), ((-0.16, 0.6), (0.16, 0.7)), ((-0.17, 0.42), (0.17, 0.42)), ((0.17, 0.42), (-0.16, 0.26)), ((-0.16, 0.26), (0.15, 0.26)), ((0, 0.21), (0, 0.49))]]
    cuts = []
    stroke = width * stroke_ratio
    for a, b in patterns[variant]:
        path = [(a[0] * width, a[1] * height), (b[0] * width, b[1] * height)]
        profile = s3d.stroke(path, stroke)
        cuts.append(s3d.extrude('angular_rune_cut', profile, groove, taper=-10))
    cutter = s3d.join(cuts[0], cuts[1:])
    floor = s3d.scale(s3d.copy(cutter), (1, 1, 1 / groove))
    s3d.material(floor, 'rock', color='#11191e', roughness=1)
    return (cutter, floor)

def left_rune_stone(seed=20):
    return carved_stone('left_rune_stone', width=440, depth=320, height=830, bevel=49, variant=1, seed=seed)

def right_rune_stone(seed=30):
    return carved_stone('right_rune_stone', width=410, depth=290, height=670, bevel=43, variant=2, seed=seed)

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np

def angular_fantasy_daisy(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(6, smooth=False)
    roots = root_base(seed=seed + 1)
    stem = bending_stem(seed=seed + 2)
    leaves = folded_leaves(seed=seed + 3)
    tip = s3d.Frame(s3d.along(stem_path(), count=2)[-1].origin).turn(rx=22, ry=14)
    calyx = s3d.at(flower_calyx(seed=seed + 4), on=tip)
    petals = s3d.at(petal_crown(seed=seed + 5), on=tip)
    gold = s3d.at(golden_center(seed=seed + 6), on=tip)
    return s3d.assembly('angular_fantasy_daisy', roots, stem, leaves, calyx, petals, gold)

def root_base(seed=1, spread=70, height=20, count=7):
    crown = s3d.loft('root_crown', s3d.station(0, 17, 15), s3d.station(height / 2, 18, 16), s3d.station(height, 7, 7, x=1))
    s3d.material(crown, 'bark', color='#205e49', roughness=0.9)
    sites = s3d.ring(count, 0).jitter(rz=7, seed=seed)
    sizes = s3d.vary(1, 0.14, count, seed=seed + 1)
    roots = [s3d.at(angular_root(length=spread / 2 * length, seed=seed + 20 + k), on=f) for k, (f, length) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes))]
    return s3d.group('root_base', crown, roots)

def angular_root(seed=20, length=35, width=9, height=16):
    root = s3d.hull('tapered_angular_root', [(0, -width / 2, 0), (0, width / 2, 0), (0, 0, height), (length * 0.48, -width * 0.35, 0), (length * 0.48, width * 0.35, 0), (length * 0.48, 0, height * 0.42), (length, 0, 0), (length * 0.88, 0, 2)])
    s3d.material(root, 'bark', color='#286650', roughness=0.93)
    return root

def bending_stem(seed=2, diameter=5.6):
    stem = s3d.wire('emerald_stem', stem_path(), d=[(0, diameter * 1.15), (0.65, diameter), (1, diameter * 0.8)])
    s3d.material(stem, 'leaf', color='#21825c', roughness=0.8)
    return stem

def stem_path(height=245):
    return s3d.spline([(0, 0, 12), (-3, 1, height * 0.27), (4, 2, height * 0.53), (12, 1, height * 0.78), (8, 0, height)])

def folded_leaves(seed=3, length=57, width=17):
    path = stem_path()
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=3, spin=137.508, span=(0.28, 0.74)).turn(ry=63).jitter(ry=9, rz=13, seed=seed)
    sizes = s3d.vary(1, 0.2, len(sites), seed=seed + 1)
    leaves = [s3d.at(lance_leaf(seed=seed + 10 + k, length=length * size, width=width * size), on=f) for k, (f, size) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes))]
    return s3d.group('folded_leaves', leaves)

def lance_leaf(seed=10, length=57, width=17, fold=4):
    leaf = s3d.hull('folded_jade_lance', [(0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 2), (-width / 2, -fold, length * 0.38), (width / 2, -fold, length * 0.38), (0, 0, length * 0.38), (-width * 0.31, -fold * 0.8, length * 0.7), (width * 0.31, -fold * 0.8, length * 0.7), (0, 1, length), (0, -fold * 0.9, length * 0.45)])
    s3d.material(leaf, 'leaf', color='#299569', roughness=0.87)
    rib = s3d.wire('leaf_fold_highlight', [(0, 0, 1), (0, 0, length * 0.38), (0, 1, length)], d=[(0, 0.9), (0.5, 0.65), (1, 0.05)])
    s3d.material(rib, 'leaf', color='#70bd84', roughness=0.9)
    return s3d.group('lance_leaf', leaf, rib)

def flower_calyx(seed=4, diameter=21, depth=11, count=6):
    cup = s3d.cone('calyx_cup', d=6, d2=diameter, h=depth)
    cup = s3d.at(cup, z=-depth)
    s3d.material(cup, 'leaf', color='#217451', roughness=0.85)
    sepal = s3d.hull('sharp_sepal', [(0, -3, -3), (0, 3, -3), (0, 0, -6), (19, 0, -2), (8, 0, 0)])
    s3d.material(sepal, 'leaf', color='#368b60', roughness=0.86)
    sepals = s3d.at(sepal, on=s3d.ring(count, diameter / 4).jitter(rz=5, seed=seed))
    return s3d.group('flower_calyx', cup, sepals)

def petal_crown(seed=5, count=15, radius=13, length=56, width=15.5):
    sites = s3d.ring(count, radius).jitter(rz=1.6, rx=2, ry=2, seed=seed)
    sizes = s3d.vary(1, 0.065, count, seed=seed + 1)
    petals = [s3d.at(blade_petal(seed=seed + 20 + k, length=length * size, width=width), on=frame) for k, (frame, size) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes))]
    return s3d.group('petal_crown', petals)

def blade_petal(seed=25, length=56, width=15.5, fold_angle=9, tip_fraction=0.79, thickness=1.1):
    shoulder = length * 0.38
    tip_start = length * tip_fraction
    blade = s3d.extrude('ivory_petal_plane', s3d.poly([(0, 0), (tip_start, 0), (tip_start, width * 0.36), (shoulder, width / 2), (0, 2)]), thickness)
    s3d.material(blade, 'ceramic', color='#a69e8d', roughness=0.98)
    blade = s3d.at(blade, rx=-fold_angle)
    twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(blade), mirror='y')
    tip = s3d.extrude('pale_lilac_petal_tip', s3d.poly([(tip_start, 0), (length, 0), (tip_start, width * 0.36)]), thickness)
    s3d.material(tip, 'ceramic', color='#8f79b0', roughness=0.98)
    tip = s3d.at(tip, rx=-fold_angle)
    other_tip = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(tip), mirror='y')
    return s3d.group('blade_petal', blade, twin, tip, other_tip)

def golden_center(seed=6, diameter=34, height=11, grain_count=150):
    disk = s3d.dome('amber_receptacle', d=diameter, h=height)
    s3d.material(disk, 'plastic', color='#b4771d', roughness=0.94)
    probes = s3d.phyllotaxis(grain_count, diameter * 0.95).move(z=height * 2)
    sites = s3d.snap(disk, probes, direction='-Z')
    sizes = s3d.vary(1, 0.2, len(sites), seed=seed)
    florets = [s3d.at(golden_floret(seed=seed + 20 + k, bright=k % 9 == 0), on=frame, scale=size) for k, (frame, size) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes))]
    return s3d.group('golden_center', disk, florets)

def golden_floret(seed=26, bright=False, width=2.7, height=2.2):
    grain = s3d.cone('golden_faceted_floret', d=width, d2=width * 0.57, h=height)
    s3d.material(grain, 'plastic', color='#ffe58a' if bright else '#c88f23', roughness=0.8, emission=0.12 if bright else 0)
    return grain

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np


def toy_crocus(seed=0):
    corm_lift = 3
    corm = s3d.at(corm_part(seed=seed + 1), z=corm_lift)
    roots = s3d.at(roots_part(seed=seed + 2), on=s3d.local(corm, z=-corm_lift), anchor="-Z")
    stem = s3d.at(stem_part(seed=seed + 3), on=corm.face("+Z"))
    flower = s3d.at(flower_part(seed=seed + 4), on=stem.face("+Z"))
    leaves = s3d.at(foliage_part(seed=seed + 5), on=corm.face("+Z").offset(-6))
    return s3d.assembly("toy_crocus", corm, roots, stem, flower, leaves)


def corm_part(seed, width=29, depth=26, height=20):
    with s3d.facets(6, smooth=False):
        corm = s3d.loft("brown_corm", 
            s3d.station(0, width * .74, depth * .74),
            s3d.station(height * .3, width, depth, x=-1),
            s3d.station(height * .72, width * .85, depth * .86, y=1),
            s3d.station(height, width * .34, depth * .34))
        s3d.material(corm, "soil", color="#835432", roughness=1)
    return corm


def roots_part(seed, count=6, reach=20, radius=8):
    with s3d.facets(6, smooth=False):
        sites = s3d.ring(count, radius, start=12).jitter(rz=13, seed=seed + 1)
        lengths = s3d.vary(reach, 4, len(sites), seed=seed + 2)
        roots = [s3d.at(root_part(seed=seed + 10 + i, length=length), on=frame)
                 for i, (frame, length) in enumerate(zip(sites, lengths))]
    return s3d.group("spreading_roots", roots)


def root_part(seed, length=20, diameter=3):
    root = s3d.wire("short_root", [(0, 0, 5), (length * .4, 1, 2),
                    (length * .78, 0, 1.1), (length, 1, 1)],
                    d=[(0, diameter), (.4, diameter * .75), (.8, diameter * .42), (1, 0)],
                    tip="sharp")
    s3d.material(root, "bark", color="#a67c4e", roughness=1)
    return root


def stem_part(seed, diameter=5.5, height=43):
    with s3d.facets(6, smooth=False):
        stem = s3d.cone("short_green_stem", diameter, height, d2=diameter * .8)
        s3d.material(stem, "leaf", color="#729047", roughness=.95)
    return stem


def flower_part(seed, attachment_radius=2.8, inner_rise=2):
    with s3d.facets(6, smooth=False):
        outer_sites = s3d.ring(3, attachment_radius, start=15).jitter(rz=3, seed=seed + 1)
        inner_sites = s3d.ring(3, attachment_radius * .8, start=75).move(z=inner_rise).jitter(rz=3, seed=seed + 2)
        heights = s3d.vary(57, 4.5, 3, seed=seed + 3)
        inner_heights = s3d.vary(56, 3.5, 3, seed=seed + 4)
        outer = [s3d.at(petal_part(seed=seed + 20 + i, height=h, width=26, spread=19), on=f)
                 for i, (f, h) in enumerate(zip(outer_sites, heights))]
        inner = [s3d.at(petal_part(seed=seed + 30 + i, height=h, width=24, spread=17), on=f)
                 for i, (f, h) in enumerate(zip(inner_sites, inner_heights))]
        stamens = s3d.at(stamen_part(seed=seed + 40), on=s3d.ring(3, 3.5, start=35).move(z=4),
                         scale=s3d.vary(1, .07, 3, seed=seed + 5))
    return s3d.group("open_violet_cup", outer, inner, stamens)


def petal_part(seed, height=57, width=26, spread=19, thickness=1.7):
    spread = s3d.vary(spread, spread * .08, 1, seed=seed + 1)[0]
    tip_sway = s3d.vary(0, width * .13, 1, seed=seed + 2)[0]
    petal = s3d.loft("angular_violet_petal",
        s3d.station(0, thickness, width * .13),
        s3d.station(height * .24, thickness, width * .44, x=spread * .12),
        s3d.station(height * .53, thickness, width * .86, x=spread * .48, y=tip_sway * .2),
        s3d.station(height * .78, thickness, width, x=spread * .86, y=tip_sway * .5),
        s3d.station(height * .94, thickness * .7, width * .60, x=spread, y=tip_sway * .8),
        s3d.station(height, 0, 0, x=spread * .98, y=tip_sway), tip="sharp")
    def petal_color(x, y, z, n):
        interior = np.array([.60, .50, .84])
        exterior = np.array([.34, .15, .57])
        return np.where((n[0] < -.12)[:, None], interior, exterior)
    s3d.material(petal, "leaf", color=petal_color, roughness=1)
    return petal


def stamen_part(seed, height=34, filament_d=1.25, anther_h=8):
    filament = s3d.cone("golden_filament", filament_d, height, d2=filament_d * .72)
    s3d.material(filament, "leaf", color="#f9bd35", roughness=1)
    anther = s3d.at(s3d.loft("orange_anther",
        s3d.station(0, 1.8, 2), s3d.station(anther_h * .22, 3.3, 2.7),
        s3d.station(anther_h * .82, 2.9, 2.5), s3d.station(anther_h, 1, 1)),
        on=filament.face("+Z"))
    s3d.material(anther, "leaf", color="#efa021", roughness=1)
    return s3d.group("stamen", filament, anther)


def foliage_part(seed, count=5, root_radius=5, height=76):
    with s3d.facets(6, smooth=False):
        sites = s3d.ring(count, root_radius, start=-15).jitter(rz=15, seed=seed + 1)
        heights = s3d.vary(height, 13, count, seed=seed + 2)
        spreads = s3d.vary(32, 7, count, seed=seed + 3)
        blades = [s3d.at(striped_leaf_part(seed=seed + 10 + i, height=h, spread=spread), on=f)
                  for i, (f, h, spread) in enumerate(zip(sites, heights, spreads))]
    return s3d.group("splayed_striped_leaves", blades)


def striped_leaf_part(seed, height=76, spread=32, width=5.2, thickness=.85, stripe_ratio=.23):
    sections = [(0, 0, .43), (.22, .10, 1), (.55, .39, .93), (.84, .80, .55)]
    blade = s3d.loft("green_blade",
        *[s3d.station(height * z, thickness, width * w, x=spread * x) for z, x, w in sections],
        s3d.station(height, 0, 0, x=spread), tip="sharp")
    s3d.material(blade, "leaf", color="#356638", roughness=1)
    stripes = []
    for side in (-1, 1):
        stripe = s3d.loft("pale_central_stripe",
            *[s3d.station(height * z, .16, width * w * stripe_ratio,
                           x=spread * x + side * (thickness / 2 + .055)) for z, x, w in sections],
            s3d.station(height, 0, 0, x=spread), tip="sharp")
        s3d.material(stripe, "leaf", color="#d0ddab", roughness=1)
        stripes.append(stripe)
    return s3d.group("striped_leaf", blade, stripes)

import sand3d as s3d
import random


def toy_clover_flower(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(6, smooth=False)
    roots = splayed_root_base(seed=seed + 1)
    stem = s3d.at(bent_stem(seed=seed + 2), z=10)
    lower = s3d.at(leaf_stalks(seed=seed + 3), on=s3d.local(stem, *tuple(stem.lower.origin)), rz=180)
    upper = s3d.at(leaf_stalks(seed=seed + 4, reach=23, rise=12), on=s3d.local(stem, *tuple(stem.upper.origin)))
    low_leaves = s3d.at(trefoil_leaf_clusters(seed=seed + 5), on=s3d.local(lower, *tuple(lower.tip.origin)), rz=-125)
    high_leaves = s3d.at(trefoil_leaf_clusters(seed=seed + 6), on=s3d.local(upper, *tuple(upper.tip.origin)), rz=-60)
    cup = s3d.at(bloom_receptacle(seed=seed + 7), on=s3d.local(stem, *tuple(stem.bloom.origin)))
    flower = s3d.at(clustered_florets(seed=seed + 8), on=s3d.local(stem, *tuple(stem.bloom.origin)))
    return s3d.assembly('toy_clover_flower', roots, stem, lower, upper, low_leaves, high_leaves, cup, flower)


def splayed_root_base(seed=1, reach=33, width=10, crown_h=14, count=5):
    root = s3d.hull('splayed_root', [(-width/2,-width/2,0),(-width/2,width/2,0),(0,-width/2,crown_h),(0,width/2,crown_h),(reach*.65,-width*.4,0),(reach*.65,width*.4,0),(reach,-width*.17,0),(reach,width*.17,0),(reach*.85,-width*.2,crown_h*.22),(reach*.85,width*.2,crown_h*.22)])
    s3d.material(root, 'bark', color='#80533e', roughness=1)
    sites = s3d.ring(count, 0, start=18).jitter(rz=7, seed=seed)
    roots = s3d.at(root, on=sites, scale=s3d.vary(1, .12, count, seed=seed+1))
    crown = s3d.cone('root_crown', 19, crown_h+2, d2=11)
    s3d.material(crown, 'bark', color='#704735', roughness=1)
    return s3d.group('splayed_root_base', crown, roots)


def bent_stem(seed=2, height=158, diameter=7, lean=8):
    lean += random.Random(seed).uniform(-1,1)
    path = s3d.spline([(0,0,0),(-2,0,height*.28),(1,1,height*.57),(lean,0,height*.84),(lean,0,height)])
    stem = s3d.wire('angular_green_stem', path, diameter)
    s3d.material(stem, 'leaf', color='#3c8543', roughness=.88)
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=2, span=(.40,.64))
    tip = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]
    return s3d.assembly('bent_stem', stem, lower=s3d.Frame(tuple(sites[0].origin)), upper=s3d.Frame(tuple(sites[1].origin)), bloom=s3d.Frame(tuple(tip.origin)))


def leaf_stalks(seed=3, reach=24, rise=13, diameter=3.3):
    bow = random.Random(seed).uniform(-1,1)
    path = s3d.spline([(0,0,0),(reach*.55,bow,rise*.2),(reach,0,rise*.72),(reach,0,rise)])
    stalk = s3d.wire('short_side_stalk', path, diameter)
    s3d.material(stalk, 'leaf', color='#4d9448', roughness=.9)
    return s3d.assembly('leaf_stalks', stalk, tip=s3d.Frame(tuple(s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1].origin)))


def trefoil_leaf_clusters(seed=5, length=28, width=25, spread=66):
    frames = s3d.Frames([s3d.Frame().turn(rz=a) for a in (-spread,0,spread)]).jitter(rx=5, ry=4, rz=4, seed=seed)
    leaves = [s3d.at(folded_leaflet(seed=seed+10+i, length=length, width=width), on=f) for i,f in enumerate(frames)]
    return s3d.group('trefoil_leaf_clusters', leaves)


def folded_leaflet(seed=15, length=28, width=25, thickness=1.4, fold=18):
    fold += random.Random(seed).uniform(-2,2)
    shape = s3d.poly([(0,0),(width*.4,length*.23),(width/2,length*.65),(width*.31,length*.94),(width*.14,length),(0,length*.88)])
    half = s3d.extrude('folded_leaf_half', shape, thickness)
    s3d.material(half, 'leaf', color='#47984a', roughness=.95)
    marking = s3d.at(leaf_chevrons(length=length, width=width), z=thickness)
    right = s3d.at(s3d.group('leaf_half_with_marking',half,marking), ry=fold)
    left = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(right), mirror='x')
    return s3d.group('folded_leaflet',right,left)


def leaf_chevrons(length=28, width=25, relief=.12):
    shape = s3d.poly([(0,length*.41),(width*.38,length*.66),(width*.36,length*.74),(0,length*.51)])
    marking = s3d.extrude('pale_chevron', shape, relief)
    s3d.material(marking, 'leaf', color='#cae2a0', roughness=1)
    return marking


def bloom_receptacle(seed=7, diameter=27, height=12):
    cup = s3d.loft('green_receptacle', s3d.station(-height/2,9,9), s3d.station(0,diameter,diameter), s3d.station(height/2,diameter*.8,diameter*.8))
    s3d.material(cup, 'leaf', color=random.Random(seed).choice(['#478342','#4b8944']), roughness=.95)
    return cup


def clustered_florets(seed=8):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    tiers = [(0,13,18,85),(7,16,22,66),(15,15,20,47),(22,10,15,28),(26,4,7,12)]
    florets = []
    for tier,(z,radius,count,tilt) in enumerate(tiers):
        sites = s3d.ring(count,radius,start=tier*27,on=s3d.Frame((0,0,z))).turn(ry=tilt).jitter(rx=6,ry=5,rz=5,seed=seed+10+tier)
        scales = s3d.vary(1,.12,count,seed=seed+20+tier)
        for i,(site,scale) in enumerate(zip(sites,scales)):
            f = floret(seed=seed+100+tier*20+i, color=rng.choice(['#ce528a','#da6095','#c84680','#df6a9b']))
            florets.append(s3d.at(f,on=site,scale=scale))
    core = s3d.at(s3d.sphere('hidden_pink_bloom_core',26),z=2)
    s3d.material(core,'leaf',color='#be477b',roughness=1)
    return s3d.group('clustered_florets',core,florets)


def floret(seed=100, color='#d45b90', length=16, width=7.8, tip_length=6):
    width *= random.Random(seed).uniform(.94,1.06)
    body_h = length-tip_length
    body = s3d.loft('rose_floret',s3d.station(0,width*.45,width*.45),s3d.station(body_h*.66,width,width*.8),s3d.station(body_h,width*.65,width*.55))
    s3d.material(body,'plastic',color=color,roughness=.88)
    tip = s3d.at(translucent_floret_tips(width=width*.65,depth=width*.55,height=tip_length),z=body_h)
    return s3d.group('floret',body,tip)


def translucent_floret_tips(width=4.4, depth=3.7, height=4.5):
    tip = s3d.loft('pale_translucent_point',s3d.station(0,width,depth),s3d.station(height,0,0),tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(tip,'plastic',color='#f2a0c8',roughness=.85,opacity=.32)
    return tip

import sand3d as s3d
import random
import numpy as np


def fantasy_swamp_canna_vignette(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    water = shallow_swamp_water_part(seed=seed + 1)
    mud = faceted_mud_island_part(seed=seed + 2)
    seams = turquoise_mineral_seams_part(mud, seed=seed + 3)
    clump = canna_stalk_clump_part(mud, seed=seed + 4)
    fallen = fallen_canna_leaves_part(mud, seed=seed + 5)
    return s3d.assembly('fantasy_swamp_canna_vignette', water, mud, seams, clump, fallen)


def shallow_swamp_water_part(seed=0, width=1500, depth=1250, height=52, corners=13, irregularity=44):
    sites = s3d.ring(corners, width/2).jitter(x=irregularity, y=irregularity, seed=seed)
    outline = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y*depth/width) for f in sites]
    water = s3d.extrude('bounded_moss_green_water', s3d.poly(outline), height)
    s3d.material(water, 'water', color='#53694b', roughness=.32, transmission=.28, absorb='#657b42', absorb_distance=180)
    return water


def faceted_mud_island_part(seed=0, width=1250, depth=1010, height=166, corners=11, jitter=37):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    perimeter = s3d.ring(corners, width/2).jitter(x=jitter, y=jitter, seed=seed+1)
    inner = s3d.ring(corners-3, width/3).jitter(x=jitter, y=jitter, seed=seed+2)
    points = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y*depth/width, 25) for f in perimeter]
    points += [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y*depth/width, height*.47+rng.uniform(-jitter/2,jitter/2)) for f in perimeter]
    points += [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y*depth/width, height+rng.uniform(-jitter/2,jitter/2)) for f in inner]
    points += [(0,0,height+12)]
    mud = s3d.hull('dark_faceted_swamp_mud', points)
    def soil_color(x,y,z):
        q = s3d.noise(x/280,y/280,z/240,seed=seed+3)
        return np.where((q > .05)[:,None], [.23,.205,.22], [.13,.145,.13])
    s3d.material(mud, 'soil', color=soil_color, roughness=.82)
    return mud


def turquoise_mineral_seams_part(ground, seed=0, diameter=9, glow=.65):
    paths = [ [(-490,-160),(-395,-215),(-330,-285),(-230,-300)], [(-395,-215),(-440,-305),(-430,-365)], [(285,-320),(340,-255),(445,-240),(500,-170)], [(340,-255),(300,-170)], [(-430,205),(-310,235),(-235,310)], [(240,350),(310,310),(390,335)] ]
    minerals=[]
    for i, path in enumerate(paths):
        probes=[(x,y,400) for x,y in path]
        hits=s3d.snap(ground,probes,direction='-Z')
        if len(hits)>1:
            seam=s3d.wire('inlaid_turquoise_seam', [tuple(f.offset(2).origin) for f in hits], diameter)
            s3d.material(seam,'rock',color='#48cbbd',roughness=.42,emission=glow)
            minerals.append(seam)
    return s3d.group('turquoise_mineral_seams',*minerals)


def canna_stalk_clump_part(ground, seed=0):
    layout=[(-155,65,1470,5,35,True),(135,90,1630,5,195,True),(10,-125,1200,4,105,True),(-220,-95,820,3,265,False)]
    shoots=[]
    for i,(x,y,height,count,azimuth,flowering) in enumerate(layout):
        hit=s3d.snap(ground,[(x,y,400)],direction='-Z')[0]
        stalk=s3d.at(canna_shoot_part(height=height,leaf_count=count,azimuth=azimuth,flowering=flowering,seed=seed+100+i),on=s3d.Frame(hit.origin).offset(-8))
        shoots.append(stalk)
    return s3d.group('upright_canna_clump',*shoots)


def canna_shoot_part(seed=0, height=1470, leaf_count=5, azimuth=35, flowering=True, diameter=37, lean=65):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    path=s3d.spline([(0,0,0),(lean*.2,0,height*.4),(lean*.65,lean*.15,height*.78),(lean,lean*.3,height)])
    stem=s3d.wire('sturdy_green_canna_stalk',path,[(0,diameter),(1,diameter*.58)])
    s3d.material(stem,'leaf',color='#396638',roughness=.8)
    sites=s3d.along(path,count=leaf_count,spin=145,span=(.17,.78)).turn(rz=azimuth)
    lengths=s3d.vary(height*.44,height*.065,leaf_count,seed=seed+1)
    leaves=[]
    sheaths=[]
    for i,(site,length) in enumerate(zip(sites,lengths)):
        sheath=s3d.at(wrapping_leaf_bases_part(seed=seed+10+i,diameter=diameter),on=site)
        leaf_frame=site.turn(rx=78-i*8+rng.uniform(-9,9))
        leaf_length=length*(1-.34*i/max(1,leaf_count-1))
        blade=s3d.at(folded_paddle_leaves_part(seed=seed+30+i,length=leaf_length,width=leaf_length*.4),on=leaf_frame)
        leaves.append(blade)
        sheaths.append(sheath)
    flowers=[]
    if flowering:
        top=s3d.along(path,count=2)[-1]
        flowers.append(s3d.at(asymmetric_canna_flowers_part(seed=seed+60),on=top.turn(rz=azimuth)))
    return s3d.group('leafy_flowering_shoot',stem,*sheaths,*leaves,*flowers)


def wrapping_leaf_bases_part(seed=0, diameter=37, height=105):
    base=s3d.cone('overlapping_leaf_sheath',diameter*1.2,height,d2=diameter*.82)
    s3d.material(base,'leaf',color='#456e3a',roughness=.85)
    return base


def folded_paddle_leaves_part(seed=0, length=650, width=250, fold=52, curl=195, wall=3):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    drift=rng.uniform(-width*.4,width*.4)
    table=[(0,.035,0,.12),(.16,.43,-.05,.6),(.4,.91,-.13,1),(.67,1,-.23,.86),(.86,.62,-.48,.5),(1,0,-1,0)]
    sections=[s3d.station(z=u*length,w=max(w*width,wall),d=max(f*fold,wall),x=drift*u*u,y=c*curl,n=2) for u,w,c,f in table]
    blade=s3d.loft('broad_pointed_folded_blade',*sections,tip='sharp')
    def blade_color(x,y,z,n):
        jade=np.where((z/length>.63)[:,None],[.16,.41,.29],[.11,.32,.23])
        return np.where((n[1]>0)[:,None],jade,[.30,.19,.35])
    s3d.material(blade,'leaf',color=blade_color,roughness=.91)
    edges=[(u*length,max(w*width,wall),max(f*fold,wall),drift*u*u,c*curl) for u,w,c,f in table]
    details=leaf_ribs_and_copper_margins_part(edges,seed=seed+1)
    return s3d.group('jade_violet_paddle_leaf',blade,details)


def leaf_ribs_and_copper_margins_part(sections,seed=0,edge_d=5,rib_d=7):
    ribpath=[(x,y+d/2+1,z) for z,w,d,x,y in sections]
    rib=s3d.wire('strong_angular_midrib',ribpath,[(0,rib_d),(1,rib_d/3)])
    s3d.material(rib,'leaf',color='#9c9f5e',roughness=.85)
    edgepath=[(-w/2+x,y,z) for z,w,d,x,y in sections]
    edgepath += [(w/2+x,y,z) for z,w,d,x,y in reversed(sections)]
    edge=s3d.wire('copper_leaf_margin',edgepath,edge_d,closed=True)
    s3d.material(edge,'leaf',color='#ab754b',roughness=.8)
    return s3d.group('leaf_rib_and_margins',rib,edge)


def asymmetric_canna_flowers_part(seed=0, stem_h=155, stem_d=13):
    stalk=s3d.cylinder('flower_spike',stem_d,stem_h)
    s3d.material(stalk,'leaf',color='#66713c',roughness=.85)
    stages=[(-34,0,15,-35,.9),(27,9,91,48,1),(-9,3,155,155,.8)]
    blooms=[]
    for i,(x,y,z,angle,scale) in enumerate(stages):
        branch=s3d.wire('short_flower_branch',[(0,0,max(0,z-18)),(x,y,z+18)],stem_d*.7)
        s3d.material(branch,'leaf',color='#66713c',roughness=.85)
        bloom=s3d.at(canna_blossom_part(seed=seed+10+i),x=x,y=y,z=z+10,rz=angle,scale=scale)
        blooms.extend([branch,bloom])
    bud=s3d.at(s3d.cone('pointed_amber_bud',24,75,d2=2),z=stem_h+80,x=18)
    s3d.material(bud,'leaf',color='#aa7239',roughness=.8)
    return s3d.group('asymmetric_scarlet_amber_crown',stalk,*blooms,bud)


def canna_blossom_part(seed=0, length=165, width=65):
    calyx=s3d.cone('green_flower_calyx',26,45,d2=15)
    s3d.material(calyx,'leaf',color='#6e7738',roughness=.85)
    petals=[]
    arrangements=[(-44,-20,1,1,'#d63d28'),(29,65,.83,.86,'#ee4a28'),(38,175,.94,.7,'#b82532'),(-15,255,.76,.66,'#f38b2b'),(64,18,1.15,.22,'#efb338')]
    for i,(tilt,turn,l,w,color) in enumerate(arrangements):
        petal=s3d.at(angular_flared_petal_part(seed=seed+1+i,length=length*l,width=width*w,color=color),z=27,rx=tilt,rz=turn)
        petals.append(petal)
    return s3d.group('scarlet_and_amber_canna_blossom',calyx,*petals)


def angular_flared_petal_part(seed=0,length=165,width=65,color='#d63d28',thickness=9,bend=48):
    petal=s3d.loft('angular_flared_petal',s3d.station(0,width*.16,thickness),s3d.station(length*.34,width*.5,thickness,y=-bend*.12),s3d.station(length*.72,width,thickness*.75,y=-bend*.55,x=width*.1),s3d.station(length*.91,width*.7,thickness*.5,y=-bend),s3d.station(length,2,2,y=-bend*1.15,x=-width*.12),tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(petal,'leaf',color=color,roughness=.78)
    return petal


def fallen_canna_leaves_part(ground,seed=0,count=5,length=340):
    sites=s3d.scatter(count*20,ground,seed=seed+1)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.normal.z>.72 and f.origin.z>70 and (f.origin.x**2+f.origin.y**2)>260**2][:count]
    turns=s3d.vary(180,180,len(kept),seed=seed+2)
    sizes=s3d.vary(length,65,len(kept),seed=seed+3)
    colors=['#9b753c','#695039','#697446','#a68a4c','#535e37']
    leaves=[]
    for i,(site,turn,size) in enumerate(zip(kept,turns,sizes)):
        leaf=fallen_folded_leaf_part(seed=seed+20+i,length=size,color=colors[i%len(colors)])
        leaf=s3d.at(leaf,on=s3d.Frame(site.origin).turn(rz=turn))
        leaf=s3d.lay(leaf,ground,reach=500)
        leaves.append(leaf)
    return s3d.group('scattered_fallen_canna_leaves',*leaves)


def fallen_folded_leaf_part(seed=0,length=340,color='#9b753c',width_ratio=.34,fold=14):
    shape=s3d.loft('folded_fallen_blade',s3d.station(0,3,3),s3d.station(length*.26,length*width_ratio*.8,fold,y=-fold),s3d.station(length*.6,length*width_ratio,fold*2,y=-fold),s3d.station(length*.85,length*width_ratio*.55,fold,y=-fold*2),s3d.station(length,2,2,y=-fold*3),tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(shape,'leaf',color=color,roughness=.96)
    rib=s3d.wire('fallen_leaf_rib',[(0,-2,0),(0,-fold*1.5,length*.26),(0,-fold*2,length*.6),(0,-fold*2.5,length*.85),(0,-fold*3,length)],3)
    s3d.material(rib,'leaf',color='#b59b60',roughness=.95)
    flat=s3d.at(s3d.group('fallen_folded_leaf',shape,rib),rx=-90)
    return s3d.group('fallen_leaf_ground_frame',flat)

import sand3d as s3d
import random
import numpy as np

def flowering_water_lily(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(10, smooth=False)
    soil = soil_patch(seed=seed + 1)
    grass = grass_tufts(soil, seed=seed + 2)
    hit = s3d.snap(soil, [s3d.Frame((0, 0, 100))], direction='-Z')[0]
    crown = s3d.at(shared_plant_base(seed=seed + 3), on=s3d.Frame(origin=hit.origin))
    stem = s3d.at(flower_stalk(seed=seed + 4), on=s3d.bbox(crown, '+Z'))
    foliage = s3d.at(pad_stalks(seed=seed + 5), on=s3d.bbox(crown, '+Z'))
    outer = s3d.at(outer_petal_whorl(seed=seed + 6), on=stem.tip)
    inner = s3d.at(inner_petal_whorls(seed=seed + 7), on=stem.tip)
    heart = s3d.at(golden_flower_center(seed=seed + 8), on=stem.tip)
    return s3d.assembly('flowering_water_lily', soil, grass, crown, stem, foliage, outer, inner, heart)

def soil_patch(seed=0, radius=330, aspect=0.84, edge_h=24, mound_h=39, irregularity=22):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    edge = s3d.ring(12, radius).jitter(x=irregularity, y=irregularity, seed=seed + 1)
    points = []
    for f in edge:
        x, y = (f.origin.x, f.origin.y * aspect)
        points.extend([(x, y, 0), (x * 0.97, y * 0.97, edge_h + rng.uniform(-5, 5))])
    points.extend([(0, 0, mound_h), (-radius / 2, 0, mound_h - 3), (radius / 2, 0, mound_h - 2)])
    soil = s3d.hull('uneven_brown_soil', points)
    s3d.material(soil, 'soil', color=lambda x, y, z: np.stack((0.32 + 0.035 * s3d.noise(x / 90, y / 90, z / 90, seed=seed + 2), 0.195 + 0.02 * s3d.noise(x / 90, y / 90, z / 90, seed=seed + 2), 0.105 + 0 * x), axis=-1), roughness=1)
    return soil

def grass_tufts(soil, seed=0, count=78, height=33, width=6):
    sites = s3d.scatter(count, soil, seed=seed + 1)
    kept = s3d.Frames((f for f in sites if f.normal.z > 0.7 and f.origin.x ** 2 + f.origin.y ** 2 > 65 ** 2))
    grass = s3d.tufts('sparse_angular_grass', kept, height=height, width=width, blades=4, lean=28, shape='cone', seed=seed + 2)
    s3d.material(grass, 'grass', color='#527c30', roughness=1)
    return grass

def shared_plant_base(seed=0, diameter=58, height=25):
    crown = s3d.dome('shared_green_crown', diameter, height)
    s3d.material(crown, 'leaf', color='#32643c', roughness=0.9)
    return crown

def flower_stalk(seed=0, height=326, lean=23, diameter=12, calyx_d=57, calyx_h=14):
    path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (-5, lean * 0.25, height * 0.38), (0, lean, height * 0.84), (0, lean, height)])
    stalk = s3d.wire('upright_flower_stalk', path, diameter)
    s3d.material(stalk, 'leaf', color='#3d7944', roughness=0.85)
    end = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]
    calyx = s3d.at(s3d.cone('green_flower_calyx', diameter * 2, calyx_h, d2=calyx_d), on=end)
    s3d.material(calyx, 'leaf', color='#357240', roughness=0.9)
    return s3d.assembly('flower_stalk', stalk, calyx, tip=end.offset(calyx_h * 0.6))

def pad_stalks(seed=0, diameter=9):
    specs = [(-166, -27, 99, 260, 231, -6, 8, 43), (156, 15, 133, 250, 223, 7, -9, 194), (-4, 142, 163, 237, 213, 9, 3, 292)]
    parts = []
    for k, (x, y, z, w, d, rx, ry, rz) in enumerate(specs):
        path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (x * 0.45, y * 0.4, z * 0.45), (x * 0.88, y * 0.9, z * 0.88), (x, y, z)])
        stem = s3d.wire('pad_stalk_' + str(k), path, diameter)
        s3d.material(stem, 'leaf', color='#397743', roughness=0.9)
        end = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]
        pad_frame = s3d.Frame(origin=end.origin).turn(rx=rx, ry=ry, rz=rz)
        pad = s3d.at(lily_pads(seed=seed + 10 + k, width=w, depth=d), on=pad_frame)
        parts.extend([stem, pad])
    return s3d.group('three_connected_pads', *parts)

def lily_pads(seed=0, width=260, depth=231, edge_lift=15, thickness=5, notch=43):
    r = width / 2
    profile = s3d.poly([(0, thickness), (r * 0.46, thickness), (r * 0.83, thickness + edge_lift * 0.3), (r, thickness + edge_lift), (r, edge_lift), (r * 0.83, edge_lift * 0.3), (r * 0.46, 0), (0, 0)])
    leaf = s3d.revolve('notched_cupped_lily_pad', profile, angle=360 - notch)
    leaf = s3d.scale(leaf, (1, depth / width, 1))
    s3d.material(leaf, 'leaf', color=['#398647', '#438e49', '#327a45'][seed % 3], roughness=0.95)
    return leaf

def outer_petal_whorl(seed=0, count=11, length=167, width=65, tilt=-78, root_radius=8):
    sites = s3d.ring(count, root_radius, start=8).turn(rx=tilt).jitter(rx=3, rz=3, seed=seed + 1)
    sizes = s3d.vary(1, 0.055, count, seed=seed + 2)
    petal = pointed_petal(seed=seed + 3, length=length, width=width, color='#dc6ca2')
    petals = s3d.at(petal, on=sites, scale=sizes)
    return s3d.group('outer_open_pink_whorl', *petals)

def pointed_petal(seed=0, length=167, width=60, thickness=7, curl=18, color='#ec85b1'):
    p = s3d.loft('pointed_pink_petal', s3d.station(0, width * 0.13, thickness * 0.6), s3d.station(length * 0.25, width * 0.68, thickness), s3d.station(length * 0.59, width, thickness * 1.15, y=-curl * 0.2), s3d.station(length * 0.83, width * 0.62, thickness * 0.72, y=-curl * 0.6), s3d.station(length, 0, 0, y=-curl), tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(p, 'plastic', color=color, roughness=0.92)
    return p

def inner_petal_whorls(seed=0):
    stages = [(9, 140, 55, -67, 24, 5, '#ee91bb'), (7, 102, 43, -52, 6, 9, '#f6b2ce')]
    rings = []
    for k, (count, length, width, tilt, turn, rise, color) in enumerate(stages):
        sites = s3d.ring(count, 7, start=turn).move(z=rise).turn(rx=tilt).jitter(rx=3, rz=4, seed=seed + 10 + k)
        petal = pointed_petal(seed=seed + 20 + k, length=length, width=width, curl=14, color=color)
        petals = s3d.at(petal, on=sites, scale=s3d.vary(1, 0.04, count, seed=seed + 30 + k))
        rings.append(s3d.group('inner_whorl_' + str(k), *petals))
    return s3d.group('inner_pink_petal_layers', *rings)

def golden_flower_center(seed=0, diameter=67, height=33, rise=24, stamen_n=15):
    mound = s3d.at(s3d.dome('raised_golden_receptacle', diameter, height), z=rise)
    s3d.material(mound, 'plastic', color='#e9aa24', roughness=0.95)
    stamens = s3d.at(golden_stamen(seed=seed + 1), on=s3d.ring(stamen_n, diameter * 0.47, start=11).move(z=rise - 6).turn(ry=13))
    inner = s3d.at(golden_stamen(seed=seed + 2, height=19, bulb=6), on=s3d.ring(9, diameter * 0.25).move(z=rise + height * 0.55).turn(ry=9))
    return s3d.group('golden_flower_center', mound, *stamens, *inner)

def golden_stamen(seed=0, height=29, diameter=3.4, bulb=7):
    filament = s3d.cylinder('gold_filament', diameter, height)
    s3d.material(filament, 'plastic', color='#f6c435', roughness=0.95)
    pollen = s3d.at(s3d.loft('angular_pollen_tip', s3d.station(0, bulb * 0.65, bulb * 0.65), s3d.station(bulb * 0.55, bulb, bulb), s3d.station(bulb * 1.4, bulb * 0.45, bulb * 0.45)), z=height - bulb * 0.3)
    s3d.material(pollen, 'plastic', color='#ffda4b', roughness=0.95)
    return s3d.group('short_golden_stamen', filament, pollen)

import sand3d as s3d
import random
import numpy as np


def snow_covered_tundra_grass_cluster(seed=0):
    sites = patch_layout(seed=seed + 1)
    sizes = s3d.vary(1.0, 0.32, len(sites), seed=seed + 2)
    earth = soil_clods(sites, sizes, seed=seed + 10)
    caps = soil_snow_caps(earth, sites, sizes, seed=seed + 20)
    grass = tundra_grass_tufts(earth, sites, sizes, seed=seed + 30)
    lodged = interblade_snow(caps, sites, sizes, seed=seed + 40)
    return s3d.assembly('snow_covered_tundra_grass_cluster', earth, caps, grass, lodged)


def patch_layout(seed=0):
    positions = [(-205, -130, -16), (190, -120, 23), (-15, 170, 12), (325, 155, -31), (-340, 150, 34)]
    frames = s3d.Frames([s3d.Frame((x, y, 0)).turn(rz=turn) for x, y, turn in positions])
    return frames.jitter(rz=8, seed=seed)


def soil_clods(sites, sizes, seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    clods = [s3d.at(soil_clod(seed=seed + 100 + i), on=frame, scale=size) for i, (frame, size) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes))]
    return s3d.group('soil_clods', clods)


def soil_clod(w=355, d=285, h=78, corners=9, seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    rim = s3d.ring(corners, 1).jitter(x=0.23, y=0.23, seed=seed + 1)
    pts = []
    for frame in rim:
        x, y = frame.origin.x * w / 2, frame.origin.y * d / 2
        pts.extend([(x * 0.77, y * 0.77, 0), (x, y, h * rng.uniform(0.55, 0.82)), (x * 0.49, y * 0.49, h * rng.uniform(0.88, 1.12))])
    clod = s3d.hull('jagged_earth_clod', pts)
    def earth_color(x, y, z):
        broad = s3d.noise(x / 95, y / 95, z / 95, seed=seed + 2)
        return np.where((broad > 0.05)[:, None], np.array([0.23, 0.19, 0.16]), np.array([0.15, 0.13, 0.12]))
    chip_sites = s3d.Frames([s3d.Frame((f.origin.x * w * 0.4, f.origin.y * d * 0.4, 0)) for f in list(rim)[::3]])
    chips = s3d.at(soil_fragment(w=w * 0.19, d=d * 0.19, h=h * 0.32, seed=seed + 3), on=chip_sites, scale=s3d.vary(1, 0.4, len(chip_sites), seed=seed + 4))
    rough = s3d.group('broken_soil_clod', clod, chips)
    s3d.material(rough, 'soil', color=earth_color, roughness=1)
    return rough


def soil_fragment(w=68, d=54, h=44, seed=0):
    rim = s3d.ring(5, 1).jitter(x=0.2, y=0.2, seed=seed)
    points = [(f.origin.x * w / 2, f.origin.y * d / 2, 0) for f in rim]
    points += [(f.origin.x * w * 0.38, f.origin.y * d * 0.38, h * 0.7) for f in rim]
    points.append((0, 0, h))
    return s3d.hull('attached_earth_fragment', points)


def soil_snow_caps(earth, sites, sizes, seed=0):
    caps = [snow_on_surface(earth, frame, w=283 * size, d=218 * size, h=37 * size, wind_gap=True, seed=seed + 100 + i) for i, (frame, size) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes))]
    return s3d.group('soil_snow_caps', caps)


def snow_on_surface(support, frame, w, d, h, corners=9, wind_gap=False, seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    outline = s3d.ring(corners, 1).jitter(x=0.23, y=0.23, seed=seed + 1)
    probes = [frame.point(f.origin.x * w / 2, f.origin.y * d / 2, 1000) for f in outline]
    hits = s3d.snap(support, probes, direction='-Z')
    pts = []
    for hit in hits:
        x, y, z = hit.origin.x, hit.origin.y, hit.origin.z
        pts.extend([(x, y, z - 4), (x, y, z + h * rng.uniform(0.3, 0.65))])
    center = s3d.snap(support, [frame.point(0, 0, 1000)], direction='-Z')[0].origin
    pts.append((center.x - w * 0.12, center.y + d * 0.08, center.z + h))
    pts.append((center.x + w * 0.17, center.y - d * 0.11, center.z + h * 0.84))
    snow = s3d.hull('uneven_snow_cap', pts)
    if wind_gap:
        opening = s3d.poly([(w * 0.08, -d), (w * 0.37, -d), (w * 0.14, d * 0.06), (-w * 0.06, -d * 0.05)])
        tool = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('wind_scoured_notch', opening, 1000), on=frame)
        snow = s3d.cut(snow, tool)
    s3d.material(snow, 'snow', color='#b7c5ce', roughness=1)
    return snow


def tundra_grass_tufts(earth, sites, sizes, seed=0):
    heights = s3d.vary(258, 67, len(sites), seed=seed + 1)
    fullness = s3d.vary(1, 0.3, len(sites), seed=seed + 2)
    hits = [s3d.snap(earth, [frame.point(0, 0, 1000)], direction='-Z')[0] for frame in sites]
    tufts = [s3d.at(grass_tuft(height=height, fullness=full, seed=seed + 100 + i), on=s3d.Frame(hit.origin).turn(rz=17 * i), scale=size) for i, (hit, height, full, size) in enumerate(zip(hits, heights, fullness, sizes))]
    for i, (frame, size) in enumerate(zip(list(sites)[:2], sizes[:2])):
        exposed = s3d.snap(earth, [frame.point(28 * size, -50 * size, 1000)], direction='-Z')[0]
        tufts.append(s3d.at(grass_tuft(height=145, fullness=0.28, seed=seed + 200 + i), on=s3d.Frame(exposed.origin).turn(rz=-31 * i), scale=size))
    return s3d.group('tundra_grass_tufts', tufts)


def grass_tuft(height=258, fullness=1, seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    palette = ['#a39462', '#8d8153', '#b6a477', '#626d46', '#9c9267']
    tiers = [(11, 0.16, 0.95, 0.16), (18, 0.32, 0.78, 0.41), (23, 0.49, 0.66, 0.63)]
    blades = []
    root_radius = height * 0.22
    for tier, (count, radius, length, lean) in enumerate(tiers):
        count = max(1, round(count * fullness))
        frames = s3d.ring(count, root_radius * radius, start=tier * 17).jitter(rz=22, rx=4, ry=5, seed=seed + tier * 10 + 1)
        lengths = s3d.vary(height * length, height * 0.17, count, seed=seed + tier * 10 + 2)
        widths = s3d.vary(13, 4, count, seed=seed + tier * 10 + 3)
        leans = s3d.vary(lean, 0.13, count, seed=seed + tier * 10 + 4)
        for frame, blade_h, width, slope in zip(frames, lengths, widths, leans):
            blade = grass_blade(h=blade_h, w=width, lean=blade_h * slope, color=rng.choice(palette), seed=seed + len(blades) + 100)
            blades.append(s3d.at(blade, on=frame))
    return s3d.group('compact_winter_tuft', blades)


def grass_blade(h=240, w=13, lean=85, thickness=1.5, color='#a39462', seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    drift = rng.uniform(-0.12, 0.12) * h
    blade = s3d.loft('folded_tapered_grass_ribbon', s3d.station(0, w * 0.32, thickness), s3d.station(h * 0.43, w, thickness, x=lean * 0.25, y=drift * 0.3), s3d.station(h, 0, 0, x=lean, y=drift), tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(blade, 'grass', color=color, roughness=0.91)
    return blade


def interblade_snow(caps, sites, sizes, seed=0):
    heights = s3d.vary(44, 16, len(sites), seed=seed + 1)
    mounds = [snow_on_surface(caps, frame.move(x=-22 * size, y=18 * size), w=90 * size, d=80 * size, h=height * size, corners=7, seed=seed + 100 + i) for i, (frame, size, height) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes, heights))]
    return s3d.group('interblade_snow', mounds)

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random


def snowbound_tussock_cottongrass(seed=0):
    snow = snow_patch(seed=seed + 1)
    layout = [(-62, 48, 490, 5, 1.0, -7, -5, 18), (73, 25, 390, 4, .86, 8, 9, 105), (-83, -67, 325, 3, .75, 6, -12, 210), (65, -73, 266, 2, .63, -9, 6, 310)]
    plants = []
    for i, (x, y, height, count, spread, rx, ry, rz) in enumerate(layout):
        hit = s3d.snap(snow, [(x, y, 180)], direction='-Z')[0]
        site = s3d.Frame(hit.origin).offset(-10).turn(rx=rx, ry=ry, rz=rz)
        plant = basal_tussocks(seed=seed + 100 * (i + 1), height=height, flowers=count, spread=spread)
        plants.append(s3d.at(plant, on=site))
    return s3d.assembly('snowbound_tussock_cottongrass', snow, *plants)


def snow_patch(seed=1, width=460, depth=380, thickness=44, drift_height=45, samples=14):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    sites = s3d.ring(samples, 1).jitter(x=.06, y=.06, seed=seed + 1)
    outline = [(f.origin.x * width / 2, f.origin.y * depth / 2) for f in sites]
    snow = s3d.extrude('thick_snow_blanket', s3d.poly(outline), thickness, taper=18)
    def drift(x, y, z):
        hummocks = .15 + .52 * np.exp(-((x + 62) ** 2 + (y - 48) ** 2) / 5200)
        hummocks += .48 * np.exp(-((x - 73) ** 2 + (y - 25) ** 2) / 4600)
        hummocks += .4 * np.exp(-((x + 83) ** 2 + (y + 67) ** 2) / 3500)
        hummocks += .4 * np.exp(-((x - 65) ** 2 + (y + 73) ** 2) / 3400)
        return np.clip(hummocks + .13 * s3d.noise(x / 85, y / 85, z / 85, seed=seed + 2), 0, 1)
    snow = s3d.displace(snow, drift_height, 55, noise=drift, direction='+Z', faces='top', step=32)
    s3d.material(snow, 'snow', color='#aebcc7', roughness=1)
    return snow


def basal_tussocks(seed=100, height=490, flowers=5, spread=1.0, blades=29, base_radius=12):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    flower_frames = s3d.ring(flowers, base_radius * .5, start=rng.uniform(0, 360)).jitter(rz=16, x=3, y=3, seed=seed + 1)
    heights = s3d.vary(height * .87, height * .13, flowers, seed=seed + 2)
    stems = [s3d.at(flowering_stems(seed=seed + 20 + k, height=h, drift=spread * rng.uniform(20, 65)), on=f) for k, (f, h) in enumerate(zip(flower_frames, heights))]
    leaf_frames = s3d.ring(blades, base_radius, start=rng.uniform(0, 360)).jitter(rz=16, rx=8, ry=8, z=2, seed=seed + 3)
    lengths = s3d.vary(205 * spread, 85 * spread, len(leaf_frames), seed=seed + 4)
    leaves = [s3d.at(leaf_blade(seed=seed + 80 + k, length=length, width=rng.uniform(3.5, 6.2), dry=rng.random() < .4), on=f) for k, (f, length) in enumerate(zip(leaf_frames, lengths))]
    return s3d.group('basal_tussock', *stems, *leaves)


def flowering_stems(seed=120, height=450, drift=50, diameter=2.5):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    bend = rng.uniform(-9, 9)
    path = [(0, 0, 0), (drift * .16, bend, height * .42), (drift * .62, bend * .5, height * .78), (drift, 0, height)]
    stem = s3d.wire('angular_flowering_stem', path, d=diameter)
    s3d.material(stem, 'leaf', color=lambda x, y, z: np.where((z > height * .67)[:, None], [.57, .53, .29], [.31, .39, .20]), roughness=1)
    endpoint = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]
    head = s3d.at(cotton_head(seed=seed + 1, width=rng.uniform(27, 36), height=rng.uniform(57, 73)), on=endpoint)
    return s3d.group('flowering_stem_and_cotton', stem, head)


def cotton_head(seed=121, width=32, height=65, lobes=7):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    core = s3d.loft('ivory_cotton_core',
        s3d.station(0, width * .22, width * .20),
        s3d.station(height * .16, width * .72, width * .65, x=-width * .04),
        s3d.station(height * .40, width, width * .88, x=width * .02),
        s3d.station(height * .72, width * .85, width * .76, x=-width * .06),
        s3d.station(height * .91, width * .4, width * .35),
        s3d.station(height, 0, 0, x=width * .04), tip='sharp')
    s3d.material(core, 'fabric', color='#c7bfab', roughness=1)
    frames = s3d.ring(lobes, width * .28).jitter(rx=9, ry=9, rz=20, z=height * .06, seed=seed + 1)
    scales = s3d.vary(1, .2, len(frames), seed=seed + 2)
    frays = []
    for f, factor in zip(frames, scales):
        lobe = s3d.loft('jagged_cotton_lobe',
            s3d.station(height * .13, width * .22, width * .20),
            s3d.station(height * .35, width * .48, width * .42, x=width * .10),
            s3d.station(height * .61 * factor, width * .35, width * .32, x=width * .15),
            s3d.station(height * .91 * factor, 0, 0, x=width * .25), tip='sharp')
        s3d.material(lobe, 'fabric', color=rng.choice(['#d1c9b5', '#bab6a7', '#c9c2af']), roughness=1)
        frays.append(s3d.at(lobe, on=f))
    return s3d.group('irregular_ivory_cotton_tuft', core, *frays)


def leaf_blade(seed=180, length=210, width=5, dry=False, thickness=.7):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    reach = length * rng.uniform(.38, .66)
    kink = rng.uniform(.58, .76)
    leaf = s3d.loft('folded_pointed_leaf',
        s3d.station(0, width * .36, thickness),
        s3d.station(length * .33, width, thickness * 1.5, x=reach * .10),
        s3d.station(length * kink, width * .67, thickness, x=reach * .46),
        s3d.station(length * .82, 0, 0, x=reach), tip='sharp')
    palette = ['#a28b4e', '#b09b62', '#8e8049'] if dry else ['#4b6037', '#5e7141', '#6e7744', '#3f5734']
    s3d.material(leaf, 'leaf', color=rng.choice(palette), roughness=1)
    return leaf

items.program:
import sand3d as s3d
import random
import numpy as np


def new_zealand_flax(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(6, smooth=False)
    crown = root_crown(seed=seed + 1)
    sheaths = overlapping_basal_sheaths(crown, seed=seed + 2)
    inner = erect_inner_blades(sheaths, seed=seed + 3)
    middle = ascending_fan_blades(sheaths, seed=seed + 4)
    outer = splayed_outer_blades(sheaths, seed=seed + 5)
    return s3d.assembly('new_zealand_flax', crown, sheaths, inner, middle, outer)


def root_crown(seed, width=235, depth=200, height=85):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    crown = s3d.loft('compact_root_crown',
        s3d.station(0, width * .72, depth * .72),
        s3d.station(height * .30, width, depth, x=rng.uniform(-7, 7)),
        s3d.station(height * .72, width * .85, depth * .88, y=6),
        s3d.station(height, width * .48, depth * .46))
    s3d.material(crown, 'bark', color='#343b22', roughness=1)
    return crown


def overlapping_basal_sheaths(crown, seed, span=110, sheath_h=230):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    probes = [s3d.Frame((0, 0, sheath_h)),
              s3d.Frame((-span / 2, -span * .32, sheath_h)),
              s3d.Frame((span / 2, -span * .25, sheath_h)),
              s3d.Frame((-span * .35, span / 2, sheath_h)),
              s3d.Frame((span * .40, span * .42, sheath_h))]
    hits = s3d.snap(crown, probes, direction='-Z')
    orientations = [-34, 16, 61, 103, -72]
    anchors = {}
    sheath_parts = []
    for i, (hit, angle) in enumerate(zip(hits, orientations)):
        frame = s3d.Frame(tuple(hit.origin)).turn(rz=angle)
        anchors['fan' + str(i)] = frame
        pair = s3d.Frames([frame.turn(rz=side) for side in (0, 180)])
        sheath = sword_blade(seed + 100 + i, height=sheath_h,
                            reach=55, width=68, droop=.08,
                            tone='#35482a', edge='#64743b', basal=True)
        sheath_parts += s3d.at(sheath, on=pair, scale=rng.uniform(.88, 1.05))
    return s3d.assembly('overlapping_basal_sheaths', *sheath_parts, **anchors)


def blade_sites(sheaths, count, seed, spread=15, rank_pitch=4):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    frames = []
    for i in range(count):
        fan = getattr(sheaths, 'fan' + str(i % 5))
        side = 180 if (i // 5) % 2 else 0
        frames.append(fan.move(x=rng.uniform(-spread, spread),
                               y=rng.uniform(-spread, spread), z=-8)
                      .turn(rz=side + rng.uniform(-rank_pitch, rank_pitch)))
    return s3d.Frames(frames)


def erect_inner_blades(sheaths, seed):
    return leaf_population('erect_inner_blades', sheaths, seed, count=14,
                           height=(1480, 1770), reach=(110, 360),
                           width=(62, 87), droop=(0, .055), spread=12)


def ascending_fan_blades(sheaths, seed):
    return leaf_population('ascending_fan_blades', sheaths, seed, count=22,
                           height=(1170, 1500), reach=(410, 740),
                           width=(73, 104), droop=(.025, .17), spread=20)


def splayed_outer_blades(sheaths, seed):
    return leaf_population('splayed_outer_blades', sheaths, seed, count=18,
                           height=(790, 1120), reach=(650, 925),
                           width=(70, 106), droop=(.22, .40), spread=30)


def leaf_population(name, sheaths, seed, count, height, reach, width, droop, spread):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sites = blade_sites(sheaths, count, seed + 10, spread=spread, rank_pitch=13)
    palette = [('#344c2b', '#88964f'), ('#405a30', '#a5ab61'),
               ('#536538', '#a6ad64'), ('#29462d', '#7c9250'),
               ('#68733d', '#b0b374')]
    blades = []
    for i, frame in enumerate(sites):
        tone, edge = rng.choice(palette)
        blade = sword_blade(seed + 100 + i,
                            height=rng.uniform(*height),
                            reach=rng.uniform(*reach),
                            width=rng.uniform(*width),
                            droop=rng.uniform(*droop), tone=tone, edge=edge)
        blades.append(s3d.at(blade, on=frame))
    return s3d.group(name, *blades)


def sword_blade(seed, height, reach, width, droop, tone, edge,
                fold=.12, thickness=2.5, edge_width=1.8, basal=False):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    drift = rng.uniform(-.12, .12) * reach
    path = [(0, 0, 0),
            (drift * .04, reach * .025, height * .20),
            (drift * .18, reach * .13, height * .43),
            (drift * .44, reach * .36, height * .68),
            (drift * .73, reach * .69, height * .88),
            (drift, reach, height * (1 - droop))]
    half = width / 2
    ridge = width * fold
    profile = s3d.poly([(-half, 0), (0, -ridge), (half, 0),
                       (half, -thickness), (0, -ridge - thickness),
                       (-half, -thickness)])
    law = [(0, .47), (.12, .85), (.32, 1), (.59, .84), (.82, .48), (1, 0)]
    blade = s3d.sweep('folded_sword_leaf', profile, path,
                     scale=law, tip='sharp')
    rgb = np.array([int(tone[k:k+2], 16) / 255 for k in (1, 3, 5)])
    base = np.array([.16, .22, .115])
    def leaf_colour(x, y, z, n, u):
        t = np.clip((u - .035) / .22, 0, 1)
        if basal:
            t = t * .66
        return base[None, :] * (1-t[:, None]) + rgb[None, :] * t[:, None]
    s3d.material(blade, 'leaf', color=leaf_colour, roughness=.92)
    margins = []
    for sign in (-1, 1):
        x = sign * (half - edge_width / 2)
        y = -ridge * (edge_width / 2) / half
        band = s3d.poly([(x - edge_width/2, y),
                        (x, y + thickness * .22),
                        (x + edge_width/2, y),
                        (x, y - thickness * .22)])
        margin = s3d.sweep('pale_leaf_margin', band, path,
                          scale=law, tip='sharp')
        s3d.material(margin, 'leaf', color=edge, roughness=.95)
        margins.append(margin)
    return s3d.group('sword_blade', blade, *margins)

import sand3d as s3d
import random
import math

def tech_punk_parasol_cluster(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(6, smooth=False)
    stump = weathered_stump(seed=seed + 1)
    moss = moss_patches(stump, seed=seed + 2)
    tall = s3d.at(tall_parasol(seed=seed + 10), x=-28, y=20, z=67)
    right = s3d.at(right_parasol(seed=seed + 20), x=35, y=0, z=65)
    front = s3d.at(front_parasol(seed=seed + 30), x=-38, y=-38, z=64)
    rear = s3d.at(rear_parasol(seed=seed + 40), x=25, y=37, z=67)
    return s3d.assembly('tech_punk_parasol_cluster', stump, moss, tall, right, front, rear)

def weathered_stump(seed=1, width=141, depth=123, height=75, flare=19):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    stations = [s3d.station(0, width + flare, depth + flare, n=3), s3d.station(height * 0.18, width, depth, n=3), s3d.station(height * 0.82, width * 0.83, depth * 0.85, x=4, n=3), s3d.station(height, width * 0.78, depth * 0.78, x=3, n=3)]
    wood = s3d.loft('root_flared_stump', *stations, tip='sharp')

    def bark_color(x, y, z):
        patch = s3d.noise(x / 26, y / 26, z / 40, seed=seed + 1)
        return (0.2 + patch * 0.07, 0.135 + patch * 0.05, 0.086 + patch * 0.035)
    s3d.material(wood, 'bark', color=bark_color)
    top = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('exposed_broken_heartwood', s3d.polygon(6, width * 0.76), 3), x=3, z=height - 1)
    s3d.material(top, 'walnut', color='#826449', roughness=0.95)
    grooves = []
    for f in s3d.ring(9, width * 0.39):
        h = height * rng.uniform(0.64, 1.12)
        shard = s3d.loft('broken_bark_rib', s3d.station(0, 15, 12, n=3), s3d.station(h * 0.75, 10, 9, x=3, n=3), s3d.station(h, 4, 5, x=6, n=3), tip='sharp')
        s3d.material(shard, 'bark', color=rng.choice(['#392a21', '#493427', '#594031']))
        grooves.append(s3d.at(shard, on=f))
    return s3d.group('weathered_stump', wood, top, *grooves)

def moss_patches(stump, seed=2, count=20):
    sites = s3d.scatter(count * 3, stump, seed=seed)
    kept = [f for f in sites if f.origin.z > 22 and f.normal.z > 0.3]
    rng = random.Random(seed + 1)
    patches = []
    for f in kept[:count]:
        p = s3d.dome('angular_moss_patch', rng.uniform(12, 24), rng.uniform(3, 7))
        s3d.material(p, 'moss', color=rng.choice(['#4b5c2b', '#64723a', '#354629']))
        patches.append(s3d.at(p, on=f))
    return s3d.group('moss_patches', *patches)

def tall_parasol(seed=10):
    return parasol_mushroom('tall_parasol', seed=seed, height=207, radius=97, lean=-10, tilt=-8, spin=12)

def parasol_mushroom(name, seed, height, radius, lean, tilt, spin):
    stem, path = mushroom_stem(seed=seed + 1, height=height, lean=lean)
    cap_frame = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1].turn(ry=tilt, rz=spin)
    cap = s3d.at(angular_umbrella(seed=seed + 2, radius=radius), on=cap_frame)
    collar_frame = s3d.along(path, count=2, span=(0.68, 0.77))[-1]
    collar = s3d.at(stem_collar_rings(seed=seed + 3, diameter=radius * 0.36), on=collar_frame)
    return s3d.group(name, stem, cap, collar)

def mushroom_stem(seed=1, height=200, lean=0, diameter=10):
    path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (lean * 0.15, -3, height * 0.34), (lean * 0.72, 1, height * 0.73), (lean, 0, height)])
    stem = s3d.wire('bent_ivory_stem', path, d=[(0, diameter * 1.24), (0.46, diameter * 0.8), (1, diameter)], tip='flat')
    s3d.material(stem, 'ceramic', color='#cfc6a5', roughness=0.94)
    markings = stem_zigzag_markings(stem, path, seed=seed + 1, diameter=diameter)
    return (s3d.group('mushroom_stem', stem, markings), path)

def stem_zigzag_markings(stem, path, seed=1, diameter=10, count=7):
    frames = s3d.along(path, count=count, spin=137, span=(0.15, 0.65))
    patches = []
    for f in frames:
        outline = s3d.poly([(-diameter * 0.38, -2), (-diameter * 0.08, 1), (diameter * 0.18, -1), (diameter * 0.42, 2), (diameter * 0.42, 4), (diameter * 0.1, 1), (-diameter * 0.1, 3), (-diameter * 0.38, 0)])
        p = s3d.extrude('dark_snakeskin_chevron', outline, 0.35)
        s3d.material(p, 'bark', color='#4d3d31')
        surface = f.move(x=diameter * 0.43).turn(ry=90)
        patches.append(s3d.at(p, on=surface))
    return s3d.group('stem_zigzag_markings', *patches)

def angular_umbrella(seed=1, radius=90, segments=12):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    outer = []
    for i, f in enumerate(s3d.ring(segments, radius)):
        v = f.origin
        scale = rng.uniform(0.88, 1.1)
        outer.append((v.x * scale, v.y * scale, radius * rng.uniform(-0.035, 0.045)))
    inner = [(x * 0.45, y * 0.45, radius * (0.205 + rng.uniform(-0.025, 0.025))) for x, y, z in outer]
    knob = [(x * 0.16 + radius * 0.025, y * 0.16 - radius * 0.025, radius * (0.32 + rng.uniform(-0.015, 0.015))) for x, y, z in outer]
    faces = []
    for i in range(segments):
        j = (i + 1) % segments
        p = s3d.hull('ivory_umbrella_plate', [outer[i], outer[j], inner[j], inner[i], (outer[i][0], outer[i][1], outer[i][2] - 2), (outer[j][0], outer[j][1], outer[j][2] - 2)])
        s3d.material(p, 'fabric', color=rng.choice(['#b5ae96', '#a8a28c', '#c4bca4', '#b7ab92']), roughness=0.96)
        faces.append(p)
        k = s3d.hull('dark_raised_umbo', [inner[i], inner[j], knob[j], knob[i], (0, 0, radius * 0.365), (0, 0, radius * 0.15)])
        s3d.material(k, 'bark', color=rng.choice(['#4b3b32', '#5c4535', '#6c513b']), roughness=0.95)
        faces.append(k)
    gills = radial_gill_ridges(outer, seed=seed + 1, radius=radius)
    scales = jagged_cap_scales(outer, inner, seed=seed + 2, radius=radius)
    seams = cyan_cap_seams(outer, inner, seed=seed + 3, radius=radius)
    return s3d.group('angular_umbrella', *faces, gills, scales, seams)

def radial_gill_ridges(outer, seed=1, radius=90):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    ridges = []
    for i in range(len(outer)):
        a = outer[i]
        b = outer[(i + 1) % len(outer)]
        for t in (0.12, 0.48, 0.82):
            x = a[0] * (1 - t) + b[0] * t
            y = a[1] * (1 - t) + b[1] * t
            z = a[2] * (1 - t) + b[2] * t
            w = radius * 0.012
            ridge = s3d.hull('radial_gill_wedge', [(x * 0.12, y * 0.12, -radius * 0.035), (x * 0.96, y * 0.96, z - 2), (x * 0.72, y * 0.72, -radius * 0.15), (x * 0.55 - y / radius * w, y * 0.55 + x / radius * w, radius * 0.1), (x * 0.55 + y / radius * w, y * 0.55 - x / radius * w, radius * 0.1)])
            s3d.material(ridge, 'fabric', color=rng.choice(['#bcb699', '#99947b', '#cec5a7']), roughness=1)
            ridges.append(ridge)
    return s3d.group('radial_gill_ridges', *ridges)

def jagged_cap_scales(outer, inner, seed=1, radius=90, count=4):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    scales = []
    for i in range(len(outer)):
        a = outer[i]
        b = outer[(i + 1) % len(outer)]
        for k in range(count):
            u = rng.uniform(0.47, 0.9)
            t = rng.uniform(0.2, 0.8)
            x = (a[0] * (1 - t) + b[0] * t) * u
            y = (a[1] * (1 - t) + b[1] * t) * u
            edgez = a[2] * (1 - t) + b[2] * t
            z = radius * 0.205 * (1 - u) / 0.55 + edgez * (u - 0.45) / 0.55 + 1.2
            width = radius * rng.uniform(0.065, 0.13) * (1.25 - u)
            length = width * rng.uniform(1.2, 1.9)
            q = s3d.extrude('jagged_charcoal_scale', s3d.poly([(-width * 0.5, -length * 0.4), (width * 0.2, -length * 0.52), (width * 0.52, -length * 0.1), (width * 0.25, length * 0.48), (-width * 0.15, length * 0.25), (-width * 0.52, length * 0.4)]), 0.9)
            s3d.material(q, 'bark', color=rng.choice(['#493a30', '#614a37', '#7a5c41']), roughness=0.97)
            f = s3d.Frame((x, y, z), normal=(x / radius * 0.38, y / radius * 0.38, 1))
            scales.append(s3d.at(q, on=f, rz=rng.uniform(0, 360)))
    return s3d.group('jagged_cap_scales', *scales)

def cyan_cap_seams(outer, inner, seed=1, radius=90, count=3):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    seams = []
    for i in rng.sample(range(len(outer)), count):
        a = outer[i]
        b = inner[i]
        p = [(a[0] * 0.84, a[1] * 0.84, a[2] * 0.71 + b[2] * 0.29 + 1), (b[0] * 1.12, b[1] * 1.12, b[2] * 0.91 + 1)]
        seam = s3d.wire('cyan_inlaid_cap_seam', p, d=radius * 0.009, tip='flat')
        s3d.material(seam, 'painted_metal', color='#38c8c3', emission=1.8, roughness=0.7)
        seams.append(seam)
    return s3d.group('cyan_cap_seams', *seams)

def stem_collar_rings(seed=1, diameter=30, height=10):
    skirt = s3d.revolve('flared_fungal_annulus', s3d.poly([(5, 0), (diameter * 0.5, -height * 0.35), (diameter * 0.58, 0), (diameter * 0.28, height * 0.4), (6, height * 0.5)]))
    s3d.material(skirt, 'ceramic', color='#d0c5a0', roughness=0.95)
    band = s3d.tube('oxidized_copper_collar', 14, 10, height * 0.7)

    def copper_color(x, y, z):
        n = s3d.noise(x / 6, y / 6, z / 6, seed=seed)
        return '#3f8275' if n > 0.04 else '#9b6241'
    s3d.material(band, 'copper', color=copper_color, roughness=0.79, metallic=0.65)
    rivets = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder('collar_stud', 2.8, 2.5), on=s3d.ring(3, 7).turn(ry=90), z=height * 0.35)
    s3d.material(rivets, 'copper', color='#795137', roughness=0.7)
    return s3d.group('stem_collar_rings', skirt, band, rivets)

def right_parasol(seed=20):
    return parasol_mushroom('right_parasol', seed=seed, height=142, radius=80, lean=30, tilt=15, spin=53)

def front_parasol(seed=30):
    return parasol_mushroom('front_parasol', seed=seed, height=91, radius=65, lean=-17, tilt=27, spin=8)

def rear_parasol(seed=40):
    return parasol_mushroom('rear_parasol', seed=seed, height=151, radius=51, lean=10, tilt=18, spin=91)

import sand3d as s3d
import random


def snow_covered_hollow_fallen_log(seed=0):
    length, width, height = 3600, 1450, 1320
    wall, rim_depth, snow_depth = 230, 100, 180
    frame=s3d.Frame((-length/2,0,height*0.48)).turn(rx=90,rz=90)
    trunk=s3d.at(angular_trunk_shell(length,width,height,wall,seed+1),on=frame)
    lining=s3d.at(dark_hollow_lining(length,width,height,wall,seed+2),on=frame)
    front=s3d.at(prominent_open_end_rim(length,width,height,wall,rim_depth,seed+3),on=frame)
    back=s3d.at(far_broken_end_rim(length,width,height,wall,rim_depth,seed+4),on=frame)
    bark=s3d.at(broad_bark_grooves(length,width,height,seed+5),on=frame)
    snow=s3d.at(chunky_crown_snow(length,width,height,snow_depth,seed+6),on=frame)
    rim_snow=s3d.at(upper_rim_snow(length,width,height,snow_depth,seed+7),on=frame)
    return s3d.assembly('snow_covered_hollow_fallen_log',trunk,lining,front,back,bark,snow,rim_snow)


def angular_trunk_shell(length,width,height,wall,seed):
    s3d.facets(10,smooth=False)
    shell=polygonal_tube('thick_trunk',length,width,height,0,wall)
    s3d.material(shell,'bark',color='#553729',roughness=1)
    return shell


def polygonal_tube(name,length,width,height,outer_inset,inner_inset):
    body=s3d.extrude(name,s3d.poly(outline_points(width,height,outer_inset)),length)
    cutter=s3d.at(s3d.extrude('empty_bore',s3d.poly(outline_points(width,height,inner_inset)),length+2),z=-1)
    return s3d.cut(body,cutter)


def outline_points(width,height,inset=0):
    # Deliberately uneven ten-sided silhouette; the two bottom vertices form the broad foot.
    outline=[(0.97,0.12),(0.80,0.64),(0.24,1),(-0.42,0.94),(-0.91,0.53),(-1,-0.12),(-0.75,-0.78),(-0.32,-0.96),(0.45,-0.96),(0.91,-0.52)]
    return [(x*(width/2-inset),(y+0.96)*(height/2-inset)-height*0.48+inset) for x,y in outline]


def dark_hollow_lining(length,width,height,wall,seed):
    lining=polygonal_tube('dark_inner_wood',length,width,height,wall-8,wall+2)
    s3d.material(lining,'bark',color='#291e19',roughness=1)
    return lining


def prominent_open_end_rim(length,width,height,wall,depth,seed):
    return end_rim('near_exposed_wood',-depth*0.6,length,width,height,wall,depth,seed)


def end_rim(name,z,length,width,height,wall,depth,seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    outer=outline_points(width,height,-2)
    inner=outline_points(width,height,wall+3)
    pieces=[]
    palette=['#bd8850','#cf9c63','#c39159','#d3a26a']
    for i in range(10):
        j=(i+1)%10
        profile=s3d.poly([outer[i],outer[j],inner[j],inner[i]])
        extent=depth*rng.uniform(0.8,1.3)
        piece=s3d.at(s3d.extrude(name,profile,extent),z=z+rng.uniform(-depth*0.25,depth*0.25))
        s3d.material(piece,'oak',color=rng.choice(palette),roughness=0.9)
        pieces.append(piece)
    return s3d.group(name,*pieces)


def far_broken_end_rim(length,width,height,wall,depth,seed):
    return end_rim('far_exposed_wood',length-depth*0.4,length,width,height,wall,depth,seed)


def broad_bark_grooves(length,width,height,seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    # Uneven axial splits and narrow gaps between radial plates form shallow broad grooves.
    spans=[0,0.24,0.55,0.79,1]
    colors=['#69432e','#754c32','#805337','#62402e','#895b3b']
    gap,relief=0.03,32
    outer=outline_points(width,height,-relief)
    inner=outline_points(width,height,3)
    pieces=[]
    for a,b in zip(spans[:-1],spans[1:]):
        for i in range(10):
            if i==7:
                continue
            j=(i+1)%10
            profile=s3d.poly([interpolate(outer[i],outer[j],gap),interpolate(outer[i],outer[j],1-gap),interpolate(inner[i],inner[j],1-gap),interpolate(inner[i],inner[j],gap)])
            start=max(0,a+rng.uniform(-0.01,0.01))
            end=min(1,b-rng.uniform(0.01,0.02))
            plate=s3d.at(s3d.extrude('chunky_bark_plate',profile,(end-start)*length),z=start*length)
            s3d.material(plate,'bark',color=rng.choice(colors),roughness=1)
            pieces.append(plate)
    return s3d.group('broad_shallow_bark_channels',*pieces)


def interpolate(a,b,f):
    return tuple(x+(y-x)*f for x,y in zip(a,b))


def chunky_crown_snow(length,width,height,depth,seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    # Broad overlapping snow masses vary both their lateral reach and their height.
    stages=[(0.02,0.30,0.40,0.9),(0.27,0.63,0.14,1.1),(0.60,0.98,0.48,1)]
    pieces=[snow_strip('crown_snow',a,b,length,width,height,depth*thickness*rng.uniform(0.96,1.04),edge) for a,b,edge,thickness in stages]
    return s3d.group('faceted_crown_snow',*pieces)


def snow_strip(name,a,b,length,width,height,depth,edge):
    arc=outline_points(width,height,-20)[:6]
    arc[0]=interpolate(arc[0],arc[1],edge)
    arc[-1]=interpolate(arc[-1],arc[-2],edge)
    crown=[0.30,0.86,1,1,0.86,0.30]
    bottom=[(x,y-14) for x,y in arc]
    top=[(x*1.025,y+depth*crown[i]) for i,(x,y) in enumerate(arc)]
    profile=s3d.poly(list(reversed(bottom))+top)
    snow=s3d.at(s3d.extrude(name,profile,(b-a)*length),z=a*length)
    s3d.material(snow,'plastic',color='#dce6ed',roughness=1,metallic=0,opacity=1,transmission=0,emission=0)
    return s3d.group(name,snow)


def upper_rim_snow(length,width,height,depth,seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    reach=0.06
    near=snow_strip('near_rim_snow',-0.025,reach,length,width,height,depth*0.8,rng.uniform(0.65,0.8))
    far=snow_strip('far_rim_snow',1-reach,1.025,length,width,height,depth*0.8,rng.uniform(0.65,0.8))
    return s3d.group('upper_rim_snow',near,far)
