import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random


def snow_covered_millstone(seed=0):
    stone = millstone_body(seed=seed + 1)
    stone = s3d.cut(stone, square_aperture_tool(seed=seed + 2))
    stone = s3d.cut(stone, grinding_furrows_tool(seed=seed + 3))
    stone = s3d.cut(stone, rim_chips_tool(seed=seed + 4))
    stone = granite_weathering(stone, seed=seed + 5)
    snow = snow_blanket(seed=seed + 6)
    snow = s3d.cut(snow, rim_chips_tool(seed=seed + 4))
    needles = caught_pine_needles(snow, seed=seed + 7)
    return s3d.assembly('snow_covered_millstone', stone, snow, needles)


def millstone_body(seed=1, diameter=1240, height=294, bevel=36):
    s3d.facets(10, smooth=False)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sites = s3d.ring(10, diameter / 2, start=18)
    radii = [rng.uniform(.96, 1.025) for f in sites]
    pts = []
    for f, ratio in zip(sites, radii):
        x, y, _ = tuple(f.origin)
        for z, inset in [(0,.91),(bevel,1),(height-bevel,1),(height,.94)]:
            pts.append((x*ratio*inset,y*ratio*inset,z))
    stone = s3d.hull('angular_granite_disk', pts)
    return stone


def square_aperture_tool(seed=2, width=222, depth=450):
    tool = s3d.extrude('square_eye_tool', s3d.rect(width, width), depth)
    return s3d.at(tool, z=-depth/5, rz=8)


def grinding_furrows_tool(seed=3, count=10, inner=156, outer=610, width=25, top=305, depth=42, pitch=45):
    section = s3d.poly([(inner,-width/2),(outer,-width),(outer,width/2),(inner,width/2)])
    tool = s3d.extrude('radial_furrow_tool', section, depth)
    frames = s3d.ring(count, 0, start=18).move(z=top-depth)
    primary = s3d.at(tool, on=frames)
    second = s3d.extrude('secondary_grinding_tool',s3d.poly([(inner*1.5,pitch),(outer,pitch-width/2),(outer,pitch+width/2),(inner*1.5,pitch+width/2)]),depth)
    secondary = s3d.at(second,on=frames)
    return primary + secondary


def rim_chips_tool(seed=4, radius=606, count=7, depth=96, base=184, height=170):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    frames = s3d.ring(count, radius, start=31).jitter(rz=12,z=22,seed=seed+1)
    chips=[]
    for f in frames:
        w = rng.uniform(58,115)
        reach=depth*rng.uniform(.7,1.15)
        chip = s3d.hull('rim_chip_tool', [(depth,-w/2,0),(depth,w/2,0),(-reach*.2,-w/4,height*.32),(-reach*.4,w/4,height*.4),(-reach,-w/2,height),(-reach,w/2,height),(depth,-w/2,height),(depth,w/2,height)])
        chips.append(s3d.at(chip, on=f.move(z=base)))
    return chips


def granite_weathering(stone, seed=5):
    def granite_color(x,y,z,n):
        broad = s3d.noise(x/115,y/115,z/115,seed=seed)
        fleck = s3d.noise(x/35,y/35,z/35,seed=seed+1)
        shade = .045 * fleck
        base = np.stack((x*0+.40+shade,y*0+.47+shade,z*0+.52+shade),axis=-1)
        charcoal = np.stack((x*0+.24+shade,y*0+.29+shade,z*0+.32+shade),axis=-1)
        base = np.where((broad < -.20)[...,None],charcoal,base)
        wall = ((np.maximum(np.abs(x),np.abs(y)) < 170)&(z>25)) | ((z>255)&(z<278)&(n[2]>.5))
        return np.where(wall[...,None],charcoal,base)
    s3d.material(stone,'rock',color=granite_color,roughness=1)
    sites=s3d.scatter(150,stone,seed=seed+2)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.origin.z>55 and f.origin.z<225 and abs(f.normal.z)<.6]
    patches=[s3d.at(weathering_patch(seed=seed+100+i),on=f.offset(.8)) for i,f in enumerate(kept[:16])]
    darksites=s3d.scatter(80,stone,seed=seed+3)
    darkkept=[f for f in darksites if f.origin.z>90 and f.origin.z<235 and abs(f.normal.z)<.5]
    charcoal=[s3d.at(weathering_patch(seed=seed+200+i,diameter=100,thickness=1.2,name='charcoal_patch',kind='rock',palette=('#343E43','#414A50','#303A42')),on=f.offset(.5)) for i,f in enumerate(darkkept[:7])]
    return s3d.group('weathered_granite',stone,patches,charcoal)


def weathering_patch(seed=100, diameter=34, thickness=2.4, name='olive_lichen', kind='moss', palette=('#727957','#818565','#646C51')):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    diameter=diameter*rng.uniform(.6,1.5)
    outline=s3d.ring(7,diameter/2).jitter(x=diameter*.13,y=diameter*.13,seed=seed+1)
    points=[]
    for f in outline:
        x,y,z=tuple(f.origin)
        points.extend([(x,y,0),(x*.85,y*.85,thickness)])
    patch=s3d.hull(name,points)
    s3d.material(patch,kind,color=rng.choice(palette),roughness=1)
    return patch


def snow_blanket(seed=6, diameter=1206, bottom=287, height=78, hole=245):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    frames=s3d.ring(20,diameter/2,start=18)
    points=[]
    for f in frames:
        x,y,z=tuple(f.origin)
        inset=rng.uniform(.92,1.01)
        points.extend([(x*inset,y*inset,bottom),(x*inset*.96,y*inset*.96,bottom+rng.uniform(height*.15,height*.45))])
    points.extend([(-diameter/5,diameter/6,bottom+height),(diameter/6,diameter/4,bottom+height*.85),(-diameter/5,-diameter/6,bottom+height*.7)])
    snow=s3d.hull('snow_blanket',points)
    eye=s3d.at(s3d.extrude('snow_eye_tool',s3d.rect(hole,hole),height*4),z=bottom-height,rz=8)
    snow=s3d.cut(snow,eye)
    cuts=[]
    settings=[(35,280,170),(116,170,220),(202,230,170),(287,390,310)]
    for i,(angle,w,d) in enumerate(settings):
        outline=s3d.ring(8,1,start=18).jitter(x=.17,y=.17,seed=seed+10+i)
        pts=[]
        for f in outline:
            x,y,z=tuple(f.origin)
            for h in [bottom-height,bottom+height*2]:
                pts.append((x*w,y*d,h))
        cutter=s3d.hull('irregular_snow_melt_tool',pts)
        frame=s3d.ring(1,diameter*.45,start=angle)[0]
        cuts.append(s3d.at(cutter,on=frame))
    snow=s3d.cut(snow,cuts)
    s3d.material(snow,'snow',color='#BCCDD7',roughness=1)
    return snow


def caught_pine_needles(snow,seed=7,count=12,length=88,width=5,splay=16):
    sites=s3d.scatter(count*4,snow,seed=seed+1)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.normal.z>.5 and f.origin.z>300][:count]
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    needles=[]
    for f in kept:
        outline=s3d.poly([(0,0),(length/2,-width/2),(length,0),(length/2,width/2)])
        needle=s3d.extrude('pine_needle',outline,2)
        s3d.material(needle,'bark',color=rng.choice(['#6B4027','#805332','#513725']),roughness=1)
        pair=s3d.at(needle,on=s3d.Frames([s3d.Frame().turn(rz=-splay/2),s3d.Frame().turn(rz=splay/2)]))
        cluster=s3d.group('needle_fascicle',pair)
        needles.append(s3d.at(cluster,on=f.offset(1).turn(rz=rng.uniform(0,180))))
    return s3d.group('caught_pine_needles',needles)

import sand3d as s3d
import random
import numpy as np

def alien_alpine_drystone_wall(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    foundation, foot = foundation_stones(seed=seed + 11)
    lower, low = lower_courses(foot, seed=seed + 23)
    middle, mid = middle_courses(low, seed=seed + 37)
    upper, high = upper_course(mid, seed=seed + 51)
    crest, caps = broken_crest(high, seed=seed + 67)
    minerals = embedded_mineral_seams(foot + low + mid + high + caps, seed=seed + 83)
    return s3d.assembly('alien_alpine_drystone_wall', foundation, lower, middle, upper, crest, minerals)

def foundation_stones(seed=0, width=1840, depth=590, height=192, count=5):
    stones, records = stone_course(width, depth, height, count, [], seed, 'foundation', foundation=True)
    return (s3d.group('foundation_stones', *stones), records)

def stone_course(width, depth, height, count, support, seed, name, foundation=False, crest=False, gap=8, width_spread=0.27, height_spread=0.04, xshift=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    weights = [rng.uniform(1 - width_spread, 1 + width_spread) for i in range(count)]
    lengths = [v / sum(weights) * width for v in weights]
    x = -width / 2 + xshift
    stones, records = ([], [])
    for i, length in enumerate(lengths):
        w = length - gap
        center = x + length / 2
        overlap = [r for r in support if min(center + w / 2, r['x'] + r['w'] / 2) - max(center - w / 2, r['x'] - r['w'] / 2) > gap]
        z = max([r['z'] + r['h'] for r in overlap], default=0) + (0 if foundation else 1)
        h = height * rng.uniform(1 - height_spread, 1 + height_spread)
        if crest:
            h *= 0.53 if i in (0, count - 1) else rng.uniform(0.76, 1.52)
        d = depth * rng.uniform(0.94, 1)
        y = rng.uniform(-gap, gap)
        block = angular_stone(w, d, h, seed + 101 + i, name + '_' + str(i))
        block = s3d.at(block, x=center, y=y, z=z)
        stones.append(block)
        records.append({'part': block, 'x': center, 'y': y, 'z': z, 'w': w, 'd': d, 'h': h})
        x += length
    return (stones, records)

def angular_stone(w, d, h, seed=0, name='stone', bevel=0.12, drift=0.045):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    corners = [(-0.5 + bevel, -0.5), (0.5 - bevel, -0.5), (0.5, -0.5 + bevel), (0.5, 0.5 - bevel), (0.5 - bevel, 0.5), (-0.5 + bevel, 0.5), (-0.5, 0.5 - bevel), (-0.5, -0.5 + bevel)]
    points = []
    for level, inset in [(0, 0.91), (0.28, 1), (0.74, 0.99), (1, 0.86)]:
        dx, dy = (rng.uniform(-drift, drift) * w, rng.uniform(-drift, drift) * d)
        for px, py in corners:
            jitter = rng.uniform(0.96, 1.04)
            points.append((px * w * inset * jitter + dx, py * d * inset * jitter + dy, level * h))
    stone = s3d.hull(name, points)
    palette = ['#302b40', '#383047', '#42384d', '#4a4055', '#34333f', '#6f617b']
    tint = palette[rng.randrange(len(palette))]
    base = np.array([int(tint[j:j + 2], 16) / 255 for j in (1, 3, 5)])

    def rock_colour(x, y, z):
        variation = 0.94 + 0.13 * s3d.noise(x / 93, y / 93, z / 93, seed=seed)
        return np.clip(variation[:, None] * base[None, :], 0, 1)
    s3d.material(stone, 'rock', color=rock_colour, roughness=0.94)
    return stone

def lower_courses(support, seed=0, width=1790, depth=530, height=152):
    first, a = stone_course(width, depth, height, 6, support, seed + 1, 'lower_a', xshift=15)
    second, b = stone_course(width - 28, depth - 30, height, 5, a, seed + 2, 'lower_b', xshift=-18)
    return (s3d.group('lower_courses', *first, *second), a + b)

def middle_courses(support, seed=0, width=1730, depth=458, height=185):
    stones, records = stone_course(width, depth, height, 6, support, seed, 'middle', xshift=-55)
    return (s3d.group('middle_courses', *stones), records)

def upper_course(support, seed=0, width=1640, depth=390, height=175):
    stones, records = stone_course(width, depth, height, 5, support, seed, 'upper', xshift=5)
    return (s3d.group('upper_course', *stones), records)

def broken_crest(support, seed=0, width=1530, depth=340, height=100, remnant_height=112):
    stones, records = stone_course(width, depth, height, 6, support, seed, 'crest', crest=True, xshift=-55)
    remnants = []
    extra = []
    for i, factor in [(1, 1), (3, 0.88)]:
        host = records[i]
        w, d, h = (host['w'] * 0.92, host['d'] * 0.88, remnant_height * factor)
        cap = angular_stone(w, d, h, seed + 101 + i, 'broken_crest_remnant')
        cap = s3d.at(cap, on=s3d.local(host['part'], z=host['h']))
        remnants.append(cap)
        extra.append({'part': cap, 'x': host['x'], 'y': host['y'], 'z': host['z'] + host['h'], 'w': w, 'd': d, 'h': h})
    return (s3d.group('broken_crest', *stones, *remnants), records + extra)

def embedded_mineral_seams(records, seed=0, count=13, seam_width=8, relief=0.9):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    candidates = rng.sample(records, min(count, len(records)))
    seams = []
    for i, r in enumerate(candidates):
        side = -1 if i % 2 == 0 else 1
        path = [(-r['w'] * 0.3, side * r['d'], r['h'] * 0.3), (-r['w'] * 0.1, side * r['d'], r['h'] * 0.48), (r['w'] * 0.09, side * r['d'], r['h'] * 0.54), (r['w'] * 0.28, side * r['d'], r['h'] * 0.76)]
        local_points = [(p[0] + r['x'], p[1] + r['y'], p[2] + r['z']) for p in path]
        hits = s3d.snap(r['part'], local_points, direction='+Y' if side < 0 else '-Y')
        if len(hits) < 2:
            continue
        for j in range(len(hits) - 1):
            a, b = (hits[j].origin, hits[j + 1].origin)
            points = [(a.x, a.y + side * relief, a.z - seam_width / 2), (a.x, a.y + side * relief, a.z + seam_width / 2), (b.x, b.y + side * relief, b.z - seam_width / 2), (b.x, b.y + side * relief, b.z + seam_width / 2), (a.x, a.y - side * relief, a.z - seam_width / 2), (b.x, b.y - side * relief, b.z + seam_width / 2)]
            seam = s3d.hull('mineral_fracture', points)
            s3d.material(seam, 'rock', color='#60c9cb' if i % 3 else '#a1e2df', roughness=0.73)
            seams.append(seam)
    return s3d.group('embedded_mineral_seams', *seams)

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import math
import random

def rustic_rocking_chair_spring_meadow(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    ground_h, rail_length, rail_rise, rail_t = (40, 1060, 80, 46)
    rail_x, leg_y, seat_z, seat_d = (285, 220, 475, 540)
    back_h, back_lean = (625, 150)
    contact = ground_h + rail_t + rail_rise * (2 * leg_y / rail_length) ** 2
    ground = meadow_ground(seed=seed + 1, h=ground_h)
    grass = spring_grass_tufts(ground, seed=seed + 2, rail_x=rail_x)
    runners = s3d.at(rocker_rails(seed=seed + 3, length=rail_length, rise=rail_rise, thickness=rail_t), x=rail_x, z=ground_h)
    runner_twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(runners), mirror='x')
    legs = s3d.at(leg_frames(seed=seed + 4, height=seat_z - contact, foot_y=leg_y), x=rail_x, z=contact - 2)
    leg_twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(legs), mirror='x')
    stretchers = s3d.at(underseat_stretchers(seed=seed + 5), z=seat_z - 55)
    braces = s3d.at(angular_cross_bracing(seed=seed + 6), x=rail_x - 5, z=175)
    brace_twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(braces), mirror='x')
    seat = s3d.at(plank_seat(seed=seed + 7, depth=seat_d), y=-15, z=seat_z)
    back = s3d.at(back_frame(seed=seed + 8, height=back_h, lean=back_lean), y=200, z=seat_z)
    slats = s3d.at(back_slats(seed=seed + 9, height=back_h, lean=back_lean), y=200, z=seat_z)
    arms = s3d.at(open_armrests(seed=seed + 10), x=rail_x, z=seat_z)
    arm_twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(arms), mirror='x')
    vignette = s3d.assembly('rustic_rocking_chair_spring_meadow', ground, grass, runners, runner_twin, legs, leg_twin, stretchers, braces, brace_twin, seat, back, slats, arms, arm_twin)
    return s3d.transform(vignette, rz=180)

def meadow_ground(seed=0, width=1240, depth=1280, h=40, irregularity=24):
    outline = s3d.ring(11, width / 2, start=12).jitter(x=irregularity, y=irregularity, seed=seed)
    points = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width) for f in outline]
    soil = s3d.extrude('bounded_earth_patch', s3d.poly(points), h)
    soil_rgb, pigment_variation, patch_size, edge_tone = (np.array([0.34, 0.24, 0.14]), 0.1, 240, 0.72)

    def earth(x, y, z, n):
        patch = s3d.noise(x / patch_size, y / patch_size, z / patch_size, seed=seed + 1)
        tone = np.where(n[2] > 0.5, 1.0, edge_tone)
        return soil_rgb * ((1 + pigment_variation * patch) * tone)[..., None]
    s3d.material(soil, 'soil', color=earth, roughness=1)
    return soil

def spring_grass_tufts(ground, seed=0, count=380, rail_x=285, rail_clearance=65):
    sites = s3d.scatter(count, ground, seed=seed)
    kept = [f for f in sites if f.normal.z > 0.9 and (not (abs(abs(f.origin.x) - rail_x) < rail_clearance and abs(f.origin.y) < 550))]
    populations = [s3d.Frames(kept[i::3]) for i in range(3)]
    colors = ['#79a643', '#94b94c', '#527d30']
    grass = []
    for i, frames in enumerate(populations):
        tuft = s3d.tufts('spring_pointed_tufts', frames, height=lambda x, y, z, n: 42 + 22 * (0.5 + 0.5 * s3d.noise(x / 180, y / 180, z / 180, seed=seed + 12)), width=11, blades=5, lean=27, shape='blade', seed=seed + 20 + i)
        s3d.material(tuft, 'grass', color=colors[i], roughness=1)
        grass.append(tuft)
    return s3d.group('sparse_spring_meadow_grass', *grass)

def rocker_rails(seed=0, length=1060, rise=80, thickness=46, width=48):
    samples = [i / 8 for i in range(-4, 5)]
    bottom = [(u * length, rise * (2 * u) ** 2) for u in samples]
    top = [(u * length, thickness + rise * (2 * u) ** 2) for u in reversed(samples)]
    rail = s3d.extrude('faceted_curved_rocker', s3d.poly(bottom + top), width, both=True)
    timber_material(rail, seed=seed, color='#805431', grain_axis=0)
    rail = s3d.at(rail, on=s3d.Frame(normal=(1, 0, 0), up=(0, 0, 1)))
    return s3d.group('curved_runner', rail)

def timber_material(ob, seed=0, color='#99683e', grain_axis=2, patch_size=155, end_tone=0.52, weathering=0.32):
    rgb = np.array([int(color[i:i + 2], 16) / 255 for i in (1, 3, 5)])
    worn_rgb = np.array([0.57, 0.5, 0.39])

    def weathered(x, y, z, n):
        patch = s3d.noise(x / patch_size, y / patch_size, z / patch_size, seed=seed)
        wear = weathering * np.clip(0.5 + patch, 0, 1)
        end = np.where(np.abs(n[grain_axis]) > 0.85, end_tone, 1.0)
        pigment = rgb * (1 - wear[..., None]) + worn_rgb * wear[..., None]
        return np.clip((1 + 0.15 * patch)[..., None] * end[..., None] * pigment, 0, 1)
    s3d.material(ob, 'oak', color=weathered, roughness=1)
    return ob

def leg_frames(seed=0, height=375, foot_y=220, top_y=200, splay=25, stock=47):
    leg = connected_beam((0, -foot_y, 0), (-splay, -top_y, height), seed=seed, width=stock, depth=stock, color='#a07549')
    rear = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(leg), mirror='y')
    return s3d.group('sturdy_splayed_side_legs', leg, rear)

def connected_beam(start, end, seed=0, width=42, depth=42, color='#99683e'):
    direction = tuple((b - a for a, b in zip(start, end)))
    length = math.sqrt(sum((v * v for v in direction)))
    return s3d.at(timber_beam(seed=seed, width=width, depth=depth, length=length, color=color), on=s3d.Frame(origin=start, normal=direction))

def timber_beam(seed=0, width=42, depth=42, length=300, color='#99683e', bevel=2):
    beam = s3d.extrude('hewn_timber', s3d.rect(width, depth, chamfer=bevel), length)
    return timber_material(beam, seed=seed, color=color)

def underseat_stretchers(seed=0, width=565, depth=445, stock=36, height=55):
    front = connected_beam((-width / 2, -depth / 2, height / 2), (width / 2, -depth / 2, height / 2), seed=seed, width=height, depth=stock, color='#825837')
    rear = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(front), mirror='y')
    side = connected_beam((width / 2, -depth / 2, height / 2), (width / 2, depth / 2, height / 2), seed=seed + 1, width=stock, depth=height, color='#8e603b')
    twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(side), mirror='x')
    return s3d.group('underseat_apron_frame', front, rear, side, twin)

def angular_cross_bracing(seed=0, span=412, rise=255, width=28, depth=22, lap=11):
    diagonal = connected_beam((-lap / 2, -span / 2, 0), (-lap / 2, span / 2, rise), seed=seed, width=width, depth=depth, color='#8b613c')
    other = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(diagonal), mirror='y')
    return s3d.group('side_x_braces', diagonal, other)

def plank_seat(seed=0, width=620, depth=540, thickness=39, count=6, gap=5):
    sites = s3d.grid(count, 1, px=width / count)
    shades = ['#a47b51', '#ac8050', '#986c43', '#b18a5c', '#9e774c', '#aa7a49']
    planks = [s3d.at(seat_plank(seed=seed + 20 + i, width=width / count - gap, depth=depth, thickness=thickness, color=shades[i % len(shades)]), on=f) for i, f in enumerate(sites)]
    return s3d.group('broad_gapped_plank_seat', *planks)

def seat_plank(seed=0, width=98, depth=540, thickness=39, uneven=6, color='#a47b51'):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    left, right = (-width / 2, width / 2)
    nose, tail = (-depth / 2 + rng.uniform(-uneven, uneven), depth / 2 + rng.uniform(-uneven, uneven))
    outline = [(left, nose), (right - uneven, nose - uneven / 2), (right, 0), (right - uneven / 2, tail), (left + uneven, tail), (left - uneven / 2, 0)]
    plank = s3d.extrude('uneven_seat_board', s3d.poly(outline), thickness)
    return timber_material(plank, seed=seed + 1, color=color, grain_axis=1)

def back_frame(seed=0, height=625, lean=150, width=520, stock=44):
    post = connected_beam((width / 2, 0, 0), (width / 2, lean, height), seed=seed, width=stock, depth=stock, color='#967047')
    twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(post), mirror='x')
    top = connected_beam((-width / 2 - stock / 2, lean, height - stock / 2), (width / 2 + stock / 2, lean, height - stock / 2), seed=seed + 1, width=stock, depth=62, color='#a87c4d')
    lower_z = stock * 2
    lower = connected_beam((-width / 2, lean * lower_z / height, lower_z), (width / 2, lean * lower_z / height, lower_z), seed=seed + 2, width=stock, depth=stock, color='#835a38')
    return s3d.group('leaning_back_posts_and_rails', post, twin, top, lower)

def back_slats(seed=0, height=625, lean=150, width=442, count=5, board_w=68, thickness=27, lower=72, upper_gap=48):
    positions = s3d.grid(count, 1, px=(width - board_w) / (count - 1))
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    slats = []
    for i, f in enumerate(positions):
        length = (height - lower - upper_gap + rng.uniform(-8, 8)) * math.sqrt(1 + (lean / height) ** 2)
        slat = seat_plank(seed=seed + 30 + i, width=board_w + rng.uniform(-4, 4), depth=length, thickness=thickness, uneven=5, color=['#a97e51', '#91683f', '#b18a5a'][i % 3])
        norm = math.sqrt(height * height + lean * lean)
        center = (f.origin.x, lean * lower / height - 12 + lean / norm * length / 2, lower + height / norm * length / 2)
        frame = s3d.Frame(origin=center, normal=(0, -height, lean), up=(0, lean, height))
        slats.append(s3d.at(slat, on=frame))
    return s3d.group('five_mismatched_back_slats', *slats)

def open_armrests(seed=0, arm_height=245, board_t=34, board_w=76, front=-300, rear=264, post_y=-215, stock=37):
    post = connected_beam((0, post_y, 0), (0, post_y, arm_height - board_t), seed=seed, width=stock, depth=stock, color='#9c7146')
    board = s3d.at(seat_plank(seed=seed + 1, width=board_w, depth=rear - front, thickness=board_t, uneven=2, color='#ad8454'), y=(rear + front) / 2, z=arm_height - board_t)
    return s3d.group('open_arm_and_front_support', post, board)

items.program:
import sand3d as s3d
import random


def snow_covered_hay_roll(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    soil = soil_patch(seed=seed + 1)
    body = hay_roll_body(seed=seed + 2)
    spiral = s3d.at(rolled_straw_spiral(seed=seed + 3), on=body.near_end)
    ridges = lengthwise_straw_ridges(body, seed=seed + 4)
    cap = upper_snow_cap(body, seed=seed + 5)
    other_end = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(spiral), mirror='y')
    roll = s3d.at(s3d.group('snowy_hay', body, spiral, other_end, ridges, cap), z=620)
    patches = ground_snow_patches(soil, seed=seed + 6)
    grass = sparse_grass_tufts(soil, patches, seed=seed + 7)
    return s3d.assembly('snow_covered_hay_roll', soil, roll, patches, grass)


def soil_patch(seed=0, width=1800, depth=1600, height=60, corners=11, irregularity=65):
    sites = s3d.ring(corners, 1).jitter(x=irregularity / width, y=irregularity / depth, seed=seed)
    outline = s3d.poly([(f.origin.x * width / 2, f.origin.y * depth / 2) for f in sites])
    soil = s3d.extrude('irregular_soil', outline, height)
    s3d.material(soil, 'soil', color='#684934', roughness=1)
    return soil


def hay_roll_body(seed=0, radius=560, length=1000, sides=12, end_skin=8):
    hay = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('polygonal_hay', s3d.polygon(sides, radius * 2), length, both=True), rx=90)
    s3d.material(hay, 'plastic', color='#bd862c', roughness=1)
    end = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('packed_straw_end', s3d.polygon(sides, radius * 2 - end_skin), end_skin), y=-length / 2, rx=90)
    s3d.material(end, 'plastic', color='#d49f43', roughness=1)
    return s3d.assembly('hay_roll_body', hay, end, near_end=s3d.Frame((0, -length / 2 - end_skin, 0), normal=(0, -1, 0), up=(0, 0, 1)))


def rolled_straw_spiral(seed=0, inner_r=48, outer_r=526, turns=4, corners=12, band=76, seam=13, relief=13):
    directions = list(s3d.ring(corners, 1, start=15 + seed % corners))
    winding = directions * turns + directions[:1]
    radii = [inner_r + (outer_r - inner_r) * k / (len(winding)-1) for k, f in enumerate(winding)]
    points = [(f.origin.x*r, f.origin.y*r, relief) for f,r in zip(winding,radii)]
    channel = s3d.wire('rolled_straw_dark_seam', points, d=band)
    s3d.material(channel, 'plastic', color='#9a6627', roughness=1)
    strand = s3d.wire('broad_golden_spiral', [(x,y,z+seam) for x,y,z in points], d=band-seam*2)
    s3d.material(strand, 'plastic', color='#e6b653', roughness=1)
    heart = s3d.extrude('straw_core', s3d.polygon(7, inner_r * 1.5), relief * 2)
    s3d.material(heart, 'plastic', color='#d9a044', roughness=1)
    return s3d.group('rolled_straw_spiral', channel, strand, heart)


def lengthwise_straw_ridges(body, seed=0, radius=560, count=48, length=1000, width=23, variation=24):
    sites = s3d.ring(count, radius * 1.3, start=4, on=s3d.Frame(normal=(0,-1,0), up=(0,0,1)))
    hits = s3d.snap(body, sites)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    parts = []
    palette = ['#e5b44e', '#c98f30', '#dca23e', '#b97c25']
    for i, f in enumerate(hits):
        p = f.origin
        start = -length / 2 - rng.uniform(0, variation)
        end = length / 2 + rng.uniform(0, variation)
        ridge = s3d.wire('long_straw_ridge', [(p.x,start,p.z),(p.x,end,p.z)], d=width * rng.uniform(.6, 1.3))
        s3d.material(ridge, 'plastic', color=palette[i % len(palette)], roughness=1)
        parts.append(ridge)
    return s3d.group('lengthwise_straw_ridges', *parts)


def upper_snow_cap(body, seed=0, radius=560, depth=1000, thickness=110, overhang=52):
    # The lower contour is sampled on the actual twelve-sided hay crown.
    probes = s3d.grid(5, 1, radius * .43).move(z=radius * 2)
    hits = s3d.snap(body, probes, direction='-Z')
    underside = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.z - 8) for f in hits]
    underside.sort()
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    crown = [(x * (1 + overhang / radius), z + thickness + rng.uniform(-12, 12)) for x,z in underside]
    profile = s3d.poly(underside + list(reversed(crown)))
    snow = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('thick_crown_snow', profile, depth + overhang * 3, both=True), rx=90)
    half = radius + overhang
    front = -depth / 2 - overhang
    back = depth / 2 + overhang / 2
    footprint = [(-half, front+overhang),(-radius*.65,front-overhang*.9),(-radius*.28,front+overhang*1.25),(radius*.12,front-overhang*1.15),(radius*.5,front+overhang*.4),(half,front+overhang), (radius*.81,-depth*.28),(radius*.96,-depth*.07),(radius*.83,depth*.2),(half,back-overhang*.3),(radius*.55,back+overhang*.4),(0,back),( -radius*.6,back+overhang*.3),(-half,back-overhang),(-radius*.82,depth*.21),(-radius*.97,-depth*.05),(-radius*.80,-depth*.29)]
    limit = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('snow_perimeter_tool', s3d.poly(footprint), radius*3), z=-radius)
    snow = s3d.intersect(snow, limit)
    s3d.material(snow, 'plastic', color='#aabccc', roughness=1, metallic=0, emission=0)
    return snow


def ground_snow_patches(soil, seed=0, height=24, corner_count=7):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # A few deliberately separate islands leave the soil visible.
    layout = [(-650,-320,260,210), (590,-390,290,220), (-310,-650,260,150), (350,-670,330,150), (-630,300,280,270), (570,370,300,250), (10,625,360,160)]
    parts = []
    for i,(x,y,w,d) in enumerate(layout):
        probe = s3d.Frames([s3d.Frame((x,y,200))])
        hit = s3d.snap(soil, probe, direction='-Z')[0]
        ring = s3d.ring(corner_count, 1).jitter(x=.15,y=.15, seed=seed+i+1)
        profile = s3d.poly([(f.origin.x*w/2,f.origin.y*d/2) for f in ring])
        patch = s3d.extrude('fallen_snow_patch', profile, height*rng.uniform(.6,1.2), taper=20)
        s3d.material(patch, 'plastic', color='#c1ccd4', roughness=1, metallic=0, emission=0)
        parts.append(s3d.at(patch,on=hit))
    return s3d.group('ground_snow_patches', *parts)


def sparse_grass_tufts(soil, snow, seed=0, candidates=150, height=95, width=20):
    sites = s3d.scatter(candidates, soil, seed=seed)
    exposed = [f for f in sites if f.origin.z > 59 and (abs(f.origin.x)>585 or abs(f.origin.y)>570)]
    probes = s3d.Frames(s3d.Frame((f.origin.x,f.origin.y,200)) for f in exposed)
    snow_hits = s3d.snap(snow, probes, direction='-Z')
    kept = s3d.Frames(f for f in exposed if not any((f.origin.x-h.origin.x)**2+(f.origin.y-h.origin.y)**2 < 1 for h in snow_hits))
    grass = s3d.tufts('sparse_winter_grass', kept, height=height, width=width, blades=4, lean=30, seed=seed+1)
    s3d.material(grass, 'grass', color='#88804a', roughness=1)
    return grass

items.program:
import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random


def overgrown_polygonal_tree_bench(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(6, smooth=False)
    seat = seat_ring(seed=seed+1)
    frame = bench_underframe(seed=seed+2)
    legs = timber_leg(seed=seed+3)
    trunk = crooked_trunk(seed=seed+4)
    roots = exposed_root(seed=seed+5)
    branches = canopy_branch(seed=seed+6)
    crown = foliage_cluster(branches, seed=seed+7)
    moss = moss_patch(seat, legs, roots, seed=seed+8)
    vines = leafy_vine(seed=seed+9)
    return s3d.assembly('overgrown_polygonal_tree_bench', seat, frame, legs, trunk, roots, branches, crown, moss, vines)


def wood_colour(x,y,z):
    v = .035*np.sin(x/165+y/235+z/94)
    return np.stack((.64+v,.365+v*.8,.145+v*.45),axis=-1)


def bark_colour(x,y,z):
    v = .025*np.sin(x/112+y/83+z/190)
    return np.stack((.24+v,.165+v,.105+v*.6),axis=-1)


def leaf_colour(x,y,z):
    v = .045*np.sin(x/207+y/166+z/153)
    return np.stack((.075+v*.5,.38+v,.155+v*.7),axis=-1)


def moss_colour(x,y,z):
    v = .045*np.sin(x/70+y/87+z/49)
    return np.stack((.48+v,.61+v,.105+v*.5),axis=-1)


def seat_ring(seed=1, inner=465, outer=1120, height=460, thick=85, courses=3, gap=9, bevel=11):
    parts=[]
    pitch=(outer-inner)/courses
    for k in range(courses):
        a=inner+k*pitch+gap/2
        b=inner+(k+1)*pitch-gap/2
        profile=s3d.poly([(-a/np.sqrt(3)+gap/2,a),(a/np.sqrt(3)-gap/2,a),(b/np.sqrt(3)-gap/2,b),(-b/np.sqrt(3)+gap/2,b)])
        plank=s3d.extrude('broad_seat_plank',profile,thick)
        plank=s3d.chamfer(plank,bevel)
        s3d.material(plank,'oak',color=wood_colour,roughness=.78)
        parts+=s3d.at(plank,on=s3d.ring(6,0,start=0),z=height-thick)
    return s3d.group('seat_ring',parts)


def bench_underframe(seed=2, radius=780, rail=95, height=345, depth=110):
    beam=s3d.box('heavy_underseat_rail',radius*2/np.sqrt(3),rail,depth)
    beam=s3d.chamfer(beam,8)
    s3d.material(beam,'oak',color=wood_colour)
    rails=s3d.at(beam,on=s3d.ring(6,radius,start=30).turn(rz=90),z=height-depth/2)
    return s3d.group('bench_underframe',rails)


def timber_leg(seed=3, radius=885, width=145, depth=155, height=385, splay=55):
    leg=s3d.loft('stout_splayed_leg',s3d.station(0,width+15,depth+15,y=splay,n=4),s3d.station(height,width,depth,n=4))
    leg=s3d.chamfer(leg,9)
    s3d.material(leg,'oak',color=wood_colour)
    legs=s3d.at(leg,on=s3d.ring(6,radius,start=30))
    return s3d.group('timber_leg',legs)


def crooked_trunk(seed=4, height=2180, base=390):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    lean=rng.uniform(65,110)
    trunk=s3d.loft('crooked_living_trunk',s3d.station(0,base*1.35,base*1.2,n=2),s3d.station(height*.15,base,base*.88,x=-25,y=12),s3d.station(height*.38,base*.83,base*.78,x=lean,y=10),s3d.station(height*.6,base*.68,base*.61,x=-40,y=38),s3d.station(height*.8,base*.47,base*.42,x=70,y=10),s3d.station(height,base*.24,base*.22,x=15,y=40))
    s3d.material(trunk,'bark',color=bark_colour)
    return trunk


def exposed_root(seed=5, count=7, length=880, base=235, h=180):
    lengths=s3d.vary(length,150,count,seed=seed)
    sites=s3d.ring(count,0,start=10).jitter(rz=10,seed=seed+1)
    roots=[]
    for i,(f,l) in enumerate(zip(sites,lengths)):
        root=s3d.loft('exposed_tapered_root',s3d.station(0,base,base*.85,n=2),s3d.station(l*.45,base*.62,base*.5,x=base*.12,y=-h*.2),s3d.station(l*.8,base*.29,base*.22,x=-base*.12,y=-h*.8),s3d.station(l,12,12,y=-h+6))
        root=s3d.at(root,on=f.turn(rx=90),z=h)
        s3d.material(root,'bark',color=bark_colour)
        roots.append(root)
    return s3d.group('exposed_root',roots)


def canopy_branch(seed=6, h=1410, count=6, reach=740, rise=650, diameter=145):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    sites=s3d.ring(count,0,start=15).jitter(rz=12,seed=seed+1)
    parts=[]
    tips={}
    for i,f in enumerate(sites):
        length=reach*rng.uniform(.75,1.15)
        lift=rise*rng.uniform(.65,1.15)
        path=[(0,0,0),(length*.32,0,lift*.4),(length*.7,35,lift*.65),(length,55,lift)]
        branch=s3d.wire('crooked_canopy_branch',path,[(0,diameter),(0.45,diameter*.68),(1,35)],tip='flat')
        s3d.material(branch,'bark',color=bark_colour)
        attachment=f.move(z=h+(i%2)*180)
        parts.append(s3d.at(branch,on=attachment))
        tips['tip'+str(i)]=attachment.move(x=length,y=55,z=lift)
    return s3d.assembly('canopy_branch',parts,**tips)


def foliage_cluster(branches, seed=7, width=1000, depth=880, height=800):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    clusters=[]
    for i in range(6):
        f=getattr(branches,'tip'+str(i))
        cluster=angular_foliage(seed=seed+100+i,width=width*rng.uniform(.85,1.1),depth=depth*rng.uniform(.85,1.12),height=height*rng.uniform(.8,1.1))
        clusters.append(s3d.at(cluster,on=f,z=-height*.25))
    top=angular_foliage(seed=seed+200,width=width*1.05,depth=depth,height=height)
    clusters.append(s3d.at(top,x=15,y=40,z=2050))
    return s3d.group('foliage_cluster',clusters)


def angular_foliage(seed=100, width=1000, depth=900, height=800):
    sites=s3d.ring(6,1,start=0).jitter(rz=13,seed=seed)
    rng=random.Random(seed+1)
    points=[]
    for level,ratio in [(0,.45),(.25,1),(.68,.9),(1,.3)]:
        for f in sites:
            points.append((f.origin.x*width*.5*ratio*rng.uniform(.88,1.12),f.origin.y*depth*.5*ratio*rng.uniform(.88,1.12),height*level+rng.uniform(-height*.07,height*.07)))
    clump=s3d.hull('angular_emerald_foliage',points)
    s3d.material(clump,'leaf',color=leaf_colour,roughness=.85)
    return clump


def moss_patch(seat, legs, roots, seed=8, count=70):
    sites=s3d.scatter(count*2,seat,seed=seed)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.normal.z>.8]
    rng=random.Random(seed+1)
    moss=[]
    for i,f in enumerate(kept[:count]):
        patch=s3d.at(s3d.scale(s3d.dome('seat_moss_cushion',rng.uniform(35,95),rng.uniform(6,16)),(1,.55,1)),on=f)
        s3d.material(patch,'moss',color=moss_colour)
        moss.append(patch)
    sites=s3d.scatter(70,legs,seed=seed+2)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.origin.z<290]
    cushion=s3d.dome('leg_moss',55,12)
    s3d.material(cushion,'moss',color=moss_colour)
    moss+=s3d.at(cushion,on=s3d.Frames(kept))
    sites=s3d.scatter(30,roots,seed=seed+3)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.normal.z>.4]
    cushion=s3d.dome('root_moss',65,13)
    s3d.material(cushion,'moss',color=moss_colour)
    moss+=s3d.at(cushion,on=s3d.Frames(kept))
    return s3d.group('moss_patch',moss)


def vine_colour(x,y,z):
    v=.04*np.sin(x/60+y/85+z/90)
    return np.stack((.25+v,.5+v,.10+v*.5),axis=-1)


def leafy_vine(seed=9, radius=885, seat_h=460):
    sites=s3d.ring(3,radius,start=30)
    vine=vine_sprig(seed=seed+1,height=seat_h)
    vines=s3d.at(vine,on=sites)
    return s3d.group('leafy_vine',vines)


def vine_sprig(seed=10,height=460, reach=270, leaf_size=115):
    path=[(90,-50,8),(100,35,height*.25),(90,70,height*.5),(95,-30,height*.8),(100,-25,height+15),(reach-10,0,height+25),(reach+25,15,height*.72),(reach+20,-20,height*.4)]
    stem=s3d.wire('trailing_vine_stem',path,15)
    s3d.material(stem,'leaf',color='#456229')
    sites=s3d.along(path,count=29,spin=137.508).turn(ry=65).jitter(rx=12,rz=20,seed=seed)
    leaf=s3d.hull('pointed_vine_leaf',[(0,0,0),(-leaf_size*.35,0,leaf_size*.45),(0,-9,leaf_size*.48),(leaf_size*.35,0,leaf_size*.45),(0,0,leaf_size)])
    s3d.material(leaf,'leaf',color=vine_colour)
    leaves=s3d.at(leaf,on=sites)
    return s3d.group('vine_sprig',stem,leaves)
